title_zh: 上一讲复习：三类可逆抑制剂的四点记忆法
title_en: Review: a four-point checklist for the three reversible inhibitors

points.zh: 每一类抑制剂记四个点：它作用在反应的哪个点、在米氏方程里乘在哪个参数上、双倒数图 Lineweaver-Burk plot 怎么变、Km 和 Vmax 怎么变。
points.en: For each inhibitor class remember four things: which species it acts on, which term of the Michaelis-Menten equation carries the factor, how the Lineweaver-Burk plot changes, and how Km and Vmax change.

points.zh: 竞争性抑制剂 competitive inhibitor 只影响游离酶 free enzyme E 的那一支，与底物 substrate 争夺同一个酶；它的系数乘在 Km 上。
points.en: A competitive inhibitor acts only on free enzyme E, competing with substrate for the same form; its factor multiplies Km.

points.zh: 非竞争性抑制剂 noncompetitive inhibitor 两边都影响，它既能结合 E 也能结合 ES，只是结合在不同位置；系数乘在整个分母上。
points.en: A noncompetitive inhibitor affects both branches — it binds E and ES alike, just at a different site; its factor multiplies the whole denominator.

points.zh: 反竞争性抑制剂 uncompetitive inhibitor 只结合 ES 状态；系数只乘在 [S] 那一项上。课上的例子是 K-RAS 抑制剂：必须先有核苷酸结合到蛋白上，产生一个小口袋，小分子才能结合上去。
points.en: An uncompetitive inhibitor binds only the ES complex; its factor multiplies only the [S] term. The lecture's example is a K-RAS inhibitor: the nucleotide must bind first to open a small pocket before the compound can bind.

points.zh: 双倒数图：竞争性固定 y 轴交点往上转；非竞争性固定 x 轴交点往上转；反竞争性两个交点同时移动，所以是一组平行线。
points.en: Double-reciprocal plots: competitive pivots about the fixed y-intercept, noncompetitive pivots about the fixed x-intercept, uncompetitive moves both intercepts together and so gives parallel lines.

points.zh: Km 的含义要感性地理解：反应速度等于 Vmax/2 时的底物浓度。Km 越大，就代表需要越多的底物才能达到原本的 Vmax/2。
points.en: Km should be understood intuitively: it is the substrate concentration at which the rate equals Vmax/2. A larger Km means more substrate is needed to reach that same half-maximal rate.

points.zh: 竞争性抑制剂夺走了一部分游离酶，需要更多底物去竞争，所以 Km 变大；而 ES 不受影响，照常以原速率转化成 E + P，所以 Vmax 不变。
points.en: A competitive inhibitor sequesters part of the free enzyme, so more substrate is needed and Km rises; ES is untouched and still turns over to E + P at the same rate, so Vmax is unchanged.

points.zh: 非竞争性抑制剂根本不影响酶与底物的结合，所以 Km 不变；但一部分 ES 变成了不能生成产物的 ESI，所以 Vmax 减小。
points.en: A noncompetitive inhibitor does not touch substrate binding, so Km stays the same; but part of the ES pool becomes ESI, which cannot give product, so Vmax falls.

points.zh: 反竞争性抑制剂最反直觉的一点是 Km 减小 —— 加入之后我们认为酶与底物的亲和力反而增加了；Vmax 减小的原因与非竞争性相同。
points.en: The counter-intuitive feature of an uncompetitive inhibitor is that Km falls — apparent enzyme-substrate affinity goes up — while Vmax falls for the same reason as in the noncompetitive case.

extra.zh: 把三类抑制写成同一个公式就清楚了：v = Vmax[S] / (αKm + α′[S])。竞争性 α>1、α′=1，Km 表观增大而 Vmax 不变；纯非竞争性 α=α′，Km 不变、Vmax 降为 Vmax/α；反竞争性 α=1、α′>1，Km 和 Vmax 同倍下降，所以 Vmax/Km 不变 —— 这正是双倒数图斜率不变、出现平行线的原因。
extra.en: One equation covers all three: v = Vmax[S] / (αKm + α′[S]). Competitive has α>1, α′=1 (apparent Km up, Vmax unchanged); pure noncompetitive has α=α′ (Km unchanged, Vmax down to Vmax/α); uncompetitive has α=1, α′>1, lowering Km and Vmax by the same factor so Vmax/Km is unchanged — which is exactly why the Lineweaver-Burk slope is unchanged and the lines come out parallel.

extra.zh: 课上说 K-RAS 抑制剂需要「ATP 结合到蛋白上以后才会产生一个小口袋」。K-RAS 是小 GTP 酶 small GTPase，结合的是 GTP/GDP 而不是 ATP。G12C 共价抑制剂（sotorasib、adagrasib）结合的 switch-II 口袋只在 GDP 结合态才出现 —— 「先有核苷酸结合、才有可药口袋」这个逻辑是对的，只是核苷酸认错了。
extra.en: The lecture says the K-RAS pocket appears after ATP binds. K-RAS is a small GTPase and binds GTP/GDP, not ATP. The switch-II pocket targeted by the G12C covalent inhibitors (sotorasib, adagrasib) exists only in the GDP-bound state — the logic of 'nucleotide first, druggable pocket second' is right, only the nucleotide is wrong.

extra.zh: 反竞争性抑制剂使 Km 减小，并不是抑制剂真的改善了酶对底物的结合。它结合并「锁住」ES，按 Le Chatelier 原理把 E + S ⇌ ES 的平衡向右拉，于是表观亲和力升高。真实的结合常数没有变，变的是表观值。
extra.en: The drop in Km under an uncompetitive inhibitor is not a genuine improvement in substrate binding. By binding and locking up ES it pulls the E + S ⇌ ES equilibrium to the right (Le Chatelier), raising the apparent affinity. The intrinsic binding constant is unchanged; only the apparent value moves.

extra.zh: 课上没提混合型抑制 mixed inhibition：抑制剂同时结合 E 和 ES 但亲和力不同（α ≠ α′），Vmax 一定下降，Km 则可增可减。纯非竞争性只是 α = α′ 的特例，考试里常把这两个词混用，看到「Vmax 下降、Km 不变」才是纯非竞争性。
extra.en: Mixed inhibition was not covered: the inhibitor binds both E and ES but with different affinities (α ≠ α′), so Vmax always falls while Km may rise or fall. Pure noncompetitive inhibition is just the special case α = α′; only 'Vmax down, Km unchanged' identifies it.

quiz.q_zh: 在双倒数作图上出现一组平行线的是哪一类抑制剂？
quiz.q_en: Which class of inhibitor gives a set of parallel lines on a double-reciprocal plot?

options.zh: 纯非竞争性抑制剂
不可逆抑制剂
反竞争性抑制剂
竞争性抑制剂

quiz.explain_zh: 反竞争性抑制使 Km 和 Vmax 同倍下降，Vmax/Km 不变，因此斜率不变、直线平行上移。竞争性抑制固定 y 轴交点，纯非竞争性抑制固定 x 轴交点，两者都是转动而不是平移；不可逆抑制相当于减少酶量，也不给出平行线。
quiz.explain_en: Uncompetitive inhibition lowers Km and Vmax by the same factor, so Vmax/Km — the slope — is unchanged and the lines shift up in parallel. The competitive case pivots about a fixed y-intercept and the pure noncompetitive case about a fixed x-intercept; both rotate rather than translate. Irreversible inhibition simply removes active enzyme and gives no parallel set.

quiz.q_zh: 加入竞争性抑制剂后，酶的 Km 和 Vmax 如何变化？
quiz.q_en: How do Km and Vmax change when a competitive inhibitor is added?

options.zh: Km 减小，Vmax 减小
Km 增大，Vmax 减小
Km 增大，Vmax 不变
Km 不变，Vmax 减小

quiz.explain_zh: 抑制剂夺走部分游离酶，需要更多底物才能达到 Vmax/2，故 Km 增大；ES 不受影响，底物足够高时仍能达到原来的最大速度，故 Vmax 不变。「Km 不变、Vmax 减小」描述的是纯非竞争性抑制，「Km 减小、Vmax 减小」描述的是反竞争性抑制，「Km 增大、Vmax 减小」属于混合型抑制。
quiz.explain_en: The inhibitor sequesters free enzyme, so more substrate is needed to reach Vmax/2 and Km rises; ES is untouched, so at saturating substrate the original maximum rate is still reached and Vmax is unchanged. 'Km unchanged, Vmax decreases' describes pure noncompetitive inhibition, 'Km decreases, Vmax decreases' describes uncompetitive inhibition, and 'Km increases, Vmax decreases' is the mixed type.

quiz.q_zh: 反竞争性抑制剂结合的是酶的哪一种形式？
quiz.q_en: Which form of the enzyme does an uncompetitive inhibitor bind?

options.zh: 只结合 ES 复合物
只结合游离酶 E
E 和 ES 都能结合
只结合游离底物 S

quiz.explain_zh: 反竞争性抑制剂需要底物先结合、构象改变后暴露出的位点，所以只认 ES。「只结合游离酶 E」是竞争性抑制的定义，「E 和 ES 都能结合」是非竞争性/混合型抑制；结合游离底物的分子根本不算酶抑制剂，那是底物螯合。
quiz.explain_en: An uncompetitive inhibitor needs the site that appears only after substrate binding changes the conformation, so it recognises ES alone. Binding only free E defines competitive inhibition; binding both E and ES describes the noncompetitive or mixed type. A molecule that binds free substrate is not an enzyme inhibitor at all — that is substrate sequestration.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：温度与 pH 不是特征常数、酶的活性中心只占 1–2%
title_en: Review: temperature and pH are not characteristic constants; the active site is 1–2% of the protein

points.zh: 抑制剂的分类（可逆、不可逆、专一性不可逆抑制剂）不必死记，只是扩展知识面。一种抑制剂本来也不会很明确地属于某一类型，这些概念是早期为了研究方便提出来的。
points.en: The taxonomy of inhibitors (reversible, irreversible, specific irreversible) does not need memorising — it only broadens the picture. A real inhibitor rarely falls cleanly into one class; these categories were coined early on for convenience.

points.zh: 温度和 pH 都不是酶的特征性常数。对一种酶来说，唯一的特征性常数是它的 Km。
points.en: Neither temperature nor pH is a characteristic constant of an enzyme. For a given enzyme the only characteristic constant is its Km.

points.zh: 但 Km 也是有条件的：只有在一定温度、一定条件、一定反应 buffer 下才有一个特定的 Km，反应条件变了 Km 值也不一样。
points.en: Even Km comes with conditions: it is defined at a given temperature, in a given buffer, under given conditions — change the conditions and the value changes.

points.zh: 所谓最适温度、最适 pH 也不固定：换一种底物、改变反应条件，最适温度和最适 pH 都可能跟着变，所以它们不是特征性常数。
points.en: The optimum temperature and optimum pH are not fixed either: change the substrate or the reaction conditions and both can shift, which is why they do not count as characteristic constants.

points.zh: 酶的作用机理这一节没有太大的重点，整节其实就是举了溶菌酶 lysozyme 一个例子，用来建立「酶是怎样发挥作用的」这个概念。
points.en: The section on catalytic mechanism carries no single key fact; it is essentially one worked example — lysozyme — used to build an intuition for how an enzyme works.

points.zh: 酶的活性中心 active site 一般只占整个蛋白体积的 1% 到 2%。
points.en: The active site generally occupies only 1–2% of the whole protein's volume.

points.zh: 可以认为一个酶的活性中心就是催化三联体 catalytic triad 再加上几个必要的疏水氨基酸，也就是几个到十几个氨基酸的侧链或主链。
points.en: One can think of the active site as the catalytic triad plus a few essential hydrophobic residues — the side chains or backbone of only a handful to a dozen amino acids.

points.zh: 剩下 98% 的位置是非催化位点，虽然不直接发挥催化作用，但一样可以被小分子结合 —— 有一大类非竞争性抑制剂就是这样来的。
points.en: The remaining 98% is non-catalytic, and although it does no chemistry it can still bind small molecules — which is where a whole class of noncompetitive inhibitors comes from.

points.zh: 催化三联体里真正进攻底物的那个残基是 serine，也可以是 cysteine。
points.en: The residue that actually attacks the substrate in the catalytic triad is a serine, or equally a cysteine.

extra.zh: 为什么最适温度不算常数，可以再说得硬一点：它是两条曲线的交点 —— 温度升高使反应速率按 Arrhenius 关系上升，同时使酶热失活加快。因此测活时间越长，观察到的「最适温度」越低。它是一个操作性定义，不是热力学量。最适 pH 则由活性中心关键残基的解离状态决定，换底物、换离子强度都会移动。
extra.en: A sharper reason why the temperature optimum is not a constant: it is the crossing point of two curves — rate rising with temperature (Arrhenius) and thermal inactivation accelerating with it. The longer the assay, the lower the apparent optimum. It is an operational definition, not a thermodynamic quantity. The pH optimum is set by the ionisation state of key active-site residues and shifts with substrate and ionic strength.

extra.zh: Km 不等于解离常数 Kd。只有当 k2 ≪ k−1（底物结合达到快速平衡）时 Km 才近似等于 ES 的 Kd。衡量酶「好不好」的真正参数是催化效率 catalytic efficiency kcat/Km，其上限受扩散控制，约 10⁸–10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹。
extra.en: Km is not a dissociation constant. It approximates the Kd of ES only when k2 ≪ k−1, i.e. under rapid-equilibrium binding. The parameter that actually rates an enzyme is the catalytic efficiency kcat/Km, whose ceiling is diffusion-limited at roughly 10⁸–10⁹ M⁻¹s⁻¹.

extra.zh: 那「不发挥作用的 98%」正是现代药物设计找别构位点 allosteric site 的地方。别构抑制剂结合在活性中心之外，因此不必与底物竞争，也更容易做出选择性 —— 同一家族的酶活性中心往往高度保守，别构口袋却各不相同。
extra.en: That 'inert 98%' is precisely where modern drug design hunts for allosteric sites. An allosteric inhibitor binds away from the active site, so it need not compete with substrate and is easier to make selective — active sites within an enzyme family are often highly conserved while allosteric pockets are not.

quiz.q_zh: 按照课上的说法，下列哪一项才是某种酶的特征性常数？
quiz.q_en: According to the lecture, which of these is a characteristic constant of a given enzyme?

options.zh: 最适反应 pH
底物的初始浓度
米氏常数 Km
最适反应温度

quiz.explain_zh: Km 是酶本身的性质（在给定温度、buffer 条件下）。最适温度和最适 pH 会随底物和反应条件改变，所以不是特征常数；底物初始浓度是实验者设定的变量，与酶无关。
quiz.explain_en: Km is a property of the enzyme itself, at a stated temperature and buffer. The optimum temperature and optimum pH both shift with substrate and conditions, so neither qualifies; the initial substrate level is a variable the experimenter chooses and says nothing about the enzyme.

quiz.q_zh: 酶的活性中心大约占整个蛋白的多大比例？
quiz.q_en: About what fraction of the whole protein does the active site occupy?
quiz.explain_zh: 活性中心一般只由几个到十几个氨基酸的侧链或主链构成，约占蛋白体积的 1%–2%。更大的比例与「催化部位很小、其余 98% 是非催化位置」这一事实矛盾。
quiz.explain_en: The active site is built from the side chains or backbone of only a handful to a dozen residues, roughly 1–2% of the protein's volume. The larger figures contradict the point that the catalytic machinery is tiny and the other 98% is non-catalytic.

quiz.q_zh: 课上说，有一大类非竞争性抑制剂之所以存在，是因为什么？
quiz.q_en: According to the lecture, why does a whole class of noncompetitive inhibitors exist?

options.zh: 抑制剂只能结合 ES 复合物
options.en: Such inhibitors can bind only the ES complex

options.zh: 酶的 Km 会随温度而不断改变
options.en: The Km of an enzyme drifts with temperature

options.zh: 非催化位点同样能结合小分子
options.en: Non-catalytic sites can also bind small molecules

options.zh: 抑制剂与底物的结构高度相似
options.en: Such inhibitors closely resemble the substrate

quiz.explain_zh: 蛋白上 98% 的非催化表面照样可以被小分子结合，结合后通过构象影响酶活，这就是非竞争性抑制的结构来源。与底物结构相似是竞争性抑制剂的特征；只结合 ES 是反竞争性抑制的定义；Km 随温度变化是另一个话题，与抑制类型无关。
quiz.explain_en: The 98% of the surface that does no chemistry can still bind small molecules, and binding there alters activity through conformation — that is the structural origin of noncompetitive inhibition. Resembling the substrate characterises a competitive inhibitor; binding only ES defines an uncompetitive one; and Km drifting with temperature is a separate topic unrelated to inhibitor class.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：活性中心的研究方法，临近效应与定向效应
title_en: Review: studying the active site, plus proximity and orientation effects

points.zh: 研究酶活性中心的传统方法（各种化学修饰、加入试剂看反应）现在已经基本没有人用了，这一节不重要。
points.en: The classical ways of mapping an active site — chemical modification, adding reagents and watching the reaction — are barely used any more; this section is not important.

points.zh: 原因是结构生物学的极大发展：想研究一个酶（比如 RdRP），现在直接把结构解出来，它怎么催化、怎么反应就都看得见了。
points.en: The reason is the enormous growth of structural biology: to study an enzyme such as RdRP one now simply solves the structure, and how it catalyses and reacts becomes visible.

points.zh: 其中定点诱变 site-directed mutagenesis 是个例外，在酶工程里仍然涉及得比较多。
points.en: Site-directed mutagenesis is the exception — it still features heavily in enzyme engineering.

points.zh: 催化机理中讲了两个效应。临近效应 proximity effect：酶和底物天然就有很高的亲和力，活性中心附近的一些氨基酸还能进一步吸引底物，使底物在活性中心附近的局部浓度大大增加。
points.en: Two effects were covered. The proximity effect: enzyme and substrate already have high intrinsic affinity, and residues around the active site attract the substrate further, greatly raising its local concentration near the site.

points.zh: 定向效应 orientation effect：活性口袋会促使天然底物摆出正确的朝向 —— 底物被口袋附近氨基酸的电荷吸引，特地排布成有利于催化反应的姿势。
points.en: The orientation effect: the active-site pocket forces the natural substrate into the correct orientation — charges on nearby residues position it in a geometry favourable for catalysis.

points.zh: 老师用多肽底物解释定向效应：多肽在溶液里可以朝上朝下乱摆，一旦靠近活性中心，酶切位点两侧的氨基酸就被口袋附近的残基吸引，迫使切割位点朝向真正进攻的 serine 或 cysteine。
points.en: The worked explanation uses a peptide substrate: in solution it tumbles freely, but once near the active site the residues flanking the scissile bond are attracted by pocket residues, forcing the cleavage site to face the attacking serine or cysteine.

points.zh: 反过来说，如果底物以错误的方式、头尾掉转着进入口袋，酶就没有办法识别它。
points.en: Conversely, if the substrate enters the pocket the wrong way round, head to tail, the enzyme cannot recognise it.

points.zh: 老师强调这两个效应都只是假说，并没有人真正做实验去鉴定过，只是一种普遍接受的说法。
points.en: The teacher stresses that both effects are hypotheses — no one has really tested them experimentally; they are simply widely accepted accounts.

extra.zh: 临近 + 定向效应的作用可以量化为「有效浓度 effective concentration」：把一个双分子反应变成准分子内反应后，相当于把反应伙伴的浓度提高到某个等效值，在小分子模型体系里可以达到 10⁵–10⁸ M 的量级（远高于任何真实溶液浓度）。这也说明它们并不只是「假说」，模型化合物的动力学是可以测量的。
extra.en: Proximity plus orientation can be quantified as an 'effective concentration': converting a bimolecular reaction into a quasi-intramolecular one is equivalent to raising the partner's concentration to some effective value, which in small-molecule model systems reaches 10⁵–10⁸ M — far above any real solution concentration. This also shows the effects are more than hypotheses: model-compound kinetics measure them.

extra.zh: 另外两个同样重要的催化机制没有展开：过渡态稳定 transition-state stabilization —— 酶对过渡态的亲和力高于对底物的亲和力（Pauling 的核心论点），降低的正是活化能，也是过渡态类似物 transition-state analogue 成为超强抑制剂的原因；以及底物形变 substrate strain，把底物扭向过渡态的构象（溶菌酶的半椅式就是这一条）。
extra.en: Two equally important mechanisms were left out: transition-state stabilization — the enzyme binds the transition state more tightly than the substrate (Pauling's central argument), which is what lowers the activation energy and why transition-state analogues make such potent inhibitors; and substrate strain, distorting the substrate towards the transition-state geometry (lysozyme's half-chair is exactly this).

extra.zh: 定点诱变的经典读出方式值得记：突变催化残基主要降低 kcat，突变结合口袋的残基主要升高 Km。看到「kcat 降低 10⁴ 倍而 Km 基本不变」就应当想到被改掉的是催化残基而不是结合残基。
extra.en: The classic readout of site-directed mutagenesis is worth remembering: mutating a catalytic residue mainly lowers kcat, while mutating a binding-pocket residue mainly raises Km. 'kcat down 10⁴-fold with Km almost unchanged' points to a catalytic residue, not a binding one.

quiz.q_zh: 临近效应 proximity effect 说的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What does the proximity effect describe?

options.zh: 底物以正确的朝向进入活性口袋
options.en: Substrate enters the pocket correctly oriented

options.zh: 酶对过渡态的亲和力高于对底物
options.en: The enzyme binds the transition state tighter

options.zh: 底物被扭曲成不稳定的中间构象
options.en: Substrate is distorted into a strained shape

options.zh: 底物在活性中心附近局部浓度升高
options.en: Substrate local concentration rises near the site

quiz.explain_zh: 临近效应指酶与活性中心附近的氨基酸把底物吸引过来，使其局部浓度大大增加。「以正确朝向进入口袋」是定向效应；「对过渡态亲和力更高」是过渡态稳定；「扭曲成不稳定构象」是底物形变 —— 三者都是真实的催化机制，但不是临近效应。
quiz.explain_en: The proximity effect is the enzyme and its neighbouring residues drawing substrate in so that its local concentration rises sharply. Entering correctly oriented is the orientation effect; binding the transition state more tightly is transition-state stabilization; being distorted into a strained shape is substrate strain — all real mechanisms, but none of them is the proximity effect.

quiz.q_zh: 课上说传统的活性中心研究方法已经很少有人用，主要原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why, according to the lecture, are classical active-site methods now rarely used?

options.zh: 定点诱变只能用于核酸而非蛋白
options.en: Mutagenesis works on nucleic acids, not proteins

options.zh: 结构生物学可以直接解出酶的结构
options.en: Structural biology can now solve the structure

options.zh: 化学修饰试剂的特异性实在太高
options.en: Chemical modifiers are far too specific to use

options.zh: 酶的活性中心占蛋白的比例太大
options.en: The active site is too large a share of the protein

quiz.explain_zh: 结构一旦解出，怎么催化、怎么反应都能直接看见，不必再靠间接的化学修饰去推断。化学修饰的问题恰恰是特异性不够而不是太高；活性中心只占 1%–2%，不是比例太大；定点诱变是改变 DNA 序列来改造蛋白，正是研究蛋白的手段。
quiz.explain_en: Once the structure is solved, the chemistry and the mechanism are directly visible and need not be inferred from indirect chemical modification. The trouble with chemical modifiers is too little specificity, not too much; the active site is only 1–2% of the protein, not too large a share; and site-directed mutagenesis alters DNA precisely in order to study proteins.

quiz.q_zh: 关于定向效应，讲课中的说法是哪一条？
quiz.q_en: Which statement matches the lecture's account of the orientation effect?

options.zh: 口袋直接切断底物中间的那根肽键
options.en: The pocket itself severs the scissile bond

options.zh: 口袋改变底物一级结构的氨基酸序列
options.en: The pocket alters the substrate's own sequence

options.zh: 口袋迫使底物摆出有利催化的姿势
options.en: The pocket forces a catalysis-friendly pose

options.zh: 口袋使底物的局部浓度提高上千倍
options.en: The pocket raises local substrate levels

quiz.explain_zh: 定向效应指口袋附近氨基酸的电荷把底物排布成有利于反应的朝向，头尾掉转的底物就无法被识别。提高局部浓度是临近效应；真正切断肽键的是进攻性的 serine 或 cysteine，不是口袋本身；口袋不会改写底物的氨基酸序列。
quiz.explain_en: The orientation effect is the charges around the pocket arranging the substrate into a geometry favourable for reaction, so that a substrate turned head to tail is not recognised. Raising local concentration is the proximity effect; the bond is actually broken by the attacking serine or cysteine rather than the pocket itself; and a pocket does not rewrite the substrate's sequence.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：溶菌酶的催化机制与丝氨酸蛋白酶家族
title_en: Review: the lysozyme mechanism and the serine protease family

points.zh: 溶菌酶 lysozyme 是书上举的例子，专门水解细菌细胞壁上一种特殊修饰的糖构成的网状结构（课上称之为几丁质）。
points.en: Lysozyme is the textbook example: it hydrolyses the mesh of specially modified sugars that makes up the bacterial cell wall (called chitin in the lecture).

points.zh: 这个网状结构强度比较高，一般的超声只能破解一部分；要完全破开细菌壁，溶菌酶是比较好的选择。
points.en: That mesh is mechanically strong — sonication alone only partly breaks it, so lysozyme is the better choice when the wall must be fully opened.

points.zh: 溶菌酶有反应选择性：以 6 个糖为一个单元，酶切发生在第 4 位和第 5 位糖之间。
points.en: Lysozyme is selective: taking six sugars as one unit, cleavage occurs between the fourth and fifth sugar.

points.zh: 整个酶分成两大区域，下半部分是非极性区、上半部分是极性区，这两个区域共同促使六糖底物以特殊的姿势进入口袋。
points.en: The enzyme divides into two regions — a nonpolar lower half and a polar upper half — and together they force the hexasaccharide into the pocket in a particular pose.

points.zh: 进入口袋后，第 4 位的那个糖被摆成一种不太稳定的半椅式 half-chair 构象，朝向两个催化氨基酸。
points.en: Once inside, the sugar at position 4 is held in an unstable half-chair conformation facing the two catalytic residues.

points.zh: 两个带负电的氨基酸 —— 一个天冬氨酸 aspartate、一个谷氨酸 glutamate —— 的羧基共同进攻这个本来就不稳定的糖，把它水解掉。
points.en: The carboxyl groups of two negatively charged residues — an aspartate and a glutamate — attack the already-strained sugar and hydrolyse it.

points.zh: 接下来讲丝氨酸蛋白酶 serine protease 家族，这在人体内比较多。不同蛋白酶之间氨基酸组成差异很大，但三维结构都很相似 —— 就像血红蛋白和肌红蛋白，一级结构差异大而三维结构相似（课上称之为趋同进化）。
points.en: Next comes the serine protease family, abundant in humans. Different proteases differ widely in sequence yet share very similar three-dimensional structures — like haemoglobin and myoglobin, whose primary structures differ greatly while their folds match (the lecture calls this convergent evolution).

points.zh: 它们不约而同地形成了大概是能量最低、催化效率最高的同一种三维结构。
points.en: They converge on what is presumably the same lowest-energy, most catalytically efficient fold.

points.zh: 底物口袋的深度决定特异性：口袋最深的那种蛋白酶，能让精氨酸 arginine、赖氨酸 lysine 这类侧链很长的氨基酸进入并被识别水解；其余的口袋都比较浅。
points.en: Pocket depth sets specificity: the protease with the deepest pocket accommodates long side chains such as arginine and lysine for recognition and cleavage, while the others have shallower pockets.

extra.zh: 细菌细胞壁不是几丁质 chitin，而是肽聚糖 peptidoglycan：NAG（N-乙酰葡糖胺）与 NAM（N-乙酰胞壁酸）交替相连，再由短肽桥交联。溶菌酶水解的正是 NAM 与 NAG 之间的 β-1,4 糖苷键。几丁质是纯 NAG 的多糖，见于真菌细胞壁与节肢动物外骨骼 —— 两者都含 NAG，所以极易混淆。
extra.en: The bacterial cell wall is peptidoglycan, not chitin: alternating NAG (N-acetylglucosamine) and NAM (N-acetylmuramic acid) cross-linked by short peptide bridges. Lysozyme cleaves precisely the β-1,4 bond between NAM and NAG. Chitin is a polymer of NAG alone, found in fungal walls and arthropod exoskeletons — both contain NAG, hence the confusion.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 溶菌酶的两个催化残基分工不同，并非「共同进攻」。Glu35 处在疏水微环境中、pKa 被抬高，在中性 pH 下保持质子化，作为广义酸 general acid 把质子交给糖苷氧使其离去；Asp52 带负电，稳定生成的氧鎓离子过渡态（并形成共价的糖基-酶中间体）。一个给质子、一个稳定正电荷，方向恰好相反。
extra.en: The two catalytic residues of lysozyme play different roles rather than attacking jointly. Glu35 sits in a hydrophobic microenvironment with a raised pKa, stays protonated at neutral pH and acts as a general acid, donating a proton to the glycosidic oxygen so it can leave; Asp52 is negatively charged and stabilises the resulting oxocarbenium transition state (forming a covalent glycosyl-enzyme intermediate). One donates a proton, the other stabilises positive charge — opposite roles.

extra.zh: 血红蛋白与肌红蛋白序列差异大而折叠相似，这是趋异进化 divergent evolution —— 它们同属 globin 家族，是同源蛋白 homologs，由共同祖先分化而来。趋同进化 convergent evolution 的教科书例子恰恰在丝氨酸蛋白酶里：chymotrypsin 与细菌的 subtilisin 拥有相同的 Ser–His–Asp 三联体，而整体折叠完全无关，是各自独立演化出来的。
extra.en: Haemoglobin and myoglobin sharing a fold while differing in sequence is divergent evolution — both are globin-family homologs descended from a common ancestor. The textbook case of convergent evolution actually lies within the serine proteases: chymotrypsin and bacterial subtilisin carry the same Ser-His-Asp triad on completely unrelated folds, arrived at independently.

extra.zh: 三种胰腺丝氨酸蛋白酶的特异性靠口袋底部的一个残基区分：trypsin 底部是 Asp189，带负电，所以切在 Arg/Lys 之后；chymotrypsin 口袋疏水而宽大，切在 Phe/Tyr/Trp 等芳香族之后；elastase 的口袋被 Val216 和 Thr226 堵住，只能切在 Ala/Gly 这类小残基之后。三者三联体完全相同，差别只在口袋。
extra.en: The specificity of the three pancreatic serine proteases is set by one residue at the bottom of the pocket: trypsin has Asp189, negatively charged, so it cleaves after Arg/Lys; chymotrypsin's pocket is large and hydrophobic, cleaving after aromatics (Phe/Tyr/Trp); elastase's pocket is blocked by Val216 and Thr226 and cleaves only after small residues such as Ala/Gly. The triad is identical in all three — only the pocket differs.

quiz.q_zh: 溶菌酶催化时，被扭曲成不稳定半椅式构象的是什么？
quiz.q_en: In lysozyme catalysis, what is distorted into an unstable half-chair?

options.zh: 第 1 位的那个糖环
第 6 位的那个糖环
谷氨酸的羧基侧链
第 4 位的那个糖环

quiz.explain_zh: 六糖底物进入口袋后，即将被切断的第 4 位糖被扭成半椅式，这种张力使它更接近过渡态、更容易被水解。第 1 位和第 6 位的糖只提供结合能，不被扭曲；谷氨酸是催化残基，扭曲的是底物而不是酶的侧链。
quiz.explain_en: Once the hexasaccharide is in the pocket, the sugar at site 4 — the one about to be cleaved — is forced into a half-chair, and that strain pushes it towards the transition state. The sugars at sites 1 and 6 only contribute binding energy and are not distorted; the glutamate is a catalytic residue, and it is the substrate that is strained, not the enzyme's side chain.

quiz.q_zh: 细菌细胞壁的主要结构成分是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the main structural component of the bacterial cell wall?

options.zh: 肽聚糖 peptidoglycan
几丁质 chitin
纤维素 cellulose
糖原 glycogen

quiz.explain_zh: 细菌细胞壁是 NAG 与 NAM 交替、由短肽交联的肽聚糖，溶菌酶切的就是 NAM–NAG 之间的 β-1,4 键（课上把它称作几丁质，属口误）。几丁质是真菌细胞壁和节肢动物外骨骼的成分；纤维素构成植物细胞壁；糖原是储能多糖，根本不参与成壁。
quiz.explain_en: The bacterial wall is peptidoglycan — alternating NAG and NAM cross-linked by short peptides — and lysozyme cleaves the β-1,4 bond between NAM and NAG (the lecture's 'chitin' is a slip). Chitin builds fungal walls and arthropod exoskeletons; cellulose builds plant cell walls; glycogen is a storage polysaccharide with no structural role at all.

quiz.q_zh: 胰蛋白酶 trypsin 优先在哪一类残基之后切断肽链？
quiz.q_en: After which residues does trypsin preferentially cleave?

options.zh: 精氨酸和赖氨酸之后
苯丙氨酸和色氨酸之后
丙氨酸和甘氨酸之后
天冬氨酸和谷氨酸之后

quiz.explain_zh: trypsin 口袋最深、底部有带负电的 Asp189，因此专门接纳带正电的长侧链 Arg 和 Lys。切在芳香族残基之后的是 chymotrypsin，切在 Ala/Gly 这类小残基之后的是 elastase；没有哪种胰腺丝氨酸蛋白酶专门切在酸性残基之后（那是 Glu-C 一类细菌蛋白酶的特点）。
quiz.explain_en: Trypsin has the deepest pocket with a negatively charged Asp189 at its base, so it accepts the long positively charged side chains of Arg and Lys. Cleaving after aromatics is chymotrypsin, and cleaving after small residues like Ala/Gly is elastase; no pancreatic serine protease is dedicated to acidic residues (that is the hallmark of bacterial enzymes such as Glu-C).

title_zh: 上一讲复习：催化三联体如何把 serine 变成进攻者
title_en: Review: how the catalytic triad turns a serine into an attacker

points.zh: 催化三联体 catalytic triad 是许多蛋白酶共有的特点，是这一节最重要的概念。
points.en: The catalytic triad is a feature shared by many proteases and is the key concept of this section.

points.zh: 真正发挥水解活性、进攻底物的一般是 serine；也可以是 cysteine —— 只是把氧换成硫，同样有进攻底物的能力。
points.en: The residue that actually hydrolyses and attacks the substrate is usually a serine; it can equally be a cysteine — swapping oxygen for sulfur retains the attacking ability.

points.zh: 整个蛋白里有那么多 serine，只有处在催化三联体里的这一个才能发挥酶活。
points.en: A protein contains many serines, yet only the one embedded in the catalytic triad has catalytic activity.

points.zh: 三联体中间固定是组氨酸 histidine。它的侧链与 serine 的羟基形成氢键，可以理解为这个氢原子被两个氨基酸共用、一人拿一半，因此更容易受外界扰动而移走。
points.en: The middle position is invariably a histidine. Its side chain hydrogen-bonds to the serine hydroxyl — think of that hydrogen as shared half-and-half between the two residues, and therefore easier to displace.

points.zh: 结果 serine 的氧上带负电，带的电荷多就想把电荷给出去，所以进攻能力很强 —— 这就是中间那个 histidine 的关键作用。
points.en: The result is negative charge on the serine oxygen; charge it wants to give away is what makes it such a strong nucleophile — that is the key role of the central histidine.

points.zh: 最左边不一定是天冬氨酸 aspartate，谷氨酸 glutamate 也可以，只要是带羧基的氨基酸就行。
points.en: The left-hand position need not be aspartate; glutamate serves too — any residue bearing a carboxyl group works.

points.zh: 羧基在 pH 7.4 环境下带负电、进攻性很强，会强烈地把组氨酸上原本带有的一个氢原子夺过来；组氨酸夺不过天冬氨酸，就转而从更弱的 serine 身上把氢原子夺过来。
points.en: At pH 7.4 the carboxyl is negatively charged and strongly attractive, pulling a hydrogen away from the histidine; the histidine, unable to win it back from the aspartate, instead takes a hydrogen from the weaker serine.

points.zh: 所以三联体是一个「中继网」：天冬氨酸夺、组氨酸再夺，最终使进攻性氨基酸 serine 上带负电，进攻能力很强。
points.en: So the triad is a relay: the aspartate pulls, the histidine pulls in turn, and the end result is negative charge on the attacking serine and a powerful nucleophile.

points.zh: 新冠病毒的 main protease 没有最左边的天冬氨酸 —— 只要有中间的组氨酸，一样能形成氢键把氢原子夺过来，只是能力稍弱。只有右边两个残基的「催化二联体 dyad」也 OK，定义没有那么严格。核糖核酸酶 RNase 那一页不具代表性，跳过。
points.en: The SARS-CoV-2 main protease lacks the left-hand aspartate — with the histidine alone the hydrogen bond still forms and the hydrogen is still pulled, only somewhat less effectively. A two-residue catalytic dyad is fine; the definition is not that strict. The RNase slide is unrepresentative and was skipped.

extra.zh: 完整机制值得背下来：Ser 的氧亲核进攻底物羰基碳 → 形成第一个四面体中间体（负电荷由氧负离子洞 oxyanion hole 的两个主链 NH 稳定）→ His 作为广义碱接下 Ser 的质子，再作为广义酸把质子交给离去的胺，释放肽段的 N 端一半 → 剩下酰基-酶中间体 acyl-enzyme → 一分子水重复同一步（第二个四面体中间体）完成脱酰基，释放 C 端一半并再生游离酶。共两个四面体中间体、一个共价中间体。
extra.en: The full mechanism is worth memorising: the serine oxygen attacks the carbonyl carbon, giving a first tetrahedral intermediate whose negative charge is stabilised by the two backbone NH groups of the oxyanion hole; the histidine acts as a general base to take the serine proton, then as a general acid to protonate the leaving amine, releasing the N-terminal half; this leaves a covalent acyl-enzyme, which a water molecule attacks in exactly the same way (second tetrahedral intermediate) to release the C-terminal half and regenerate free enzyme. Two tetrahedral intermediates, one covalent intermediate.

extra.zh: 天冬氨酸并非可有可无：它把 histidine 咪唑环的取向固定住，并稳定质子化后的咪唑鎓正电荷。chymotrypsin 的 D102N 突变体活性下降约 10⁴ 倍 —— 三联体缺一角仍有残余活性（所以二联体成立），但代价很大。
extra.en: The aspartate is not optional: it fixes the orientation of the histidine imidazole and stabilises the positive charge of the imidazolium once protonated. The D102N mutant of chymotrypsin loses roughly 10⁴-fold in activity — a triad missing one corner retains residual activity (hence dyads exist), but at a steep cost.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 「共用氢原子、把氢原子夺过来」是形象说法。基态下 Ser 的 OH 并没有真正解离成游离的氧负离子；质子转移到 His 与 Ser 氧对羰基碳的亲核进攻是协同 concerted 发生的，氧负离子只在四面体中间体里短暂存在，并立即被氧负离子洞稳定。
extra.en: 'Sharing' and 'snatching' a hydrogen is a picture, not the state of affairs. In the ground state the serine OH is not actually ionised to a free alkoxide; proton transfer to the histidine and nucleophilic attack on the carbonyl carbon are concerted, and the oxyanion exists only transiently in the tetrahedral intermediate, immediately stabilised by the oxyanion hole.

extra.zh: 新冠病毒 main protease (Mpro / 3CLpro) 的中心是 Cys145–His41 二联体，它属于半胱氨酸蛋白酶 cysteine protease，不是丝氨酸蛋白酶。植物的 papain 家族同样是 Cys–His(–Asn) 体系。nirmatrelvir（Paxlovid 的活性成分）就是共价结合 Cys145 的抑制剂。
extra.en: The centre of the SARS-CoV-2 main protease (Mpro / 3CLpro) is a Cys145-His41 dyad: it is a cysteine protease, not a serine protease. The plant papain family likewise uses a Cys-His(-Asn) system. Nirmatrelvir, the active component of Paxlovid, is a covalent inhibitor of Cys145.

quiz.q_zh: 经典催化三联体由哪三个残基组成？
quiz.q_en: Which three residues make up the classic catalytic triad?

options.zh: Ser–Arg–Asn
Thr–His–Tyr
Ser–His–Asp
Cys–Lys–Glu

quiz.explain_zh: 进攻的 Ser（或 Cys）、中继质子的 His、以及提供羧基的 Asp（或 Glu）。Lys 和 Arg 带正电，无法承担夺取质子的角色；Asn 侧链是酰胺、不带电荷，也提供不了羧基；Tyr 不是三联体成员。
quiz.explain_en: An attacking Ser (or Cys), a His that relays the proton, and an Asp (or Glu) supplying the carboxyl. Lys and Arg are positively charged and cannot pull a proton away; the Asn side chain is a neutral amide and offers no carboxyl; Tyr is not a triad member.

quiz.q_zh: 催化三联体中 histidine 的作用是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the role of the histidine in the catalytic triad?

options.zh: 与底物形成共价的二硫键
options.en: It forms a covalent disulfide with substrate

options.zh: 在两个残基之间中继质子
options.en: It relays the proton between the two residues

options.zh: 直接进攻底物的羰基碳
options.en: It directly attacks the substrate carbonyl carbon

options.zh: 提供负电荷来螯合金属离子
options.en: It supplies charge to chelate a metal ion

quiz.explain_zh: 组氨酸把 serine 的质子接过来交给天冬氨酸一侧，从而让 serine 的氧带上负电、成为强亲核体。直接进攻羰基碳的是 serine 的氧；三联体不含金属，不需要螯合；二硫键发生在两个 cysteine 之间，与三联体的质子中继无关。
quiz.explain_en: The histidine takes the serine's proton and passes it towards the aspartate side, leaving negative charge on the serine oxygen and making it a strong nucleophile. It is the serine oxygen that attacks the carbonyl carbon; the triad contains no metal to chelate; and disulfides form between two cysteines, unrelated to the proton relay.

quiz.q_zh: 新冠病毒 main protease 的催化中心属于哪一种？
quiz.q_en: What kind of catalytic centre does the SARS-CoV-2 main protease use?

options.zh: Cys–His 催化二联体
Ser–His–Asp 三联体
两个天冬氨酸的活性中心
含 Zn²⁺ 的金属活性中心

quiz.explain_zh: 它缺少最左边的天冬氨酸，只靠 Cys145 与 His41 两个残基就能催化，是典型的催化二联体。Ser–His–Asp 是胰凝乳蛋白酶那类丝氨酸蛋白酶；双天冬氨酸中心是 HIV 蛋白酶等天冬氨酸蛋白酶的特征；含锌活性中心属于金属蛋白酶如 MMP、ACE。
quiz.explain_en: It lacks the left-hand aspartate and catalyses with just Cys145 and His41 — a textbook catalytic dyad. Ser-His-Asp belongs to the chymotrypsin-like serine proteases; a pair of aspartates characterises aspartic proteases such as HIV protease; a zinc centre belongs to metalloproteases such as the MMPs and ACE.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：酶活性的别构调节与正负效应物
title_en: Review: allosteric regulation and positive/negative effectors

points.zh: 酶的活性调节这一节，与讲血红蛋白那一节基本上是一样的内容。
points.en: The section on regulating enzyme activity is essentially the same material as the haemoglobin section.

points.zh: 血红蛋白虽然不是一种酶，但它结合氧气、又在特定条件下把氧气放出来，从动力学上讲与酶基本上很像，所以可以拿来类比。
points.en: Haemoglobin is not an enzyme, but it binds oxygen and releases it under defined conditions, which makes it kinetically very enzyme-like and a fair analogy.

points.zh: 这一节最重要的是别构调节 allosteric regulation：酶与一些特殊的化合物分子结合以后，会导致构象 conformation 发生改变，构象改变就可能导致酶活性发生改变。
points.en: The key idea is allosteric regulation: when an enzyme binds certain compounds its conformation changes, and that conformational change can change its activity.

points.zh: 其中最特殊的是多亚基的酶 multi-subunit enzyme：它更容易在结合某个底物之后发生三级结构和四级结构的改变，从而改变与底物结合的效率。
points.en: The special case is the multi-subunit enzyme: binding one substrate more readily changes its tertiary and quaternary structure, and hence its efficiency of binding substrate.

points.zh: 多亚基酶经典的反应曲线是 S 型曲线 sigmoid curve。
points.en: The classic response curve of a multi-subunit enzyme is sigmoid.

points.zh: 加入正效应物、正别构剂 positive effector 以后，S 型曲线整体向上（左）跑，也就是在底物浓度更低的情况下就能发挥出更高的酶活性。
points.en: Adding a positive effector shifts the sigmoid up and to the left: higher activity is reached at lower substrate concentration.

points.zh: 负效应物 negative effector 则相反：在相同底物浓度下只能发挥更低的活性，S 型曲线整体向右平移。
points.en: A negative effector does the reverse: less activity at the same substrate concentration, with the whole sigmoid shifted to the right.

extra.zh: 双曲线 hyperbolic 与 S 型曲线代表两种不同的动力学。米氏动力学的双曲线适用于单亚基、无协同的酶；S 型曲线意味着正协同 positive cooperativity，此时 Km 已不再适用，改用半饱和浓度 K0.5 和 Hill 系数 nH 描述（nH > 1 为正协同，= 1 无协同，< 1 为负协同）。考试里问「别构酶的 Km 是多少」本身就是个陷阱。
extra.en: Hyperbolic and sigmoid curves describe different kinetics. The Michaelis-Menten hyperbola applies to single-subunit, non-cooperative enzymes; a sigmoid signals positive cooperativity, where Km no longer applies and one uses K0.5 together with the Hill coefficient nH (>1 positive cooperativity, =1 none, <1 negative). Asking for 'the Km of an allosteric enzyme' is itself a trap.

extra.zh: 同促效应 homotropic 指效应物就是底物本身（血红蛋白结合 O₂ 促进后续 O₂ 结合）；异促效应 heterotropic 指效应物是另一种分子（2,3-BPG 之于血红蛋白）。异促调节的教科书例子是天冬氨酸转氨甲酰酶 ATCase：终产物 CTP 作为负效应物抑制，ATP 作为正效应物激活。
extra.en: Homotropic means the effector is the substrate itself (O₂ binding to haemoglobin promoting further O₂ binding); heterotropic means it is a different molecule (2,3-BPG for haemoglobin). The textbook heterotropic case is aspartate transcarbamoylase (ATCase): the end product CTP inhibits as a negative effector while ATP activates as a positive one.

extra.zh: 别构调节在代谢中最常见的形式是反馈抑制 feedback inhibition：通路的终产物回过头来抑制第一个关键步骤（committed step）的酶。这是细胞在秒到分钟尺度上控制代谢流的主要手段，比调节基因表达快得多。
extra.en: The commonest metabolic use of allostery is feedback inhibition: the end product of a pathway inhibits the enzyme catalysing the first committed step. This is how cells control metabolic flux on a timescale of seconds to minutes — far faster than regulating gene expression.

quiz.q_zh: 多亚基别构酶的速度—底物浓度曲线通常呈什么形状？
quiz.q_en: What shape is the rate-versus-substrate curve of a multi-subunit allosteric enzyme?

options.zh: 直线
钟形曲线
S 型曲线
双曲线

quiz.explain_zh: 亚基之间的正协同使前一个亚基结合底物后促进后一个亚基结合，于是低浓度段平缓、中段陡升，形成 S 型。双曲线是无协同的米氏动力学；直线只在底物远低于 Km 的一级反应区间近似成立；钟形曲线描述的是酶活对 pH 或温度的依赖。
quiz.explain_en: Positive cooperativity means binding at one subunit promotes binding at the next, so the curve is shallow at low substrate and steep in the middle — a sigmoid. A hyperbola is non-cooperative Michaelis-Menten behaviour; a straight line holds only in the first-order regime well below Km; a bell shape describes how activity depends on pH or temperature.

quiz.q_zh: 加入正效应物之后，别构酶的 S 型曲线怎么变？
quiz.q_en: How does the sigmoid change when a positive effector is added?

options.zh: 曲线右移，需更高底物浓度才行
options.en: Shifts right: more substrate is needed

options.zh: 曲线由 S 型变为竖直的直线
options.en: Turns from sigmoid into a vertical line

options.zh: 曲线形状不变，只有 Vmax 降低
options.en: Shape is kept, only Vmax comes down

options.zh: 曲线左移，低底物浓度即有高活性
options.en: Shifts left: high activity at low substrate

quiz.explain_zh: 正效应物把酶推向高亲和力状态，同样的底物浓度下活性更高，相当于曲线整体左移／上移。右移、需要更多底物是负效应物的效果；曲线不会变成竖直直线，那意味着无限大的协同；只降低 Vmax 而形状不变则是非竞争性抑制的描述，不是别构激活。
quiz.explain_en: A positive effector pushes the enzyme towards its high-affinity state, giving more activity at the same substrate concentration — the curve shifts left and up. Shifting right and needing more substrate is what a negative effector does; the curve never becomes vertical, which would mean infinite cooperativity; and lowering Vmax while keeping the shape describes noncompetitive inhibition, not allosteric activation.

quiz.q_zh: 课上为什么把血红蛋白拿来与酶类比？
quiz.q_en: Why does the lecture use haemoglobin as an analogy for an enzyme?

options.zh: 它结合并释放配体，动力学与酶相似
options.en: It binds and releases ligand, kinetically enzyme-like

options.zh: 它能催化氧分子分解成两个氧原子
options.en: It catalyses the splitting of O2 into two atoms

options.zh: 它是典型的单亚基别构调节蛋白
options.en: It is the classic single-subunit allosteric protein

options.zh: 它的活性中心含有完整的催化三联体
options.en: Its active site carries a full catalytic triad

quiz.explain_zh: 血红蛋白结合氧气、又在特定条件下放出氧气，这个结合—释放过程在动力学上与酶结合底物、释放产物很像，所以可以类比。它并不催化氧分子的断裂（那会破坏氧的运输功能）；它是四亚基而非单亚基；催化三联体属于蛋白酶，血红蛋白的辅基是血红素 heme。
quiz.explain_en: Haemoglobin binds oxygen and releases it under defined conditions, and that bind-and-release cycle is kinetically much like an enzyme binding substrate and releasing product. It does not catalyse splitting O2 (that would destroy its transport function); it has four subunits, not one; and the catalytic triad belongs to proteases, whereas haemoglobin's cofactor is heme.

title_zh: 上一讲复习：齐变与序变模型、酶原激活与磷酸化修饰
title_en: Review: concerted vs sequential models, zymogen activation and phosphorylation

points.zh: 同促效应、异促效应不是重点，这里主要记两个模型：齐变模型和序变模型。
points.en: Homotropic and heterotropic effects are not the priority here; what matters is the two models — concerted and sequential.

points.zh: 齐变模型 concerted model：一个小分子结合到酶上以后，会导致几个亚基同时发生结构变化，同时从 tense type 转到 relaxed type。
points.en: Concerted model: once a small molecule binds, all the subunits change structure simultaneously, switching together from the tense type to the relaxed type.

points.zh: 序变模型 sequential model：一个亚基先变，然后带着后边的一个一个接着变。（老师先脱口说成「异变模型」，随即在同一段内自己改口为序变模型。）
points.en: Sequential model: one subunit changes first and then drags the rest along one after another. (The teacher first says 'heterotropic model' and corrects himself to 'sequential' within the same passage.)

points.zh: 酶原 zymogen 是还没有形成正儿八经的酶的前体。
points.en: A zymogen is the precursor of an enzyme that has not yet become a proper enzyme.

points.zh: 以胰蛋白酶为例：从 mRNA 上翻译出一条无序的很长的多肽，多肽上可能形成一些二硫键，但它还没有正确折叠；只有在特殊的位置被酶切（课上说这个酶是在两个位置被切），才能形成有酶活性的正确三级结构。
points.en: Trypsin as the example: a long disordered polypeptide is translated from the mRNA, may form some disulfide bonds, but is not correctly folded; only after proteolytic cleavage at specific positions (two positions, in the lecture's account) does it adopt the correctly folded, catalytically active tertiary structure.

points.zh: 这个过程在很多病毒里是类似的 —— 先翻译出一条长多肽，再靠酶切成熟。
points.en: The same process occurs in many viruses — a long polypeptide is translated first and matured by proteolytic cleavage.

points.zh: 共价修饰只需要记磷酸化 phosphorylation 一种，因为它是整个信号传导里最重要的共价修饰方法；别的共价修饰在蛋白这一块都没有这么重要。
points.en: Of the covalent modifications, only phosphorylation needs remembering — it is the most important covalent modification in all of signal transduction; the others matter far less at the protein level.

points.zh: 给蛋白质加上一个磷酸基团的叫做蛋白激酶 protein kinase，把蛋白去磷酸化的叫做磷酸酶 phosphatase；老师提醒这两个词的中文译名太像，英文需要自己再查证一下。
points.en: The enzyme that adds a phosphate group is a protein kinase, and the one that removes it is a phosphatase; the teacher notes that the Chinese names are confusingly similar and the English should be checked.

points.zh: 磷酸化位点一般分两类：一类是丝氨酸 serine 和苏氨酸 threonine 侧链上的羟基，另一类是酪氨酸 tyrosine 苯环上的羟基。都是加在羟基上，但丝氨酸型可以说占了 90% 以上，酪氨酸型比较少见。
points.en: Phosphorylation sites fall into two classes: the hydroxyls on serine and threonine side chains, and the phenol hydroxyl of tyrosine. Both are phosphorylated on a hydroxyl, but the serine type accounts for well over 90% and the tyrosine type is uncommon.

extra.zh: 把老师在 [00:22:16] 留下的英文查证补上：加磷酸基的是 protein kinase 蛋白激酶，去磷酸的是 protein phosphatase 蛋白磷酸酶；按底物残基分为 serine/threonine kinase 与 tyrosine kinase。磷酸供体是 ATP 的 γ-磷酸（不是 α 或 β），激酶反应本身也需要 Mg²⁺。
extra.en: Filling in the check the teacher deferred at [00:22:16]: the adding enzyme is a protein kinase, the removing enzyme a protein phosphatase; by substrate residue they divide into serine/threonine kinases and tyrosine kinases. The phosphoryl donor is the γ-phosphate of ATP (not α or β), and the reaction requires Mg²⁺.

extra.zh: 人细胞磷酸化蛋白组的实测比例约为 pSer 86%、pThr 12%、pTyr 1–2%，与课上「丝氨酸占 90% 以上」方向一致（Ser + Thr 合计约 98%）。酪氨酸磷酸化虽然只占百分之一二，却由受体酪氨酸激酶 RTK 主导细胞增殖信号，因此是最重要的一类抗癌药靶点（imatinib、erlotinib 等）。
extra.en: Measured human phosphoproteomes run at roughly 86% pSer, 12% pThr, 1-2% pTyr, consistent with the lecture's 'serine over 90%' (Ser + Thr together are about 98%). Despite that one or two per cent, tyrosine phosphorylation is driven by receptor tyrosine kinases controlling proliferation, which makes it the most heavily drugged target class in oncology (imatinib, erlotinib and others).

extra.zh: 「被切两处」对应的是胰凝乳蛋白酶原 chymotrypsinogen：先由 trypsin 切 Arg15–Ile16 生成 π-chymotrypsin，再自切去掉两个二肽（Ser14–Arg15、Thr147–Asn148）成为稳定的 α-chymotrypsin。胰蛋白酶原 trypsinogen 只需肠激酶 enteropeptidase 在 Lys6 之后切一刀，切下一段六肽即激活，随后可自催化激活更多 trypsinogen。
extra.en: The 'cut in two places' picture fits chymotrypsinogen: trypsin first cleaves Arg15-Ile16 to give π-chymotrypsin, which then autolytically excises two dipeptides (Ser14-Arg15 and Thr147-Asn148) to give the stable α-chymotrypsin. Trypsinogen needs only a single cut by enteropeptidase after Lys6, releasing a hexapeptide, after which it autocatalytically activates further trypsinogen.

extra.zh: 两个模型的可考差别：齐变模型（MWC）规定只有 T、R 两种状态且全部亚基构象必须一致，因此只能解释正协同；序变模型（KNF）允许亚基逐个改变、存在混合构象的中间态，因此既能解释正协同也能解释负协同。真实的血红蛋白介于两者之间，MWC 拟合得更好。
extra.en: The examinable difference: the concerted (MWC) model allows only T and R states with all subunits in the same conformation, so it can only account for positive cooperativity; the sequential (KNF) model lets subunits change one at a time through mixed-conformation intermediates and so can also account for negative cooperativity. Real haemoglobin lies between the two, with MWC giving the better fit.

quiz.q_zh: 齐变模型（concerted model）的核心假设是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the core assumption of the concerted (MWC) model?

options.zh: 底物与效应物结合在同一位点
options.en: Substrate and effector share the same site

options.zh: 所有亚基同时由 T 型转为 R 型
options.en: All subunits switch from T to R together

options.zh: 亚基一个接一个逐步改变构象
options.en: Subunits change conformation one after another

options.zh: 亚基之间不存在任何构象传递
options.en: No conformational signal passes between subunits

quiz.explain_zh: 齐变模型规定整个分子只有 T 和 R 两种状态，所有亚基构象必须一致，因此是同时翻转。逐个改变、带着后面的亚基接着变，是序变模型；亚基之间毫无传递则根本不存在协同效应，也就没有 S 型曲线；底物与效应物结合同一位点属于同促效应的定义，与模型无关。
quiz.explain_en: The concerted model allows the whole molecule only two states, T and R, with all subunits necessarily in the same conformation, so they flip together. Changing one at a time and dragging the rest along is the sequential model; no signal at all between subunits would mean no cooperativity and no sigmoid; and substrate sharing a site with the effector is the definition of a homotropic effect, not a model.

quiz.q_zh: 蛋白质磷酸化最主要的修饰位点是哪里？
quiz.q_en: Where does most protein phosphorylation occur?

options.zh: 赖氨酸侧链末端的氨基
options.en: The terminal amino group of lysine

options.zh: 丝氨酸和苏氨酸的羟基
options.en: The hydroxyls of serine and threonine

options.zh: 酪氨酸苯环上的羟基
组氨酸咪唑环上的氮

quiz.explain_zh: 丝氨酸与苏氨酸侧链上的羟基合计约占人细胞磷酸化位点的 98%。酪氨酸的酚羟基确实可以磷酸化，但只占百分之一二；组氨酸磷酸化主要见于细菌双组分系统，在真核中极不稳定；赖氨酸侧链的常见修饰是乙酰化和泛素化，不是磷酸化。
quiz.explain_en: Serine and threonine hydroxyls together carry about 98% of human phosphorylation sites. The tyrosine phenol hydroxyl genuinely can be phosphorylated but accounts for only a per cent or two; histidine phosphorylation belongs mainly to bacterial two-component systems and is highly unstable in eukaryotes; and the lysine side chain is typically acetylated or ubiquitinated rather than phosphorylated.

quiz.q_zh: 酶原 zymogen 转变为有活性的酶依靠的是什么？
quiz.q_en: What converts a zymogen into an active enzyme?

options.zh: 在羟基上加上一个磷酸基
options.en: Addition of a phosphate to a hydroxyl

options.zh: 在特定位点被蛋白水解切割
亚基之间形成新的二硫键
与别构效应物可逆地结合
options.en: Reversible binding of an allosteric effector

quiz.explain_zh: 酶原的激活是不可逆的有限蛋白水解：切开特定的肽键后，多肽才折叠成有活性的三级结构。二硫键在酶原阶段往往已经形成，并不是激活的开关；别构结合和磷酸化都是可逆的调节方式，调的是已经成熟的酶，不能把前体变成酶。
quiz.explain_en: Zymogen activation is irreversible limited proteolysis: only after specific peptide bonds are cut does the chain fold into an active tertiary structure. Disulfides are usually already present in the zymogen and are not the switch; allosteric binding and phosphorylation are both reversible ways of tuning an already mature enzyme and cannot turn a precursor into one.

title_zh: 同工酶与脂溶性维生素 A/D/E/K 回顾
title_en: Isozymes, then a review of fat-soluble vitamins A/D/E/K

points.zh: 同工酶 isozyme 的判定只看功能：不管两个酶来自相同还是不同组织，也不管一级结构差别大不大，只要催化相同或相似的化学反应，就算同工酶。
points.en: An isozyme is defined by function only: regardless of whether the two enzymes come from the same or different tissues, and regardless of how much their primary structure differs, if they catalyse the same or a similar reaction they count as isozymes.

points.zh: 最典型的例子是乳酸脱氢酶 lactate dehydrogenase (LDH)，它有 5 种同工酶，在人体不同组织中分布不同，但发挥的功能类似。
points.en: The classic example is lactate dehydrogenase (LDH), which has 5 isozymes distributed differently across human tissues while performing a similar function.

points.zh: 脂溶性维生素 fat-soluble vitamins 一共只有四个：A、D、E、K，老师说这点比较好记。
points.en: There are only four fat-soluble vitamins — A, D, E, K — which the lecturer notes is easy to remember.

points.zh: 维生素 A 脂溶性很强；课上说它位于视网膜的基底细胞里，以一个「辅助细胞」的形式捕获光；在血浆中与维生素 A 结合蛋白 retinol-binding protein 结合后运输。
points.en: Vitamin A is strongly lipid-soluble; the lecture places it in "basal cells" of the retina acting as a "helper cell" that captures light, and says it travels in plasma bound to retinol-binding protein.

points.zh: 维生素 D：课上说它是胆固醇 cholesterol 的前体，再被催化一步就变成胆固醇；光照下皮肤细胞能产生一点点维生素 D；主要作用是帮助钙、磷元素吸收，所以钙片常做成维生素 D 与钙的复合物。
points.en: Vitamin D: the lecture calls it a precursor of cholesterol, one catalytic step away from becoming cholesterol; skin cells make a little of it under sunlight; its main job is to aid calcium and phosphate absorption, which is why calcium tablets are often a vitamin D plus calcium combination.

points.zh: 维生素 E 的中文名是生育酚 tocopherol，最主要的作用是抗氧化 antioxidant。
points.en: Vitamin E is called tocopherol; its main role is as an antioxidant.

points.zh: 维生素 K 叫凝血维生素，课上说它「可以作为凝血酶原 prothrombin 的一个合成」；它是唯一可以作为辅酶 coenzyme 的脂溶性维生素。
points.en: Vitamin K is the "clotting vitamin"; the lecture says it "serves as a synthesis of prothrombin", and calls it the only fat-soluble vitamin that can act as a coenzyme.

points.zh: 维生素 K 作为辅酶的功能是「上一个羧基 carboxyl，或者理解为上一个二氧化碳 CO₂」——因为人体内羧基的主要来源就是 CO₂ 溶于水形成的碳酸。
points.en: As a coenzyme, vitamin K "adds a carboxyl group, or if you like, adds a CO₂" — because in the body carboxyl groups come mainly from CO₂ dissolving in water as carbonic acid.

extra.zh: 维生素 D 与胆固醇的先后顺序讲反了。胆固醇在前：皮肤中的胆固醇前体 7-脱氢胆固醇 7-dehydrocholesterol 吸收 UV-B，B 环断开生成前维生素 D3，异构化为胆钙化醇 cholecalciferol (D3)，再经肝的 25-羟化和肾的 1α-羟化生成活性形式骨化三醇 calcitriol。维生素 D 是断环甾体 secosteroid（一个环被打开的甾体），这正是它的环数与胆固醇四个环不同的原因。
extra.en: The order of vitamin D and cholesterol is reversed. Cholesterol comes first: 7-dehydrocholesterol, a cholesterol precursor in skin, absorbs UV-B, its B ring opens to give previtamin D3, which isomerises to cholecalciferol (D3); 25-hydroxylation in liver and 1α-hydroxylation in kidney then give the active calcitriol. Vitamin D is a secosteroid — a steroid with one ring opened — which is exactly why its ring count differs from cholesterol's four.

extra.zh: 维生素 A 不是「视网膜基底细胞里的一个辅助细胞」。视色素位于视杆细胞 rods 和视锥细胞 cones 的外节 outer segment；11-顺-视黄醛 11-cis-retinal 是视紫红质 rhodopsin 内部的发色团 chromophore，是一个小分子而不是一种细胞。光照使它异构为全反式视黄醛，触发信号转导。同样的口误在第 5 讲也出现过。
extra.en: Vitamin A is not "a helper cell in the basal layer of the retina". Visual pigment sits in the outer segments of the rods and cones; 11-cis-retinal is a chromophore inside rhodopsin — a small molecule, not a cell. Light isomerises it to all-trans-retinal, triggering signalling. The same slip appeared in lecture 5.

extra.zh: 维生素 K 的作用说得不完整。它是 γ-谷氨酸羧化酶 γ-glutamyl carboxylase 的辅因子，把凝血酶原和因子 VII、IX、X 上的谷氨酸残基羧化成 γ-羧基谷氨酸 Gla，使这些因子能螯合 Ca²⁺ 并结合磷脂膜。华法林 warfarin 抑制维生素 K 环氧化物还原酶 VKOR，正是打断这一步。
extra.en: The vitamin K statement is incomplete rather than false. It is the cofactor for γ-glutamyl carboxylase, which converts glutamate residues in prothrombin and factors VII, IX and X into γ-carboxyglutamate (Gla), letting them chelate Ca²⁺ and bind phospholipid membranes. Warfarin blocks vitamin K epoxide reductase (VKOR), cutting exactly this step.

extra.zh: LDH 的 5 种同工酶来自两种亚基 H (LDH-B) 和 M (LDH-A) 组成的四聚体：H₄ (LDH-1) 到 M₄ (LDH-5) 共 5 种组合。LDH-1 以心肌为主，LDH-5 以肝和骨骼肌为主，因此血清同工酶谱可用于组织定位。
extra.en: The five LDH isozymes are tetramers built from two subunit types, H (LDH-B) and M (LDH-A): H₄ (LDH-1) through M₄ (LDH-5), five combinations. LDH-1 predominates in heart, LDH-5 in liver and skeletal muscle, so the serum isozyme pattern can localise tissue damage.

quiz.q_zh: 判定两个酶是否为同工酶，依据是什么？
quiz.q_en: What decides whether two enzymes are isozymes?

options.zh: 催化相同或相似的化学反应
options.en: They catalyse the same or a similar reaction

options.zh: 具有完全相同的一级结构
options.en: They have exactly the same primary structure

options.zh: 必须来自同一种组织器官
options.en: They must come from the same one tissue

options.zh: 必须由同一个基因编码
options.en: They must be encoded by the same one gene

quiz.explain_zh: 同工酶按催化功能定义。一级结构相同、组织来源相同、同一基因编码这三项都不是要求——同工酶恰恰常由不同基因编码、一级结构不同，如 LDH 的 H 与 M 亚基。
quiz.explain_en: Isozymes are defined by catalytic function. Identical primary structure, a shared tissue and a shared gene are all not required — isozymes are typically encoded by different genes with different sequences, as with the H and M subunits of LDH.

quiz.q_zh: 四种脂溶性维生素中，哪一种可以作为辅酶？
quiz.q_en: Which of the four fat-soluble vitamins can act as a coenzyme?

options.zh: 维生素 A vitamin A
维生素 D vitamin D
维生素 E vitamin E
维生素 K vitamin K

quiz.explain_zh: 维生素 K 是 γ-谷氨酸羧化酶的辅因子，是唯一有辅酶功能的脂溶性维生素。维生素 A 作为视黄醛是发色团，维生素 D 的活性形式是激素，维生素 E 是脂相抗氧化剂，都不催化反应。
quiz.explain_en: Vitamin K is the cofactor for γ-glutamyl carboxylase, the only fat-soluble vitamin with a coenzyme role. Vitamin A acts as a chromophore (retinal), active vitamin D acts as a hormone, and vitamin E is a lipid-phase antioxidant — none of them serve catalysis.

quiz.q_zh: 皮肤在日光下生成维生素 D3 的正确途径是？
quiz.q_en: What is the correct route by which skin makes vitamin D3 in sunlight?

options.zh: 胆固醇经肾脏羟化生成维生素 D3
options.en: Cholesterol hydroxylated in kidney gives vitamin D3

options.zh: 角鲨烯经 UV-B 照射生成维生素 D3
options.en: Squalene irradiated with UV-B gives vitamin D3

options.zh: 7-脱氢胆固醇经 UV-B 生成维生素 D3
维生素 D 经进一步催化生成胆固醇
options.en: Vitamin D under further catalysis gives cholesterol

quiz.explain_zh: 顺序是胆固醇合成通路在前：7-脱氢胆固醇 → 前维生素 D3 → D3，再经肝 25-羟化、肾 1α-羟化成骨化三醇。「维生素 D 变成胆固醇」把方向弄反了；肾脏只做 1α-羟化而不合成 D3；角鲨烯是更上游的胆固醇合成中间体，不直接感光。
quiz.explain_en: The cholesterol pathway comes first: 7-dehydrocholesterol → previtamin D3 → D3, then 25-hydroxylation in liver and 1α-hydroxylation in kidney to calcitriol. "Vitamin D becomes cholesterol" reverses the direction; the kidney only performs 1α-hydroxylation and does not make D3; squalene is a much earlier cholesterol-synthesis intermediate and is not photoreactive here.

title_zh: 辅酶与辅基的区别（课上讲反了）
title_en: Coenzyme vs prosthetic group — the lecture inverts it

points.zh: 辅酶 coenzyme 和辅基 prosthetic group 的共同点：两者都是帮助酶催化化学反应的物质。
points.en: What coenzymes and prosthetic groups share: both are substances that help an enzyme catalyse its reaction.

points.zh: 课上先说「辅酶是结合得比较紧密」，随即自己改口「也不能说比较」，说明这句话是脱口而出的。
points.en: The lecture first says "a coenzyme binds fairly tightly", then immediately hedges "well, not exactly" — a sign the sentence slipped out.

points.zh: 他接着的解释是对的：辅酶一般可以不在酶的活性中心 active site，只是帮助这个酶进行催化反应，不一定非常紧密地结合到酶上。
points.en: His follow-up explanation is correct: a coenzyme generally need not sit in the active site, it merely assists the catalytic reaction, and it need not bind the enzyme tightly.

points.zh: 课上给出一个可操作的判据：能通过透析 dialysis、用滤膜去除的东西，可以在一定程度上称为辅酶。
points.en: The lecture offers a workable operational test: anything that can be removed by dialysis through a membrane can to a degree be called a coenzyme.

points.zh: 辅基一般结合得更紧密，而且通常就在酶的活性中心，例如活性中心里结合 ATP 的 Ca²⁺、Mg²⁺ 这类离子。
points.en: A prosthetic group generally binds more tightly and usually sits right in the active site — for example the Ca²⁺ or Mg²⁺ ions that bind ATP there.

points.zh: 辅基不太容易去除，而且一旦去除，酶马上失去活性或直接变构，因为辅基是真正负责催化反应的部分；辅酶只是帮助催化。
points.en: A prosthetic group is hard to remove, and once removed the enzyme immediately loses activity or changes conformation, because the prosthetic group is what actually performs catalysis; a coenzyme only assists it.

points.zh: 老师给的记忆简化：把辅基狭义地理解成一些金属离子就 OK 了，因为大多数辅基都是这类物种。
points.en: The lecturer's memory shortcut: just treat prosthetic groups narrowly as metal ions, since most of them are that sort of species.

points.zh: 他指出水溶性维生素这一节里有非常多的物质都可以作为辅酶存在——这是接下来整节课的主线。
points.en: He notes that a great many of the water-soluble vitamins coming up act as coenzymes — the thread running through the rest of the lecture.

extra.zh: 「辅酶是结合得比较紧密」把两者讲反了，而且这是他上一讲已经弄错过一次的地方。标准区分是：辅酶 coenzyme 结合疏松，可以透析除去（NAD⁺、CoA、THF）；辅基 prosthetic group 结合紧密甚至共价相连（血红素 heme、琥珀酸脱氢酶中的 FAD、生物素 biotin）。两者都属于辅因子 cofactor。他在 00:27:37 到 00:28:40 之间的展开是对的——只有那一句反了。
extra.en: "A coenzyme binds fairly tightly" inverts the two, and it is the same error he made in the previous lecture. The standard contrast: a coenzyme binds loosely and can be removed by dialysis (NAD⁺, CoA, THF); a prosthetic group binds tightly or covalently (heme, the FAD of succinate dehydrogenase, biotin). Both are cofactors. His expansion from 00:27:37 to 00:28:40 is correct — only that one sentence is inverted.

extra.zh: 「辅基就是金属离子」这个简化会误事。血红素、琥珀酸脱氢酶中与组氨酸共价相连的 FAD、通过酰胺键连在赖氨酸上的生物素、以席夫碱结合的磷酸吡哆醛 PLP，都是有机辅基。金属离子在教材中通常单列为金属辅因子 metal cofactor，与有机小分子辅因子并列。
extra.en: The shortcut "prosthetic groups are metal ions" will cost marks. Heme, the FAD covalently bound to a histidine in succinate dehydrogenase, the biotin amide-linked to a lysine, and Schiff-base-bound pyridoxal phosphate (PLP) are all organic prosthetic groups. Metal ions are usually listed separately as metal cofactors, alongside the small-molecule organic cofactors.

extra.zh: 配套概念：全酶 holoenzyme = 脱辅基酶蛋白 apoenzyme + 辅因子 cofactor。单独的 apoenzyme 没有催化活性，单独的辅因子也没有；只有全酶有活性。这是考卷上最常问的填空式关系。
extra.en: The companion definitions: holoenzyme = apoenzyme + cofactor. The apoenzyme alone is inactive, the cofactor alone is inactive; only the holoenzyme has activity. This is the relationship exams ask for most often.

extra.zh: 两个教科书式对照：琥珀酸脱氢酶的 FAD 与酶的组氨酸残基共价相连，是典型辅基；而脱氢酶中的 NAD⁺ 每催化一轮就解离一次、在细胞内自由扩散，是典型辅酶——它更像共底物 co-substrate，因为反应中它本身被化学改变（NAD⁺→NADH）后离开。
extra.en: Two textbook contrasts: the FAD of succinate dehydrogenase is covalently attached to a histidine residue — the archetypal prosthetic group; the NAD⁺ of a dehydrogenase dissociates every catalytic cycle and diffuses freely — the archetypal coenzyme, and really a co-substrate, since it is itself chemically changed (NAD⁺→NADH) and leaves.

quiz.q_zh: 关于辅酶与辅基的结合方式，哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about how coenzymes and prosthetic groups bind is correct?

options.zh: 辅酶与辅基都紧密结合，均不可透析
options.en: Both bind tightly and neither can be dialysed off

options.zh: 辅酶与辅基都疏松结合，均可以透析
options.en: Both bind loosely and either can be dialysed off

options.zh: 辅酶结合疏松可透析，辅基结合紧密
options.en: Coenzyme binds loosely and dialyses off, prosthetic group binds tightly

options.zh: 辅基结合疏松可透析，辅酶结合紧密
options.en: Prosthetic group binds loosely and dialyses off, coenzyme binds tightly

quiz.explain_zh: 辅酶结合疏松、可透析除去（NAD⁺、CoA）；辅基结合紧密或共价（血红素、琥珀酸脱氢酶的 FAD、生物素）。「辅基疏松、辅酶紧密」正是课上讲反的版本；说两者都紧密或都疏松则抹掉了这一对概念存在的意义。
quiz.explain_en: Coenzymes bind loosely and can be dialysed away (NAD⁺, CoA); prosthetic groups bind tightly or covalently (heme, the FAD of succinate dehydrogenase, biotin). "Prosthetic loose, coenzyme tight" is exactly the inverted version given in the lecture; saying both are tight, or both loose, erases the whole point of the pair of terms.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一种是典型的辅基 prosthetic group？
quiz.q_en: Which of these is a typical prosthetic group?

options.zh: 脱氢酶反应中的 NAD⁺
脂肪酸代谢中的辅酶 A
options.en: The coenzyme A of fatty acid metabolism

options.zh: 一碳代谢中的四氢叶酸 THF
血红蛋白中的血红素 heme

quiz.explain_zh: 血红素通过配位和疏水口袋牢固嵌在蛋白内，不能透析除去，是典型辅基。NAD⁺、辅酶 A、四氢叶酸都在反应中结合又解离、可透析除去，属于辅酶。
quiz.explain_en: Heme is locked into the protein by coordination and a hydrophobic pocket and cannot be dialysed away — the archetypal prosthetic group. NAD⁺, coenzyme A and tetrahydrofolate all bind and dissociate during turnover and can be dialysed away, making them coenzymes.

title_zh: B 族维生素的命名由来与编号空缺
title_en: How the B vitamins got their names, and why numbers are missing

points.zh: 水溶性维生素 water-soluble vitamins 很多，老师说「有十来种」，所以要一种一种慢慢看。
points.en: There are many water-soluble vitamins — "a dozen or so", the lecturer says — so they are covered one at a time.

points.zh: 维生素的字母命名其实是按发现时间的早晚定的：发现越早的叫维生素 A，越晚的依次叫 B、C、D、E、F。
points.en: The letter names were assigned by date of discovery: the earliest found was called vitamin A, then B, C, D, E, F in turn.

points.zh: 早期好几个人几乎同时发现了「溶于水、对人的生存必需」的一类物质，都以为发现的是同一种东西，都把它命名为维生素 B。
points.en: Early on several people independently found a class of substances that were water-soluble and essential for survival, each assuming it was the same one thing, and each named it vitamin B.

points.zh: 直到化学鉴定手段提高，人们才知道这几个人发现的其实是不一样的物质，于是才有了 B1、B2、B几 这样的编号。
points.en: Only when chemical identification improved did it become clear these were different substances, which is how the B1, B2, B-something numbering arose.

points.zh: 维生素的定义：人体不能合成、并且对生命又很重要的一类物质才叫维生素。
points.en: The working definition given: a vitamin is something the body cannot synthesise and that is nonetheless important for life.

points.zh: 为什么 B3、B4、B5 这些编号「没有」：早期有些物质被当作维生素编了号，后来研究发现人体可以合成它们，或者它们对生存并非必需，就被从维生素里踢出去了，编号因此空缺。
points.en: Why numbers like B3, B4 and B5 seem to be missing: substances were numbered as vitamins early on, then later research showed the body can make them, or that they are not essential, so they were struck off the list and their numbers were left vacant.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: B3 和 B5 并不是空号。B3 就是烟酸 niacin，也就是这节课后面讲的维生素 PP；B5 就是泛酸 pantothenic acid，后面也会讲到。中文教材习惯用 PP、泛酸这些名字，所以听起来像是编号被跳过了。真正被除名的例子是 B4（腺嘌呤）、B8（肌醇）、B10、B11 等。
extra.en: B3 and B5 are not vacant. B3 is niacin — the vitamin PP taught later in this same lecture — and B5 is pantothenic acid, also covered later. Chinese textbooks favour the names PP and pantothenic acid, which is why the numbers sound skipped. The genuinely de-listed cases are B4 (adenine), B8 (inositol), B10 and B11.

extra.zh: 考试用的完整定义：维生素是维持机体正常生理功能所必需的一类小分子有机化合物，体内不能合成或合成量不足，必须由食物供给；既不供能，也不构成组织，主要以辅酶或辅基的形式参与代谢调节。「不供能、不构成组织」这两条是与糖、脂、蛋白质区分开的关键。
extra.en: The full exam definition: vitamins are small organic compounds required for normal physiological function that the body cannot synthesise, or cannot synthesise in sufficient amount, and must obtain from food; they neither supply energy nor build tissue, acting mainly as coenzymes or prosthetic groups in metabolic regulation. "No energy, no structure" is what separates them from carbohydrate, lipid and protein.

extra.zh: 「人体不能合成」是相对的。维生素 D 皮肤能自己合成，严格说更像激素前体；维生素 K 和生物素有相当一部分由肠道菌群提供，所以单纯膳食缺乏很少见，长期广谱抗生素或肠道手术后才容易出问题；烟酸可以由色氨酸部分转化而来。
extra.en: "The body cannot synthesise it" is relative. Vitamin D is made in skin and is strictly closer to a hormone precursor; a large share of vitamin K and biotin comes from gut flora, so pure dietary deficiency is rare and usually follows prolonged broad-spectrum antibiotics or bowel surgery; and niacin can be made in part from tryptophan.

quiz.q_zh: 维生素用 A、B、C、D 等字母命名，依据是什么？
quiz.q_en: On what basis were vitamins given the letters A, B, C, D?

options.zh: 被发现的时间先后顺序
options.en: The order in which they were discovered

options.zh: 分子量由小到大的顺序
options.en: The order of molecular weight, small to large

options.zh: 在水中溶解度高低的顺序
options.en: The order of their solubility in water

options.zh: 每日需要量由多到少排序
options.en: The order of daily requirement, high to low

quiz.explain_zh: 字母按发现年代先后依次给出，与化学性质无关——这正是为什么脂溶性的 A、D、E、K 和水溶性的 B、C 在字母上完全混在一起。分子量、溶解度和需要量都不曾用作命名依据。
quiz.explain_en: The letters follow the chronology of discovery and carry no chemical meaning — which is exactly why the fat-soluble A, D, E, K and the water-soluble B, C are interleaved in the alphabet. Molecular weight, solubility and daily requirement were never used for naming.

quiz.q_zh: B 族维生素的编号出现空缺，主要原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why are there gaps in the numbering of the B vitamins?

options.zh: 部分编号按分子量大小重新排过
options.en: Some numbers were reassigned by molecular weight

options.zh: 部分编号只用于标注脂溶性维生素
options.en: Some numbers are used only for fat-soluble ones

options.zh: 部分曾编号的物质后来被除名
options.en: Some numbered substances were later struck off

options.zh: 部分编号留给尚未发现的维生素
options.en: Some numbers were reserved for undiscovered ones

quiz.explain_zh: 早期编号的一些物质后来被证明人体能自行合成或并非必需，不符合维生素定义而被除名，如 B4（腺嘌呤）、B8（肌醇），编号就此空出。没有为未发现者预留编号，也从未按分子量重排；脂溶性维生素用的是字母而非 B 族编号。
quiz.explain_en: Some early-numbered substances turned out to be synthesisable by the body or non-essential, failed the definition and were removed — B4 (adenine), B8 (inositol) — leaving their numbers empty. Numbers were never reserved for undiscovered vitamins, never reassigned by molecular weight, and the fat-soluble vitamins use letters rather than B-series numbers.

title_zh: 维生素 B1（硫胺素）、TPP 与脚气病
title_en: Vitamin B1 (thiamine), TPP and beriberi

points.zh: 维生素 B1 最出名的名字是抗脚气病维生素 anti-beriberi vitamin，通用名叫硫胺素 thiamine——因为分子上有一个硫 S 和一个胺基 amine。
points.en: Vitamin B1 is best known as the anti-beriberi vitamin, and its common name is thiamine, because the molecule carries a sulfur and an amine group.

points.zh: 老师说具体某种维生素长什么样不必强记，但每一种水溶性维生素能发挥什么作用要记一下。
points.en: The lecturer says you need not memorise what each vitamin looks like, but you should remember what each water-soluble vitamin does.

points.zh: 在人体内 B1 通常以焦磷酸硫胺素 thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP) 的形式存在：T 是硫胺素，两个 P 就是焦磷酸 pyrophosphate。
points.en: In the body B1 exists mainly as thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP): the T is thiamine, the two P's are the pyrophosphate.

points.zh: TPP 作为辅酶最大的功能是转移二碳单位 two-carbon unit——可以给某物加两个碳原子，也可以减两个碳原子。
points.en: As a coenzyme, TPP's main job is transferring a two-carbon unit — it can add two carbons to something or take two away.

points.zh: 课上做的对比：维生素 K 是往上加一个羧基（一个碳），焦磷酸硫胺素则是转移两个碳原子。
points.en: The comparison drawn in class: vitamin K adds a carboxyl (one carbon), while thiamine pyrophosphate moves two carbons.

points.zh: B1 参与糖代谢过程中的关键环节。如果糖代谢不足、糖不能及时被代谢掉，人体就会走生成酮体 ketone bodies 的其他途径。
points.en: B1 takes part in a key step of carbohydrate metabolism. If sugar cannot be metabolised in time, the body diverts to other routes such as making ketone bodies.

points.zh: 糖尿病病人本身对糖的利用就不够，吃太多糖或太多肉都可能出现酮症酸中毒 ketoacidosis：生成的酮体没有被有效利用，在体内累积太多。
points.en: Diabetic patients already use glucose poorly, and eating too much sugar or too much meat can bring on ketoacidosis: the ketone bodies made are not used efficiently and build up.

points.zh: 酮体积累后病人身上会有特殊气味，因为酮类化合物扩散很快，特别是丙酮 acetone；课上把这种气味说成是尿毒症患者身上的味道。
points.en: The build-up gives the patient a characteristic smell because ketones diffuse readily, especially acetone; the lecture attributes this odour to uraemic patients.

points.zh: 脚气病 beriberi 的历史例子：当年日军军粮全部用去掉了米的「麸质」的精米，而维生素 B1 在其中含量较多，加上蔬菜吃得不够，长期就出现脚气病。
points.en: The historical example of beriberi: Japanese army rations used rice with the "gluten" milled away, which is where vitamin B1 is concentrated, and with too few vegetables besides, beriberi followed over time.

extra.zh: 那股甜甜的、像洗甲水的丙酮味属于酮症酸中毒 ketoacidosis（糖尿病性或饥饿性），不是尿毒症。尿毒症 uraemia 患者呼气是氨味或鱼腥味，来自唾液中尿素被细菌分解成氨。两种气味在临床上分属完全不同的代谢紊乱，考试常拿来对比。
extra.en: That sweet, nail-polish-remover smell belongs to ketoacidosis (diabetic or starvation), not uraemia. Uraemic breath smells of ammonia or fish, from bacterial breakdown of salivary urea. The two odours mark entirely different metabolic derangements and are a standard exam contrast.

extra.zh: 「麸质」是 gluten（面筋蛋白），大米基本不含。硫胺素集中在米糠和胚芽 bran and germ 里，把糙米精磨成白米正是把这部分磨掉了——这才是精米流行之后脚气病随之流行的原因。
extra.en: 麸质 means gluten, which rice essentially lacks. Thiamine sits in the bran and germ (米糠/麸皮), and polishing brown rice into white rice removes exactly that layer — which is why beriberi spread along with milled rice.

extra.zh: TPP 的具体反应要能点名：α-酮酸的氧化脱羧（丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体的 E1、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶复合体、支链 α-酮酸脱氢酶）和磷酸戊糖途径中的转酮醇酶 transketolase——后者转移的正是二碳单位。缺乏时丙酮酸和乳酸堆积，临床表现为湿性脚气病（心衰、水肿）、干性脚气病（周围神经炎）和 Wernicke-Korsakoff 综合征。
extra.en: Name TPP's actual reactions: oxidative decarboxylation of α-keto acids (E1 of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, the α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase complex, branched-chain α-keto acid dehydrogenase) and transketolase in the pentose phosphate pathway — which is the reaction that literally moves a two-carbon unit. Deficiency lets pyruvate and lactate accumulate, presenting as wet beriberi (heart failure, oedema), dry beriberi (peripheral neuropathy) and Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome.

extra.zh: 中文的「脚气病 beriberi」（维生素 B1 缺乏）和日常说的「脚气」（足癣 tinea pedis，真菌感染）完全是两回事，只是名字撞车。英文考卷上前者是 beriberi，后者是 athlete's foot。
extra.en: Chinese 脚气病 (beriberi, thiamine deficiency) and everyday 脚气 (tinea pedis, a fungal infection) are entirely unrelated conditions that merely collide in name. On an English paper the first is beriberi, the second athlete's foot.

quiz.q_zh: 焦磷酸硫胺素 TPP 作为辅酶的核心功能是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the core coenzyme function of thiamine pyrophosphate (TPP)?

options.zh: 转移一碳单位，参与嘌呤环合成
options.en: Transferring one-carbon units, purine ring synthesis

options.zh: 转移氨基，参与氨基酸转氨反应
options.en: Transferring amino groups, amino acid transamination

options.zh: 转移羧基，参与丙酮酸羧化反应
转移二碳单位，α-酮酸氧化脱羧
options.en: Transferring two-carbon units, α-keto acid decarboxylation

quiz.explain_zh: TPP 负责二碳单位转移和 α-酮酸的氧化脱羧（丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体、转酮醇酶）。一碳单位转移是四氢叶酸 THF 的工作，转氨是磷酸吡哆醛 PLP 的工作，羧化则由生物素 biotin 承担。
quiz.explain_en: TPP handles two-carbon transfer and oxidative decarboxylation of α-keto acids (pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, transketolase). One-carbon transfer is tetrahydrofolate's job, transamination is pyridoxal phosphate's, and carboxylation is biotin's.

quiz.q_zh: 以精米为主食容易导致脚气病，营养学上的原因是？
quiz.q_en: Why does a diet based on polished rice tend to cause beriberi?

options.zh: 精磨降低了大米淀粉的消化吸收率
options.en: Milling lowers the digestibility of the rice starch

options.zh: 精磨去掉了富含硫胺素的米糠层
options.en: Milling strips off the thiamine-rich bran layer

options.zh: 精磨破坏了大米中的必需氨基酸
options.en: Milling destroys the essential amino acids in rice

options.zh: 精磨使大米中的脂肪酸氧化变质
options.en: Milling makes the fatty acids in rice go rancid

quiz.explain_zh: 硫胺素集中在米糠和胚芽中，精磨成白米时被一并磨掉。必需氨基酸并未因精磨被破坏，脂肪酸氧化只影响风味和保质期，而精磨反而略微提高而非降低淀粉的消化率——三者都不造成脚气病。
quiz.explain_en: Thiamine is concentrated in the bran and germ, both of which are removed when brown rice is polished to white. Milling does not destroy essential amino acids, fat rancidity affects only flavour and shelf life, and polishing if anything slightly raises rather than lowers starch digestibility — none of these produce beriberi.

quiz.q_zh: 糖尿病酮症酸中毒患者呼气带甜味，主要来自哪种物质？
quiz.q_en: The sweet breath of diabetic ketoacidosis comes mainly from which substance?

options.zh: 丙酮 acetone
氨 ammonia
乙醇 ethanol
硫化氢 hydrogen sulfide

quiz.explain_zh: 三种酮体中乙酰乙酸可自发脱羧生成丙酮，丙酮挥发性高、从肺呼出，形成甜味或洗甲水味。氨味见于尿毒症和肝性脑病，乙醇味来自饮酒，硫化氢是腐败气味，都不是酮症酸中毒的标志。
quiz.explain_en: Of the three ketone bodies, acetoacetate spontaneously decarboxylates to acetone, which is volatile and exhaled through the lungs, giving the sweet, nail-polish odour. Ammonia breath points to uraemia or hepatic encephalopathy, ethanol to drinking, and hydrogen sulfide to putrefaction — none marks ketoacidosis.

title_zh: 维生素 B2（核黄素）与 FMN / FAD
title_en: Vitamin B2 (riboflavin) and FMN / FAD

points.zh: 维生素 B2 叫核黄素 riboflavin，比 B1 常见得多，是很重要的一个维生素。
points.en: Vitamin B2 is riboflavin, far more familiar than B1 and a genuinely important vitamin.

points.zh: 老师给出重要性排序：脂溶性维生素整体没那么重要，只有维生素 D 稍重要一点；水溶性维生素里第一个重要的就是维生素 B2。
points.en: The lecturer ranks them: the fat-soluble vitamins matter less overall, with only vitamin D standing out a little; among the water-soluble ones the first important entry is vitamin B2.

points.zh: 药店里能买到单卖的维 B2，也能买到复合维生素 B；里面主要显黄色的就是核黄素，因为这个小分子本身就是特别的荧光黄色。
points.en: Pharmacies sell B2 on its own and as a B-complex; the strong yellow in it is riboflavin, because the molecule itself is a distinctive fluorescent yellow.

points.zh: B2 在人体内主要以 FMN 和 FAD 两种形式存在，两者都算维生素 B2 的存在形式。
points.en: In the body B2 exists mainly as FMN and FAD; both count as forms of vitamin B2.

points.zh: 结构拆解（课上讲法）：下面是那个三元的环，加上核糖醇 ribitol（一个五碳糖）、再加一个磷酸，这个东西叫 FMN。
points.en: The structure as taught: the "three-ring" system at the bottom, plus ribitol (a five-carbon sugar), plus one phosphate — that assembly is FMN.

points.zh: FMN 再接上一个腺苷单磷酸 AMP（也就是那个 A，含磷酸），就叫 FAD；FMN 与 FAD 唯一的区别就是 FAD 多了这个腺苷。
points.en: Adding one adenosine monophosphate (the "A", phosphate included) onto FMN gives FAD; the only difference between FMN and FAD is that extra adenosine.

points.zh: 功能：FMN 和 FAD 可以接受两个氢原子，是动态生化里传递氢原子非常重要的中间体；一分子 FMN 或 FAD 接受两个氢原子，这一点记住就行。
points.en: Function: FMN and FAD each accept two hydrogen atoms, making them crucial hydrogen-carrying intermediates in metabolic biochemistry; one molecule of FMN or FAD takes two hydrogen atoms — that is the point to remember.

points.zh: 在三羧酸循环 TCA cycle 和各种代谢里提到氢原子被传递出来时，课上说主要就是「FMN 和 NAD」这两个东西发挥作用。
points.en: When hydrogen transfer comes up in the TCA cycle and other pathways, the lecture says it is mainly "FMN and NAD" doing the work.

extra.zh: 总结那句「主要就是 FMN 和 NAD 这两个东西发挥作用」与他自己正在讲的图不一致——图上讲的是 FMN 和 FAD。NAD⁺ 是维生素 PP（烟酸）的衍生物，属于下一段的内容，而且它传递的是氢负离子而不是氢原子。
extra.en: The summary line "it is mainly FMN and NAD doing the work" does not match the slide he is describing, which shows FMN and FAD. NAD⁺ derives from vitamin PP (niacin), belongs to the next section, and carries a hydride rather than hydrogen atoms.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 两处口头简化值得校正：核心环叫异咯嗪环 isoalloxazine，是三个稠合环组成的环系，不是「三元环」（three-membered ring 指只有三个原子的环）；核糖醇 ribitol 是核糖被还原后的开链糖醇 sugar alcohol，不再是环状五碳糖，这也是黄素与核苷酸的关键结构差别。
extra.en: Two spoken shortcuts worth fixing: the core ring is isoalloxazine, a system of three fused rings, not a "three-membered ring" (which would mean a ring of only three atoms); and ribitol is the open-chain sugar alcohol obtained by reducing ribose, no longer a cyclic pentose — which is the key structural difference between a flavin and a nucleotide.

extra.zh: 两种氢载体的化学配平要分清：FAD + 2H（即 2H⁺ + 2e⁻）→ FADH₂，接受的是两个完整的氢原子；NAD⁺ + 2H → NADH + H⁺，接受的是一个氢负离子 hydride（H⁻ = 1 个质子 + 2 个电子），多出的那个质子释放到介质中。黄素还能停在半还原态 FADH·，因此可以在双电子供体与单电子受体（如呼吸链的铁硫簇）之间做转换。
extra.en: Balance the two hydrogen carriers correctly: FAD + 2H (that is, 2H⁺ + 2e⁻) → FADH₂, taking two complete hydrogen atoms; NAD⁺ + 2H → NADH + H⁺, taking a hydride (H⁻ = one proton plus two electrons) with the spare proton released to the medium. Flavins can also rest in the半-reduced FADH· state, which is why they can bridge two-electron donors and one-electron acceptors such as the respiratory chain's iron-sulfur clusters.

extra.zh: FAD/FMN 是典型的辅基，不是辅酶——琥珀酸脱氢酶（复合体 II）中的 FAD 与酶的组氨酸残基共价相连，全程不解离。核黄素缺乏的典型临床表现是口角炎、唇炎、舌炎和阴囊皮炎；补充 B2 后尿液呈亮黄色是正常的排泄现象。
extra.en: FAD/FMN are prosthetic groups rather than coenzymes — the FAD of succinate dehydrogenase (complex II) is covalently attached to a histidine residue and never dissociates. Riboflavin deficiency classically presents as angular stomatitis, cheilitis, glossitis and scrotal dermatitis; the bright yellow urine after a B2 supplement is normal excretion.

quiz.q_zh: FAD 与 FMN 在结构上的唯一区别是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the only structural difference between FAD and FMN?

options.zh: FAD 比 FMN 多一个烟酰胺基团
options.en: FAD has one nicotinamide group more than FMN

options.zh: FAD 比 FMN 多一个腺苷单磷酸
options.en: FAD has one adenosine monophosphate more

options.zh: FAD 比 FMN 多一个核糖醇基团
options.en: FAD has one ribitol group more than FMN

options.zh: FAD 比 FMN 多一个异咯嗪环系
options.en: FAD has one isoalloxazine ring system more

quiz.explain_zh: FMN 是核黄素的 5'-磷酸酯，再通过焦磷酸键接上一个 AMP 就成为 FAD——名字里的 A 就是这个腺苷。核糖醇和异咯嗪环两者都各有一份，烟酰胺则属于 NAD⁺ 而不属于黄素。
quiz.explain_en: FMN is riboflavin 5'-phosphate; attaching one AMP through a pyrophosphate bond makes FAD — the A in the name is that adenosine. Ribitol and the isoalloxazine ring are present once in each, and nicotinamide belongs to NAD⁺, not to flavins.

quiz.q_zh: FAD 与 NAD⁺ 接受还原当量的方式，哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which describes how FAD and NAD⁺ accept reducing equivalents?

options.zh: FAD 接受 1 个氢负离子，NAD⁺ 接受 2 个氢原子
options.en: FAD takes 1 hydride, NAD⁺ takes 2 hydrogen atoms

options.zh: 两者都接受 2 个氢原子，生成 FADH₂ 与 NADH₂
options.en: Both take 2 hydrogen atoms, giving FADH₂ and NADH₂

options.zh: 两者都接受 1 个氢负离子，生成 FADH 与 NADH
options.en: Both take 1 hydride, giving FADH and NADH

options.zh: FAD 接受 2 个氢原子，NAD⁺ 接受 1 个氢负离子
options.en: FAD takes 2 hydrogen atoms, NAD⁺ takes 1 hydride

quiz.explain_zh: FAD + 2H → FADH₂；NAD⁺ + 2H → NADH + H⁺，只有氢负离子加到烟酰胺环上，多出的质子进入介质。把两者对调是常见错误；「NADH₂」这一写法不存在，正因为 NAD 只收一个氢负离子。
quiz.explain_en: FAD + 2H → FADH₂; NAD⁺ + 2H → NADH + H⁺, where only the hydride adds to the nicotinamide ring and the extra proton goes into the medium. Swapping the two is the common error, and the form "NADH₂" does not exist precisely because NAD accepts only a hydride.

quiz.q_zh: 核黄素（维生素 B2）缺乏最典型的临床表现是？
quiz.q_en: What is the classic clinical picture of riboflavin (B2) deficiency?

options.zh: 周围神经炎、心力衰竭
口角炎、舌炎、阴囊皮炎
夜盲症、干眼症、角膜软化
牙龈出血、伤口经久不愈
options.en: Bleeding gums, wounds that fail to heal

quiz.explain_zh: 口角炎、舌炎、阴囊皮炎是核黄素缺乏的经典三联征。夜盲和角膜软化属维生素 A 缺乏，牙龈出血和伤口不愈属维生素 C 缺乏（坏血病），周围神经炎和心衰属维生素 B1 缺乏（干性与湿性脚气病）。
quiz.explain_en: Angular stomatitis, glossitis and scrotal dermatitis are the classic riboflavin triad. Night blindness and keratomalacia mark vitamin A deficiency, bleeding gums and poor wound healing mark vitamin C deficiency (scurvy), and neuropathy with heart failure marks thiamine deficiency (dry and wet beriberi).

title_zh: 维生素 B6（PLP）与维生素 B12（钴胺素）
title_en: Vitamin B6 (PLP) and vitamin B12 (cobalamin)

points.zh: 维生素 B6 结构上是一个小小的、单独的一个环，属于比较小的一类维生素；课上评价它没有维 B2 重要。
points.en: Vitamin B6 is structurally just a small single ring, one of the smaller vitamins; the lecture rates it as less important than B2.

points.zh: B6 有三种可以互相转变的形式：吡哆醛 pyridoxal、吡哆醇 pyridoxine、吡哆胺 pyridoxamine，统称为维生素 B6。
points.en: B6 comes in three interconvertible forms — pyridoxal, pyridoxine and pyridoxamine — collectively called vitamin B6.

points.zh: 最主要的活性形式是磷酸吡哆醛 pyridoxal phosphate (PLP)。
points.en: The principal active form is pyridoxal phosphate (PLP).

points.zh: PLP 也是一种辅酶，它催化的作用是脱去羧基 decarboxylation 和转氨基 transamination。
points.en: PLP too is a coenzyme; the reactions it serves are decarboxylation and transamination.

points.zh: 老师的应试建议：B6 提得很少，记住它也能作为一种辅酶就行；重点是记住哪几种维生素可以作为辅酶。
points.en: The lecturer's exam advice: B6 comes up rarely, so just remember that it too works as a coenzyme; what matters is knowing which vitamins act as coenzymes.

points.zh: 维生素 B12 的名字叫钴胺素 cobalamin。
points.en: Vitamin B12 is named cobalamin.

points.zh: 课上说 B12 的结构「很眼熟、有点像血红蛋白」，就是把血红蛋白里的二价铁离子换成了三价的钴离子。
points.en: The lecture calls the B12 structure "familiar-looking, rather like haemoglobin", describing it as haemoglobin with the divalent iron swapped for trivalent cobalt.

points.zh: 钴之所以是人体的微量元素 trace element，就是因为维 B12 里带有这个钴离子。
points.en: Cobalt counts as a human trace element precisely because vitamin B12 carries that cobalt ion.

points.zh: 钴胺素也是一种辅酶，可以参与很多不同的酶的催化作用；具体催化哪些反应，课上认为不用记。
points.en: Cobalamin is also a coenzyme taking part in many different enzymes' catalysis; which reactions exactly, the lecture treats as not worth memorising.

extra.zh: B12 不是「血红蛋白换个金属」。首先血红蛋白 haemoglobin 是蛋白质，它的辅基才是血红素 heme；其次 B12 建在咕啉环 corrin ring 上，不是卟啉环 porphyrin——咕啉比卟啉少一个桥碳且更还原。钴还带一个上位轴向配体：氰钴胺 cyanocobalamin 是 CN⁻，体内活性形式是 5'-脱氧腺苷或甲基。他想说的结构相似性是真的，但不是同一种东西。
extra.en: B12 is not "haemoglobin with a different metal". Haemoglobin is the protein and heme is its prosthetic group; and B12 is built on a corrin ring, not a porphyrin — corrin has one fewer bridging carbon and is more reduced. The cobalt also carries an upper axial ligand: CN⁻ in cyanocobalamin, 5'-deoxyadenosyl or methyl in the active forms. The structural resemblance he is reaching for is real, but the two are not the same thing.

extra.zh: 人体内依赖 B12 的酶其实只有两个，值得直接背下来：甲硫氨酸合酶 methionine synthase（用甲钴胺，把同型半胱氨酸甲基化成甲硫氨酸，与叶酸循环偶联）和甲基丙二酰-CoA 变位酶 methylmalonyl-CoA mutase（用 5'-脱氧腺苷钴胺）。缺乏时出现巨幼细胞贫血 megaloblastic anaemia 加脊髓亚急性联合变性；吸收需要胃壁细胞分泌的内因子 intrinsic factor，缺内因子即恶性贫血 pernicious anaemia。
extra.en: Only two human enzymes depend on B12, and they are worth memorising outright: methionine synthase (methylcobalamin; methylates homocysteine to methionine, coupled to the folate cycle) and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase (5'-deoxyadenosylcobalamin). Deficiency gives megaloblastic anaemia plus subacute combined degeneration of the cord; absorption requires intrinsic factor from gastric parietal cells, and its loss is pernicious anaemia.

extra.zh: PLP 远比课上说的重要，它是氨基酸代谢的核心辅酶。它的醛基与酶活性中心赖氨酸形成席夫碱 Schiff base（内醛亚胺），底物氨基酸取代后形成外醛亚胺，吡啶环作为电子阱稳定碳负离子中间体——转氨、脱羧、消旋、β/γ-消除全靠这一机制。ALT 和 AST 的辅酶正是 PLP。
extra.en: PLP matters far more than the lecture allows: it is the central coenzyme of amino acid metabolism. Its aldehyde forms a Schiff base (internal aldimine) with an active-site lysine, the substrate amino acid displaces it to give the external aldimine, and the pyridine ring acts as an electron sink stabilising the carbanion intermediate — the single mechanism behind transamination, decarboxylation, racemisation and β/γ-elimination. ALT and AST both run on PLP.

extra.zh: 临床关联：抗结核药异烟肼 isoniazid 与 PLP 结合成腙而拮抗维生素 B6，长期服用需常规补 B6 以预防周围神经炎。另一处易混：叶酸和 B12 缺乏都引起巨幼细胞贫血，但只有 B12 缺乏伴神经系统损害，单纯补叶酸会掩盖血象而放任神经损伤加重。
