extra.en: A clinical link: the antitubercular isoniazid forms a hydrazone with PLP and antagonises vitamin B6, so long courses are routinely supplemented with B6 to prevent peripheral neuropathy. Another trap: folate and B12 deficiency both give megaloblastic anaemia, but only B12 deficiency damages the nervous system, and folate alone corrects the blood picture while the neurological damage advances.

quiz.q_zh: 磷酸吡哆醛 PLP 作为辅酶催化的是哪一类反应？
quiz.q_en: Which class of reaction does pyridoxal phosphate (PLP) serve?

options.zh: 一碳单位的转移与嘌呤环合成
options.en: One-carbon transfer and purine ring construction

options.zh: 二氧化碳的固定与羧基化反应
options.en: Carbon dioxide fixation and carboxylation reactions

options.zh: 氨基酸的转氨基与脱羧基反应
options.en: Transamination and decarboxylation of amino acids

options.zh: α-酮酸的氧化脱羧与二碳转移

quiz.explain_zh: PLP 通过席夫碱机制催化转氨、脱羧、消旋等氨基酸反应。α-酮酸氧化脱羧和二碳转移是 TPP 的功能，一碳单位转移是四氢叶酸的功能，CO₂ 固定和羧化则由生物素承担。
quiz.explain_en: PLP catalyses transamination, decarboxylation and racemisation of amino acids through its Schiff-base mechanism. Oxidative decarboxylation of α-keto acids and two-carbon transfer belong to TPP, one-carbon transfer to tetrahydrofolate, and CO₂ fixation and carboxylation to biotin.

quiz.q_zh: 维生素 B12 分子中的金属及其所在环系是？
quiz.q_en: Which metal does vitamin B12 carry, and in what ring system?

options.zh: 铁离子，位于卟啉 porphyrin 环中心
options.en: An iron ion at the centre of a porphyrin ring

options.zh: 镁离子，位于卟啉 porphyrin 环中心
options.en: A magnesium ion at the centre of a porphyrin ring

options.zh: 钴离子，位于卟啉 porphyrin 环中心
options.en: A cobalt ion at the centre of a porphyrin ring

options.zh: 钴离子，位于咕啉 corrin 环中心
options.en: A cobalt ion at the centre of a corrin ring

quiz.explain_zh: B12 的钴位于咕啉环中心，咕啉比卟啉少一个桥碳且更还原。铁-卟啉是血红素，镁-卟啉是叶绿素；「钴-卟啉」正是课上把 B12 说成血红蛋白换金属时产生的混淆版本。
quiz.explain_en: The cobalt of B12 sits at the centre of a corrin ring, which has one fewer bridging carbon than porphyrin and is more reduced. Iron-porphyrin is heme and magnesium-porphyrin is chlorophyll; "cobalt-porphyrin" is exactly the hybrid produced by the lecture's description of B12 as haemoglobin with a swapped metal.

quiz.q_zh: 维生素 B6 的三种可互变形式是？
quiz.q_en: What are the three interconvertible forms of vitamin B6?

options.zh: 视黄醛、视黄醇、视黄酸
硫胺素、核黄素、烟酰胺
泛酸、生物素、叶酸
吡哆醛、吡哆醇、吡哆胺

quiz.explain_zh: 吡哆醛、吡哆醇、吡哆胺可相互转变，磷酸化后以磷酸吡哆醛为主要活性形式。视黄醛/醇/酸是维生素 A 的三种形式，构成极易混淆的平行结构；硫胺素等三者与泛酸等三者分别是不同的维生素，不是同一维生素的形式。
quiz.explain_en: Pyridoxal, pyridoxine and pyridoxamine interconvert, and once phosphorylated the dominant active form is pyridoxal phosphate. Retinal/retinol/retinoic acid form the deliberately parallel trio belonging to vitamin A, while the thiamine group and the pantothenate group are each sets of distinct vitamins rather than forms of one.

title_zh: 维生素 PP（NAD/NADP）、泛酸（辅酶A）与生物素
title_en: Vitamin PP (NAD/NADP), pantothenic acid (CoA) and biotin

points.zh: 水溶性维生素有十几种，但真正重要的就几种；第一个重要的是维 B2，第二个是维生素 PP——旧名维生素 B3，现在已经很少用 B3 这个名字了。
points.en: There are a dozen or so water-soluble vitamins but only a few that matter; the first is B2, the second vitamin PP — formerly vitamin B3, a name now rarely used.

points.zh: 维生素 PP 分子形式很简单，就是小小一坨，但它参与组成 NAD 和 NADP，这两个东西「可就太重要了」。
points.en: Vitamin PP is structurally very simple, just a small unit, but it goes into NAD and NADP, which are hugely important.

points.zh: NAD/NADP 的结构讲解：下边是一个腺苷 adenosine，然后是两坨磷酸，上面又连了一个核糖，这个核糖上连的就是那个小的维生素 PP。课上把这一半说成「右边这一坨是维生素 B2」。
points.en: The structure as walked through: an adenosine at the bottom, then two phosphates, then a ribose on top, and on that ribose sits the small vitamin PP. The lecture labels this half "the lump on the right is vitamin B2".

points.zh: 记忆要点：维生素 PP 是 NAD 和 NADP 很重要的组成部分；NAD 和 NADP 的作用是接受「一个氢/氢质子/氢原子」，别的作用不多。
points.en: The take-home: vitamin PP is a key component of NAD and NADP, whose role is to accept "one hydrogen / hydrogen proton / hydrogen atom", with little else to it.

points.zh: 泛酸 pantothenic acid：中文生化里带「泛」字的（泛酸、泛素 ubiquitin）都表示它在自然界各种生物中存在得很广泛。
points.en: Pantothenic acid: in Chinese biochemistry the character 泛 ("widespread") in pantothenate and ubiquitin marks how broadly the substance occurs across living things.

points.zh: 泛酸最重要的一点是它组成辅酶 A coenzyme A (CoA)，进一步形成乙酰辅酶 A acetyl-CoA；在脂质和糖类代谢那一章会反复提到。课上问答确认「泛酸的酸体现在焦磷酸上」。
points.en: The key fact about pantothenate is that it makes up coenzyme A (CoA), which goes on to form acetyl-CoA, recurring throughout the lipid and carbohydrate chapters. The Q&A concludes that "the acid in pantothenic acid is the pyrophosphate".

points.zh: 课上小结：讲过的六种水溶性维生素里最重要的只有三个——维 B2 构成 FMN/FAD，维生素 PP 构成 NAD/NADP，泛酸构成 CoA。
points.en: The recap: of the six water-soluble vitamins covered, only three really matter — B2 builds FMN/FAD, vitamin PP builds NAD/NADP, and pantothenate builds CoA.

points.zh: 生物素 biotin 早期叫维生素 B7，现在都直接叫 Biotin。它与「链霉素」的相互作用是人类发现的自然界最强的非共价相互作用：没有形成共价键，强度却达到皮摩尔 pM 到飞摩尔 fM 级；皮摩尔是纳摩尔往下 1000 倍，飞摩尔再往下 1000 倍，比常见抗体强 1000 到 10 万倍。
points.en: Biotin was once vitamin B7 and is now simply called biotin. Its interaction with "streptomycin" is described as the strongest non-covalent interaction known in nature: no covalent bond, yet picomolar to femtomolar in strength — pM being 1000-fold below nM and fM another 1000-fold below that, so 1000 to 100 000 times stronger than a typical antibody.

points.zh: 生物素作为维生素也是一种辅酶，参与二氧化碳的转移。课上总结的规律：很多维生素辅酶要么参与两个碳原子的转移，要么参与一个 CO₂ 与羧基之间的互变——都是几个原子的转移。
points.en: As a vitamin, biotin is also a coenzyme and takes part in CO₂ transfer. The pattern drawn in class: many vitamin coenzymes either move two carbons or shuttle a CO₂ into or out of a carboxyl group — all of them small-atom transfers.

extra.zh: 生物素的搭档是链霉亲和素 streptavidin，来自链霉菌 Streptomyces avidinii 的一种蛋白；链霉素 streptomycin 是氨基糖苷类抗生素，与此毫无关系。整段讲的飞摩尔级亲和力（Kd ≈ 10⁻¹⁴–10⁻¹⁵ M）正是 biotin–streptavidin 的。此外蛋清中的亲和素 avidin 也强结合生物素，长期大量生食蛋清可致生物素缺乏。
extra.en: Biotin's partner is streptavidin, a protein from Streptomyces avidinii; streptomycin is an aminoglycoside antibiotic and has nothing to do with it. The femtomolar affinity the whole passage rests on (Kd ≈ 10⁻¹⁴–10⁻¹⁵ M) is that of biotin–streptavidin. Avidin from egg white also binds biotin tightly, which is why eating large amounts of raw egg white can cause biotin deficiency.

extra.zh: 「右边这一坨是维生素 B2」说错了：他随后描述的腺苷 + 两个磷酸 + 核糖 + 烟酰胺，整体就是 NAD 本身，与核黄素无关。NAD⁺ 是烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸，由烟酰胺单核苷酸 NMN 与 AMP 通过焦磷酸键连成；NADP⁺ 只是在腺苷那一侧的核糖 2'-位多一个磷酸。
extra.en: "The lump on the right is vitamin B2" is wrong: the adenosine plus two phosphates plus ribose plus nicotinamide he then describes is NAD itself, with no riboflavin in it. NAD⁺ is nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, formed by joining nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) to AMP through a pyrophosphate bond; NADP⁺ differs only by one extra phosphate at the 2' position of the adenosine-side ribose.

extra.zh: 两处需要纠正。其一，泛酸的「酸」来自它自身的羧基 carboxyl group，不是焦磷酸；辅酶 A 中的焦磷酸来自分子里 ATP 的那一半，是组装 CoA 时才加上去的。其二，NAD⁺ 接受的是氢负离子 hydride（H⁻ = 1 个质子 + 2 个电子），同时有一个质子释放到介质，所以还原型写成 NADH + H⁺ 而不是「接受一个氢质子」。
extra.en: Two fixes. First, the acid in pantothenic acid is its own carboxyl group, not the pyrophosphate; the pyrophosphate in coenzyme A comes from the ATP half of the molecule and is added when CoA is assembled. Second, NAD⁺ accepts a hydride (H⁻ = one proton plus two electrons) while a second proton is released to the medium, which is why the reduced form is written NADH + H⁺ rather than "accepting a hydrogen proton".

extra.zh: NADH 与 NADPH 的分工要能说清：结构上只差腺苷侧核糖 2'-位的一个磷酸，功能上 NADH 主要走分解代谢、把电子交给呼吸链产 ATP，NADPH 主要供还原性合成（脂肪酸、胆固醇）和抗氧化（谷胱甘肽还原酶）。维生素 PP 缺乏导致糙皮病 pellagra，典型三 D：皮炎 dermatitis、腹泻 diarrhoea、痴呆 dementia；色氨酸可部分转化为烟酸，约 60 mg 色氨酸相当于 1 mg 烟酸。
extra.en: Be able to state the division of labour between NADH and NADPH: structurally they differ by one phosphate at the 2' position of the adenosine-side ribose, while functionally NADH runs catabolism and feeds electrons to the respiratory chain for ATP, and NADPH funds reductive synthesis (fatty acids, cholesterol) and antioxidant defence (glutathione reductase). Vitamin PP deficiency causes pellagra with the classic three D's — dermatitis, diarrhoea, dementia; tryptophan converts in part to niacin, roughly 60 mg tryptophan per 1 mg niacin.

quiz.q_zh: NAD⁺ 在脱氢反应中接受还原当量的确切形式是？
quiz.q_en: In a dehydrogenation, what exactly does NAD⁺ accept?

options.zh: 两个电子，同时结合两个游离质子
options.en: Two electrons, binding two free protons as well

options.zh: 一个氢负离子，同时释放一个质子
options.en: One hydride, with one proton released to the medium

options.zh: 两个氢原子，同时释放一个质子
options.en: Two hydrogen atoms, with one proton released

options.zh: 一个质子，同时释放一个自由电子
options.en: One proton, with one free electron released

quiz.explain_zh: NAD⁺ + 2H → NADH + H⁺：氢负离子 H⁻（1 个质子 + 2 个电子）加到烟酰胺环 C4 位上，另一个质子进入介质。接受两个完整氢原子的是 FAD（生成 FADH₂）；只接受质子或只接受电子都不能平衡该反应的电荷与质量。
quiz.explain_en: NAD⁺ + 2H → NADH + H⁺: a hydride (one proton, two electrons) adds to C4 of the nicotinamide ring while the other proton goes into the medium. Taking two whole hydrogen atoms is what FAD does, giving FADH₂; accepting only protons or only electrons balances neither the charge nor the mass of the reaction.

quiz.q_zh: 生物素被广泛用作分子生物学标签，是因为它与下列哪一种物质亲和力极强？
quiz.q_en: Biotin is a favourite molecular-biology tag because it binds which partner so tightly?

options.zh: 链球菌蛋白 G protein G
链霉亲和素 streptavidin
链霉素 streptomycin
链霉蛋白酶 pronase

quiz.explain_zh: 生物素与链霉亲和素的 Kd 约 10⁻¹⁴–10⁻¹⁵ M，是已知最强的非共价相互作用之一。链霉素是氨基糖苷类抗生素，链霉蛋白酶是广谱蛋白酶混合物，链球菌蛋白 G 结合的是抗体 Fc 段——三者都不结合生物素，只是名字里同样带「链」字。
quiz.explain_en: Biotin binds streptavidin with a Kd of about 10⁻¹⁴–10⁻¹⁵ M, among the strongest non-covalent interactions known. Streptomycin is an aminoglycoside antibiotic, pronase a broad-spectrum protease mixture, and protein G binds the Fc region of antibodies — none of them binds biotin, and they merely share the same prefix.

quiz.q_zh: 泛酸在体内最主要的生化作用是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is pantothenic acid's chief biochemical role in the body?

options.zh: 构成辅酶 A，转移酰基
options.en: Building coenzyme A, which carries acyl groups

options.zh: 构成 FAD，传递氢原子
options.en: Building FAD, which carries hydrogen atoms

options.zh: 构成 NAD⁺，传递氢负离子
options.en: Building NAD⁺, which carries hydride ions

options.zh: 构成四氢叶酸，转移一碳单位
options.en: Building tetrahydrofolate, which carries one carbon

quiz.explain_zh: 泛酸是辅酶 A 的组成部分，CoA 的巯基以硫酯键携带酰基，乙酰 CoA 是糖、脂、氨基酸代谢的共同节点。FAD 由核黄素（B2）构成，NAD⁺ 由维生素 PP 构成，四氢叶酸由叶酸构成。
quiz.explain_en: Pantothenate is the building block of coenzyme A, whose thiol carries acyl groups as thioesters, with acetyl-CoA the common node of carbohydrate, lipid and amino acid metabolism. FAD is built from riboflavin (B2), NAD⁺ from vitamin PP, and tetrahydrofolate from folate.

title_zh: 生物素与 Strep 标签：链霉亲和素亲和层析的由来
title_en: Biotin and the Strep-tag: where streptavidin affinity chromatography comes from

points.zh: 生物素 biotin（维生素 B7 / 维生素 H）的辅酶作用是参与羧化反应，转移 CO2 / 羧基；它以共价方式连在羧化酶的赖氨酸 lysine 侧链上。
points.en: Biotin (vitamin B7 / vitamin H) works as a coenzyme in carboxylation, transferring CO2 / a carboxyl group; it is covalently attached to a lysine side chain of the carboxylase.

points.zh: 老师总结的规律：许多水溶性维生素的辅酶作用都是搬运很小的基团——一碳单位 one-carbon unit、二碳单位 two-carbon unit、或 CO2。
points.en: The teacher's rule of thumb: most water-soluble vitamins act as coenzymes that shuttle very small groups — one-carbon units, two-carbon units, or CO2.

points.zh: 生物素作为维生素本身临床意义不大（缺乏罕见）；它今天的分量来自 biotin–链霉亲和素 streptavidin 这一对结合在实验室里的用途。
points.en: Biotin matters little as a vitamin in the clinic (deficiency is rare); its importance today comes from what the biotin–streptavidin pair is used for in the lab.

points.zh: biotin–streptavidin 比一般非共价相互作用强上千倍到十万倍，是自然界已知最强的非共价相互作用之一，强到接近共价键的实用效果。
points.en: Biotin–streptavidin is a thousand to a hundred thousand times tighter than ordinary non-covalent interactions — one of the strongest known in nature, effectively as good as covalent in practice.

points.zh: 人们据此设计了 Strep-tag：一段 8 个氨基酸的多肽（Strep-tag II，序列 WSHPQFEK），空间构象模仿生物素，因此也能结合链霉亲和素。
points.en: The Strep-tag was designed from this: an 8-amino-acid peptide (Strep-tag II, WSHPQFEK) whose spatial arrangement mimics biotin, so it too binds streptavidin.

points.zh: Strep-tag 的亲和力远不如生物素本身，但已足够做亲和层析——而且正因为没有生物素那么强，蛋白才洗脱得下来。
points.en: The Strep-tag binds far more weakly than biotin itself, but tightly enough for affinity chromatography — and precisely because it is weaker than biotin, the protein can be eluted at all.

points.zh: 现代蛋白纯化用得最多的两种亲和层析：his-tag 与镍离子 Ni2+ 配位，Strep-tag 与链霉亲和素结合。
points.en: The two affinity-chromatography methods used most in modern protein purification: his-tag coordinating Ni2+, and Strep-tag binding streptavidin.

points.zh: Strep-tag 只有 8 个氨基酸，和 his-tag 一样小，因此很多时候不必再用蛋白酶把它切掉。
points.en: The Strep-tag is only 8 residues, as small as a his-tag, so it often need not be cleaved off at all.

extra.zh: 考试要能点名生物素依赖的羧化酶：丙酮酸羧化酶 pyruvate carboxylase、乙酰辅酶A羧化酶 acetyl-CoA carboxylase、丙酰辅酶A羧化酶 propionyl-CoA carboxylase。反应耗 ATP，先生成 carboxybiotin 中间体，再把 CO2 交给底物。
extra.en: Name the biotin-dependent carboxylases in an exam: pyruvate carboxylase, acetyl-CoA carboxylase, propionyl-CoA carboxylase. The reaction costs ATP, forms a carboxybiotin intermediate, then hands CO2 to the substrate.

extra.zh: biotin–streptavidin 的 Kd 在飞摩尔 femtomolar 量级（10^-14 M 上下）；Strep-tag II 对 Strep-Tactin 只有微摩尔 micromolar 量级，相差好几个数量级。这个数量级差正是标签能被温和洗脱、而生物素几乎洗不掉的原因。
extra.en: Biotin–streptavidin has a Kd in the femtomolar range (around 10^-14 M); Strep-tag II on Strep-Tactin is only micromolar — several orders of magnitude weaker. That gap is exactly why the tag can be eluted gently while biotin essentially cannot.

extra.zh: 实际操作里 Strep 柱不是用高盐或低 pH 洗脱，而是用 desthiobiotin 脱硫生物素竞争洗脱（温和，蛋白保持活性），再用过量 biotin 或 HABA 把柱子再生。这是这类柱子的标准工作循环。
extra.en: In practice a Strep column is not eluted with high salt or low pH but by competition with desthiobiotin (gentle, protein stays active), then regenerated with excess biotin or HABA. That is the standard cycle for these columns.

quiz.q_zh: 在亲和纯化中，生物素高亲和力结合的搭档蛋白是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: In affinity purification, which protein is biotin's high-affinity partner?

options.zh: 链霉素 streptomycin
链霉亲和素 streptavidin
钙调蛋白 calmodulin
葡萄球菌蛋白A protein A

quiz.explain_zh: 链霉亲和素来自 Streptomyces avidinii，与生物素的 Kd 在飞摩尔量级，是整个方法的基础。链霉素是氨基糖苷类抗生素，名字像但完全无关；calmodulin 和 protein A 都是别的亲和标签体系的配体。
quiz.explain_en: Streptavidin, from Streptomyces avidinii, binds biotin with femtomolar Kd — the basis of the whole method. Streptomycin is an aminoglycoside antibiotic, similar name but unrelated; calmodulin and protein A are ligands for entirely different affinity systems.

quiz.q_zh: 生物素作为辅酶转移的是哪一类基团？
quiz.q_en: Which group does biotin transfer as a coenzyme?

options.zh: 酰基 acyl group
氢负离子 hydride
二氧化碳 CO2 / 羧基
一碳单位 one-carbon unit

quiz.explain_zh: 生物素是羧化酶的辅酶，转移 CO2。一碳单位由四氢叶酸 THF 携带，酰基由辅酶A CoA 携带，氢负离子由 NAD+ / FAD 接受——三者都是别的辅酶的活。
quiz.explain_en: Biotin is the coenzyme of carboxylases and carries CO2. One-carbon units are carried by tetrahydrofolate, acyl groups by coenzyme A, hydride by NAD+/FAD — each the job of a different coenzyme.

quiz.q_zh: Strep-tag 能结合链霉亲和素，是因为它？
quiz.q_en: The Strep-tag binds streptavidin because it?

options.zh: 被细胞在体内共价生物素化
options.en: gets covalently biotinylated in the cell

options.zh: 与链霉亲和素形成二硫键
options.en: forms a disulfide bond with streptavidin

options.zh: 带大量负电荷吸引链霉亲和素
options.en: carries a strong negative charge that attracts it

options.zh: 空间构象模仿了生物素分子
options.en: mimics the spatial shape of biotin

quiz.explain_zh: Strep-tag 是人工设计的 8 肽，它占据链霉亲和素上原本结合生物素的口袋，靠的是形状模拟，不是被生物素化、也不是共价或静电作用。真正被酶促生物素化的是另一套标签（AviTag / BCCP）。
quiz.explain_en: The Strep-tag is a designed 8-mer that occupies streptavidin's biotin pocket by shape mimicry — not by being biotinylated, and not through covalent or electrostatic bonding. Enzymatic biotinylation belongs to a different tag system (AviTag / BCCP).

title_zh: 实验室对话：Strep-tag 与 his-tag 的特异性和回收率之争
title_en: Lab talk: Strep-tag versus his-tag — specificity and recovery

points.zh: his-tag 纯化常见的问题是 SDS-PAGE 上一堆杂带：天然蛋白表面本来就散布着 2–4 个组氨酸的簇，也能和镍离子结合，属于非特异结合。
points.en: The usual problem with his-tag purification is a smear of extra bands on SDS-PAGE: native proteins carry surface clusters of two to four histidines that bind Ni2+ non-specifically.

points.zh: Strep-tag 只和链霉亲和素高特异性结合，一步洗脱下来往往就是干干净净的一条带。
points.en: The Strep-tag binds only streptavidin, and with high specificity, so a single elution often gives one clean band.

points.zh: 课上给出的常规原核纯化流程：过镍柱（his-tag）→ SUMO protease 切除标签 → 再过 SEC 分子筛精修。
points.en: The routine prokaryotic workflow given in class: Ni column (his-tag) → SUMO protease cleavage → SEC polishing.

points.zh: SUMO protease 切得很干净，不留任何残基，这是这条流程受欢迎的原因之一。
points.en: SUMO protease cuts cleanly and leaves no residual residues, one reason this workflow is popular.

points.zh: 大肠杆菌 E. coli 等原核体系里 his-tag 还算够用；真核体系（昆虫细胞、哺乳细胞）杂蛋白种类多得多，非特异结合更严重。
points.en: In prokaryotic systems such as E. coli the his-tag is good enough; in eukaryotic systems (insect, mammalian cells) there are far more host proteins and non-specific binding is much worse.

points.zh: 真核分泌表达要处理的体积很大——两升培养上清要全部过柱，上样时间长。
points.en: Secreted eukaryotic expression means large volumes — two litres of supernatant all have to pass over the column, which takes a long loading run.

points.zh: his-tag 结合不够紧，先结合上去的蛋白会被后面 1.9 升液体持续冲洗掉，回收率明显下降（老师的比喻：100 mL 的蛋白最后只剩 10 mL）。
points.en: The his-tag does not hold tightly enough: protein bound early is washed off by the remaining 1.9 litres, so recovery drops badly (his image: what was 100 mL of protein ends up as 10 mL).

points.zh: Strep-tag 结合极强，上柱后很难被冲掉，所以真核大体积纯化里很多人改用 Strep-tag。
points.en: The Strep-tag binds so tightly that it is hard to wash off, which is why many people switch to it for large-volume eukaryotic preps.

extra.zh: his-tag 与 Ni-NTA 是配位（螯合）结合，用咪唑 imidazole 竞争洗脱——咪唑就是组氨酸的侧链环。由此推出实验规矩：上样缓冲液不能含 EDTA（会把镍螯走）、不能含高浓度 DTT / β-巯基乙醇（会还原树脂），这是老师默认你知道的前提。
extra.en: The his-tag binds Ni-NTA by coordination (chelation) and is eluted by competition with imidazole — which is simply the histidine side-chain ring. Hence the bench rules the teacher assumes: no EDTA in the loading buffer (it strips the nickel) and no high DTT / β-mercaptoethanol (it reduces the resin).

extra.zh: SUMO protease（Ulp1）识别的是 SUMO 结构域的三维折叠，不是一段线性序列，切点固定在 SUMO 的 Gly-Gly 之后。所以切完得到的是天然 N 端、不留疤痕，而且 SUMO 融合本身还能促溶——这是它比 TEV / 3C 位点更受欢迎的原因。
extra.en: SUMO protease (Ulp1) recognises the folded SUMO domain, not a linear sequence, and always cuts right after SUMO's Gly-Gly. The product therefore has a native N-terminus with no scar, and the SUMO fusion also improves solubility — why it is often preferred over TEV or 3C sites.

extra.zh: 「特异性高」和「亲和力强」是两件事：特异性说的是有多少杂蛋白也被抓住，亲和力说的是抓住以后解离得多慢。Strep-tag 两样都好，但结合太强反过来带来洗脱和柱子再生的代价。
extra.en: High specificity and high affinity are different things: specificity is how many host proteins are also captured, affinity is how slowly what is captured falls off. The Strep-tag scores well on both, but its very tight binding is what makes elution and column regeneration costly.

quiz.q_zh: his-tag 纯化的洗脱产物在 SDS-PAGE 上出现大量杂带，最主要的原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why does a his-tag elution usually show many extra bands on SDS-PAGE?

options.zh: his 标签在柱子上被镍催化水解断裂
options.en: the his-tag is hydrolysed on the column by nickel

options.zh: 咪唑洗脱时与宿主蛋白共价交联
宿主蛋白表面的组氨酸簇也结合镍离子
options.en: host proteins' surface histidine clusters also bind Ni2+

options.zh: 镍离子把目的蛋白氧化成多种形式
options.en: Ni2+ oxidises the target protein into several forms

quiz.explain_zh: 两三个连续组氨酸就足以和 Ni-NTA 产生可观的弱结合，宿主蛋白组里这样的表面组氨酸簇很常见，属于非特异结合，这是 his-tag 特异性不如 Strep-tag 的根本原因。咪唑只做竞争洗脱，不与蛋白成键；镍在这些条件下也不催化蛋白氧化或水解。
quiz.explain_en: Two or three consecutive histidines already give appreciable weak binding to Ni-NTA, and such surface clusters are common in the host proteome — plain non-specific binding, and the root of the his-tag's lower specificity. Imidazole only competes for the site, it forms no bond with protein; nickel neither oxidises nor hydrolyses proteins under these conditions.

quiz.q_zh: 两升昆虫细胞上清过镍柱时 his-tag 回收率偏低，原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why is his-tag recovery poor when two litres of insect-cell supernatant are loaded on a Ni column?

options.zh: 上清中的盐浓度会使 his 标签解折叠
options.en: the salt in the supernatant unfolds the his-tag

options.zh: 结合较弱，后续大量液体持续冲洗使其解离
options.en: binding is weak, so the litres that follow wash it back off

options.zh: his 标签必须先由 SUMO protease 暴露
options.en: the his-tag must first be exposed by SUMO protease

options.zh: 镍离子只在 4 °C 才能结合组氨酸

quiz.explain_zh: 亲和层析的保留取决于解离速率：his-tag–Ni 的解离常数在微摩尔量级，上样一两升的时间尺度上先结合的蛋白会被后来的液体逐步冲下来。his 标签是柔性短肽，不存在被盐解折叠或需要蛋白酶「暴露」的问题，镍的配位结合也不依赖 4 °C。
quiz.explain_en: Retention in affinity chromatography is set by the off-rate: the his-tag–Ni interaction is micromolar, so over the hours it takes to load a litre or two, protein bound early is progressively washed off. The tag is a flexible short peptide that salt does not unfold and no protease needs to expose, and nickel coordination does not require 4 °C.

title_zh: 实验室对话：Strep 柱的损耗与成本，昆虫细胞纯化选哪种标签
title_en: Lab talk: Strep column wear and cost, and which tag to pick for insect cells

points.zh: Strep 柱的填料上包被的就是链霉亲和素蛋白本身（课上结构图里那个绿色的蛋白），它负责抓住生物素或 Strep-tag。
points.en: A Strep column's resin is coated with the streptavidin protein itself (the green protein in the structure shown), and that is what captures biotin or the Strep-tag.

points.zh: 缺点不在特异性，而在结合太强：每次洗脱都有一部分结合位点被「废掉」，柱子逐次失去结合力。
points.en: The drawback is not specificity but that binding is too tight: some binding sites are ruined at every elution and the column loses capacity run after run.

points.zh: 商品化的柱子（如 Cytiva 的）耐用一些；较差的生物素亲和柱可能用十次左右就完全报废。
points.en: Commercial columns (Cytiva's, for instance) hold up better; a cheaper biotin-affinity column may be dead after roughly ten runs.

points.zh: 因此 Strep 柱比镍柱贵得多，成本是它在实际选型时唯一真正的缺点。
points.en: Strep columns are therefore much more expensive than Ni columns, and cost is really their only practical disadvantage.

points.zh: 学生的实际问题：RdRP 是自己买还是自己表达；老师指出 RdRP 也可以在大肠杆菌里表达。
points.en: The student's practical question: buy RdRP or express it. The teacher notes RdRP can also be expressed in E. coli.

points.zh: 结论性建议：用昆虫细胞 insect cell 表达新冠蛋白，首推 Strep 标签纯化。
points.en: The bottom line: for expressing SARS-CoV-2 proteins in insect cells, the Strep tag is the first choice for purification.

extra.zh: 老师这里多次口头说成「链霉素」。生物素的搭档是链霉亲和素 streptavidin——来自 Streptomyces avidinii 的四聚体蛋白，与生物素的亲和力在飞摩尔量级，整个纯化方法就建立在这个亲和力上。链霉素 streptomycin 是氨基糖苷类抗生素，作用于细菌 30S 核糖体，与生物素毫无关系。答题时写错这两个字，判卷会当成概念错误。
extra.en: The teacher repeatedly says "streptomycin" aloud here. Biotin's partner is streptavidin — the tetrameric protein from Streptomyces avidinii whose femtomolar affinity for biotin the whole purification method rests on. Streptomycin is an aminoglycoside antibiotic acting on the bacterial 30S ribosome and has nothing to do with biotin. Confusing the two on an exam reads as a conceptual error, not a slip.

extra.zh: 市售柱子多用 Strep-Tactin——经过工程改造的链霉亲和素，对 Strep-tag II 的亲和力提高，而对 desthiobiotin 的结合可逆。这正是柱子能反复使用的关键：用 desthiobiotin 洗脱、用 HABA 或过量 biotin 再生。老师说的「用十次就废」多发生在用天然 streptavidin、且样品里含真正生物素的情况。
extra.en: Commercial columns mostly use Strep-Tactin — engineered streptavidin with higher affinity for Strep-tag II but reversible binding of desthiobiotin. That reversibility is what makes the column reusable: elute with desthiobiotin, regenerate with HABA or excess biotin. The "dead after ten runs" case mostly applies to native streptavidin resins and samples containing real biotin.

extra.zh: 实操里还有一个隐藏的坑：细胞裂解液中本来就有内源生物素化蛋白（各种羧化酶），以及培养基里的游离生物素，它们会不可逆地占掉位点。所以上样前常加 avidin / BioLock 把游离生物素封闭掉，这是保住柱子寿命的标准动作。
extra.en: One hidden pitfall at the bench: lysates already contain endogenous biotinylated proteins (the carboxylases) and free biotin from the medium, and these block sites irreversibly. Adding avidin / BioLock to quench free biotin before loading is the standard move that preserves column lifetime.

quiz.q_zh: Strep 亲和柱在实际使用中最主要的缺点是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the main practical drawback of a Strep affinity column?

options.zh: 只能在变性条件下结合目的蛋白
options.en: it only captures the target under denaturing conditions

options.zh: 洗脱必须用极低 pH，蛋白容易失活
options.en: elution needs very low pH, so the protein is often inactivated

options.zh: 结合位点易被占死，柱子昂贵且寿命有限
options.en: sites get blocked irreversibly; the column is costly and short-lived

options.zh: 特异性低，洗脱液中总有大量杂蛋白
options.en: low specificity, so eluates always carry many host proteins

quiz.explain_zh: Strep 柱的卖点恰恰是特异性高、条带干净，洗脱也是用 desthiobiotin 温和竞争，不需要低 pH，更不需要变性条件。它的问题只在于链霉亲和素结合太强，位点一旦被真生物素占住就放不开，柱子逐次损耗且价格高。
quiz.explain_en: High specificity and a clean single band are precisely the Strep column's selling points, and elution is a gentle desthiobiotin competition — no low pH, certainly no denaturation. Its only real problem is that streptavidin binds so tightly that a site once taken by real biotin never releases, so the expensive resin wears out.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一项正确描述了链霉亲和素 streptavidin？
quiz.q_en: Which statement correctly describes streptavidin?

options.zh: 一种氨基糖苷类抗生素，作用于 30S 核糖体
options.en: an aminoglycoside antibiotic acting on the 30S ribosome

options.zh: 一种链霉菌来源的蛋白，四聚体，紧密结合生物素
options.en: a tetrameric Streptomyces protein that binds biotin tightly

options.zh: 一种膜转运蛋白，负责把生物素运进细胞
options.en: a membrane transporter that imports biotin into cells

options.zh: 一种把生物素连到赖氨酸上的连接酶
options.en: a ligase that attaches biotin onto lysine residues

quiz.explain_zh: 链霉亲和素是 Streptomyces avidinii 分泌的四聚体蛋白，每个亚基一个生物素结合位点，Kd 在飞摩尔量级。氨基糖苷抗生素说的是名字相近的链霉素 streptomycin；把生物素共价连上赖氨酸的是 biotin ligase（BirA），也是另一回事。
quiz.explain_en: Streptavidin is a tetrameric protein secreted by Streptomyces avidinii, one biotin site per subunit, Kd in the femtomolar range. The aminoglycoside description belongs to the similarly named streptomycin; attaching biotin covalently to a lysine is the job of biotin ligase (BirA), a different thing again.

title_zh: 实验室对话：Twin-Strep 与 Strep-His-Strep 串联标签构建
title_en: Lab talk: Twin-Strep and the Strep-His-Strep tandem tag construct

points.zh: 老师分享的昆虫细胞表达构建套路（高福课题组常用）：Strep–linker–His–linker–Strep，后面可接可不接酶切位点或 SUMO，最后才是目的蛋白。
points.en: The construct the teacher shares for insect-cell expression (used in the Gao Fu lab): Strep–linker–His–linker–Strep, optionally followed by a protease site or SUMO, and only then the target protein.

points.zh: 第一代 Strep-tag 是单个 8 氨基酸序列；后来的 Twin-Strep-tag 含两段完全相同的重复。
points.en: The first-generation Strep-tag is a single 8-residue sequence; the later Twin-Strep-tag carries two identical repeats.

points.zh: 链霉亲和素是四聚体 tetramer，两段重复可以同时结合它的两个亚基，因此 Twin-Strep 的亲和力明显高于单个 Strep-tag。
points.en: Streptavidin is a tetramer, so the two repeats can occupy two of its subunits at once, giving Twin-Strep markedly higher affinity than a single Strep-tag.

points.zh: Twin-Strep-tag 是有商标（®）的商业设计序列，两段之间由 GS linker 相连。
points.en: Twin-Strep-tag is a trademarked commercial sequence, its two repeats joined by a GS linker.

points.zh: 该组的改动是在 GS linker 中间额外插入一个 6×His：linker 因此变长，反而更利于两端的 Strep 同时结合链霉亲和素。
points.en: The lab's modification inserts a 6xHis inside that GS linker: the linker gets longer, which actually helps both Strep ends engage streptavidin simultaneously.

points.zh: 顺带得到第二个正交标签：his-tag 与 Strep-tag 生物兼容，可以串联使用。
points.en: It also yields a second orthogonal handle: the his-tag and Strep-tag are compatible and can be used in series.

points.zh: 串联纯化的实际流程：先过镍柱，洗脱下来的可能只剩 10% 的总蛋白但含大部分目的蛋白，再过 Strep 柱，就能拿到非常干净的样品。
points.en: The tandem workflow in practice: run the Ni column first — the eluate may be only 10% of total protein but contains most of the target — then run it over the Strep column for a very clean sample.

points.zh: 这一策略专门针对 RdRP 这类多组分、难纯化的蛋白。
points.en: This strategy is aimed specifically at multi-component, hard-to-purify proteins such as RdRP.

extra.zh: Twin-Strep 亲和力提高的正式名称是亲合力效应 avidity（多价效应）：两个位点同时结合时，要完全脱落必须两处同时解离，表观解离速率因此大幅下降，表观 Kd 远小于单个位点的 Kd。抗体 IgM 的十价结合、以及多价配体设计走的都是同一个原理。
extra.en: The formal name for Twin-Strep's gain is avidity (multivalency): with two sites engaged, full release requires both to let go at once, so the apparent off-rate collapses and the apparent Kd is far below the single-site Kd. Decavalent IgM binding and multivalent ligand design exploit exactly the same principle.

extra.zh: 两端各带一个标签的串联纯化（tandem affinity purification, TAP）真正的价值不只是「更干净」：只有同时保留 N 端和 C 端标签的分子才能通过两轮，所以降解片段、提前终止的产物会在第二轮被丢掉。这对易碎的多亚基复合物尤其关键。
extra.en: The real value of tandem affinity purification with a tag at each end is more than "cleaner": only molecules that still carry both the N- and C-terminal tag survive two rounds, so degradation fragments and prematurely terminated products drop out at the second column. That matters most for fragile multi-subunit complexes.

extra.zh: GS linker 指的是 (GGGGS)n 这类甘氨酸-丝氨酸重复：柔性大、亲水、几乎没有二级结构倾向，也不易被蛋白酶识别。它的作用是把标签从蛋白表面「支」出去，避免空间位阻——所以老师说 linker 变长反而结合更好，是有结构道理的。
extra.en: A GS linker means a (GGGGS)n glycine-serine repeat: flexible, hydrophilic, with essentially no secondary-structure propensity and few protease sites. Its job is to hold the tag away from the protein surface and avoid steric hindrance — which is why the teacher's observation that a longer linker binds better is structurally sensible.

quiz.q_zh: Twin-Strep-tag 的亲和力高于单个 Strep-tag，原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why does a Twin-Strep-tag bind more tightly than a single Strep-tag?

options.zh: 重复序列被磷酸化后结合口袋变紧
options.en: phosphorylation of the repeat tightens the binding pocket

options.zh: 重复序列使标签带上更多的正电荷
options.en: the repeat gives the tag extra positive charge

options.zh: 两段重复可同时结合四聚体的两个亚基
options.en: the two repeats engage two subunits of the tetramer at once

options.zh: 两段重复分别结合镍离子和链霉亲和素
options.en: the two repeats bind nickel and streptavidin respectively

quiz.explain_zh: 链霉亲和素是四聚体，四个亚基各有一个结合口袋。Twin-Strep 的两段重复可同时占据相邻两个口袋，这种多价结合（avidity）使表观解离速率大幅下降。标签的电荷和磷酸化都与之无关，结合镍离子的是构建中另外插入的 his-tag。
quiz.explain_en: Streptavidin is a tetramer with a pocket in each subunit. The two Twin-Strep repeats can occupy two neighbouring pockets simultaneously, and this multivalent (avidity) binding collapses the apparent off-rate. Charge and phosphorylation play no part, and nickel is bound by the separate his-tag inserted in the construct.

quiz.q_zh: 先过镍柱再过 Strep 柱的串联纯化，为什么能得到更均一的样品？
quiz.q_en: Why does running a Ni column and then a Strep column give a more homogeneous sample?

options.zh: 第二次结合会促使目的蛋白重新正确折叠
options.en: the second binding step refolds the target protein correctly

options.zh: 只有同时保留两个标签的完整分子能通过两轮
options.en: only intact molecules keeping both tags survive both rounds

options.zh: 两种树脂孔径不同，按分子量互补分离
options.en: the two resins differ in pore size and separate by mass

options.zh: 第二根柱子顺便把缓冲液的盐浓度降下来
options.en: the second column also lowers the buffer's salt concentration

quiz.explain_zh: 两个标签放在分子的两端时，串联纯化实际上是在做一次完整性筛选：断裂或提前终止的产物只保留一个标签，会在第二根柱子上丢掉。亲和层析不依据孔径分离（那是 SEC），也不改变折叠状态，脱盐要另做缓冲液置换。
quiz.explain_en: With a tag at each end, tandem purification is effectively an integrity filter: truncated or prematurely terminated products keep only one tag and are lost at the second column. Affinity chromatography does not separate by pore size (that is SEC) and does not refold anything; desalting requires a separate buffer exchange.

title_zh: 实验室对话：RdRP 多亚基复合物纯化与昆虫/哺乳表达系统
title_en: Lab talk: purifying the multi-subunit RdRP complex, and insect versus mammalian expression

points.zh: 课上调出 SARS-CoV-2 RdRP 的结构：每种颜色是一条独立的多肽链 chain，要拿到有生物活性的酶必须把这些组分都凑齐。
points.en: The SARS-CoV-2 RdRP structure is pulled up in class: each colour is a separate polypeptide chain, and a biologically active enzyme needs all of these components together.

points.zh: 聚合酶折叠成右手掌形，可以分出 finger、palm、thumb 区，还带若干很小的肽段。
points.en: The polymerase folds into a right-hand shape with finger, palm and thumb subdomains, plus several very small peptide chains.

points.zh: 这类复杂复合物纯化时容易出现碎裂、断链的产物，单一标签往往拿到很杂的样品。
points.en: Complexes like this readily yield fragmented and truncated species, and a single tag usually gives a messy sample.

points.zh: SEC 并非万能：不是所有杂质都能靠分子筛分开，所以不能指望后面一步补救。
points.en: SEC is not a cure-all — it cannot separate every contaminant, so one should not count on it to rescue a bad prep.

points.zh: 做功能研究、尤其是结构研究，要求样品纯度高、均一性 homogeneity 好，因此多亚基组分一般用多标签联合纯化。
points.en: Functional and especially structural work demands high purity and good homogeneity, so multi-subunit assemblies are generally purified with combined tags.

points.zh: 老师的建议：先查文献里别人怎么构建，照着走——发表的构建是试过好几版之后才成的。
points.en: The teacher's advice: look up how others built the construct and copy it — a published construct is what survived after several failed versions.

points.zh: 昆虫细胞流程的关键一步：质粒在 DH5α 大肠杆菌里扩增成 bacmid 后，必须用去内毒素 endotoxin-free 试剂盒抽提，再转染昆虫细胞。
points.en: The key step in the insect-cell workflow: after amplifying the bacmid in DH5-alpha E. coli, it must be extracted with an endotoxin-free kit before transfecting insect cells.

points.zh: 昆虫细胞培养通常不加抗生素，所以污染是常态；学生反复感染失败，可能就是没用去内毒素试剂盒加上操作污染。
points.en: Insect-cell culture is usually run without antibiotics, so contamination is routine; the student's repeated failed infections may come from skipping the endotoxin-free kit plus handling contamination.

points.zh: 昆虫细胞被形容为「神秘」：细胞状态不好时蛋白折叠会出问题，同样操作两批蛋白分子量能差 10 kD；周期约一个月。替代方案是哺乳细胞表达，国内有专门公司提供细胞系与 protocol。
points.en: Insect cells are described as "mysterious": if the cells are unhappy the protein misfolds, and two batches run identically can differ by 10 kD in mass; a round takes about a month. The alternative is mammalian expression, with companies supplying cell lines and protocols.

extra.zh: 冠状病毒的最小活性聚合酶复合物是 nsp12（催化核心，右手掌折叠，另有 N 端 NiRAN 结构域）加辅因子 nsp7 和两拷贝 nsp8；nsp8 提供延伸所需的持续合成能力。这正是「多亚基、每条链都得有」的具体含义，也是 remdesivir 瑞德西韦作用的位置。
extra.en: The minimal active coronavirus polymerase is nsp12 (the catalytic core with its right-hand fold plus an N-terminal NiRAN domain) together with the cofactors nsp7 and two copies of nsp8; nsp8 supplies the processivity needed for extension. That is what "multi-subunit, every chain required" concretely means, and it is where remdesivir acts.

extra.zh: 为什么非用去内毒素试剂盒不可：常规碱裂解 miniprep 会带出大肠杆菌外膜的 LPS 内毒素，它对真核细胞有毒、显著压低转染效率。另一层原因是 bacmid 是超过 100 kb 的大分子，机械剪切就会打断，所以操作要轻柔、避免剧烈涡旋。
extra.en: Why the endotoxin-free kit is not optional: a routine alkaline-lysis miniprep carries over LPS endotoxin from the E. coli outer membrane, which is toxic to eukaryotic cells and sharply lowers transfection efficiency. A second reason is that the bacmid exceeds 100 kb and shears mechanically, so it must be handled gently without vigorous vortexing.

extra.zh: 批次间分子量差 10 kD 通常不是「神秘」，而是可查的原因：糖基化程度不同、宿主蛋白酶切掉了末端、或病毒传代过多导致表达盒缺失。昆虫细胞的 N-糖是寡甘露糖 / paucimannose 型，与哺乳细胞的复杂型糖链不同——这也是选哺乳体系做糖蛋白的真正理由。
extra.en: A 10 kD shift between batches is usually not mysterious but traceable: differing glycosylation, host proteases trimming the termini, or loss of the expression cassette after too many virus passages. Insect-cell N-glycans are paucimannose/high-mannose rather than the complex type made by mammalian cells — the real reason to choose a mammalian system for glycoproteins.

extra.zh: SEC 的分离依据是流体力学半径（Stokes 半径），而球形分子的半径大致随分子量的立方根变化。所以分子量差一两成时，体积差别小得多，几乎不可能基线分开——这就是老师说「SEC 不是万能的」的定量含义。
extra.en: SEC separates by hydrodynamic (Stokes) radius, and for a globular molecule that radius scales roughly with the cube root of mass. A ten or twenty per cent difference in mass therefore gives a much smaller difference in radius, and baseline separation is essentially impossible — the quantitative content of "SEC is not a cure-all".

quiz.q_zh: 转染昆虫细胞前必须用去内毒素试剂盒提取 bacmid，主要理由是什么？
quiz.q_en: Why must a bacmid be prepared with an endotoxin-free kit before transfecting insect cells?

options.zh: 内毒素会抑制杆状病毒基因组的复制
options.en: endotoxin blocks replication of the baculovirus genome

options.zh: 残留内毒素对真核细胞有毒并压低转染效率
options.en: residual endotoxin is toxic to eukaryotic cells and lowers transfection

options.zh: 内毒素会与 Strep 柱结合造成杂带
options.en: endotoxin binds the Strep column and creates extra bands

options.zh: 内毒素会使 bacmid 发生重组而丢失片段
options.en: endotoxin makes the bacmid recombine and lose segments

quiz.explain_zh: 内毒素就是大肠杆菌外膜的 LPS，常规质粒提取会大量带出。它对真核细胞有毒，直接表现为转染效率低、细胞状态差。它不参与病毒基因组复制，不结合亲和树脂，也不引起 DNA 重组。
quiz.explain_en: Endotoxin is the LPS of the E. coli outer membrane and comes along in bulk with a routine plasmid prep. It is toxic to eukaryotic cells, showing up directly as poor transfection and unhealthy cultures. It plays no part in viral genome replication, does not bind affinity resins, and does not cause DNA recombination.

quiz.q_zh: 为什么 SEC 常常分不开目的蛋白和它的降解片段？
quiz.q_en: Why does SEC often fail to separate a target protein from its degradation fragments?

options.zh: SEC 柱只保留小分子，大分子直接流穿
options.en: SEC retains only small molecules; large ones flow straight through

options.zh: SEC 只能分离带电性质不同的分子
options.en: SEC can only separate molecules differing in charge

options.zh: 洗脱体积取决于流体力学半径，差别太小
options.en: elution volume tracks hydrodynamic radius, and the difference is small

options.zh: 降解片段与全长蛋白的等电点完全相同
options.en: fragments and full-length protein share the same isoelectric point

quiz.explain_zh: SEC 按分子在孔隙中能进入的体积、也就是流体力学半径分离，而半径大致随分子量立方根变化，所以分子量相差不大的物种洗脱位置几乎重叠。SEC 与电荷、等电点无关（那是离子交换层析），大分子确实先流出但仍在分离范围内。
quiz.explain_en: SEC separates by the volume a molecule can enter in the pores, i.e. its hydrodynamic radius, which scales roughly with the cube root of mass, so species of similar mass elute almost on top of each other. Charge and pI are irrelevant here (that is ion exchange), and large molecules elute first but are still being separated.

quiz.q_zh: 冠状病毒有活性的最小 RdRP 复合物由哪些成分组成？
quiz.q_en: Which components make up the minimal active coronavirus RdRP complex?

options.zh: 单独的 nsp12 催化亚基
nsp12 加主蛋白酶 nsp5
options.en: nsp12 with the main protease nsp5

options.zh: 解旋酶 nsp13 加 nsp14
nsp12 加 nsp7 和 nsp8

quiz.explain_zh: nsp12 是催化核心，但单独几乎没有延伸活性，需要 nsp7 和两拷贝 nsp8 作为辅因子才具备持续合成能力。nsp5 是主蛋白酶，负责切割多聚蛋白；nsp13 解旋酶和 nsp14 校正外切酶参与更大的复制转录复合物，但不是最小活性聚合酶。
quiz.explain_en: nsp12 is the catalytic core but has almost no extension activity alone; it needs nsp7 and two copies of nsp8 as cofactors to become processive. nsp5 is the main protease that cleaves the polyprotein, while the nsp13 helicase and nsp14 proofreading exonuclease belong to the larger replication-transcription complex, not the minimal polymerase.

title_zh: 回到课程：叶酸、一碳单位与抗叶酸抗癌药
title_en: Back to the lecture: folate, one-carbon units and antifolate chemotherapy

points.zh: 叶酸 folic acid（课上称维 B11，标准编号是 B9）比前面几种维生素重要一点，因为它的辅酶作用不可替代。
points.en: Folic acid (called B11 in class; the standard number is B9) matters more than the preceding vitamins because its coenzyme role has no substitute.

points.zh: 叶酸的辅酶作用是传递一碳单位 one-carbon unit——这是这一节唯一必须记住的功能。
points.en: Folate's coenzyme function is to transfer one-carbon units — the one function to remember from this section.

points.zh: 一碳单位就是「一个碳原子」的基团；碳不能单独游离存在，必须挂在辅酶上，最终交到底物上时才是一个碳原子，所以叫一碳单位。
points.en: A one-carbon unit is a group containing a single carbon; carbon cannot exist free, so it rides on the coenzyme, and it is one carbon atom by the time it is handed to the substrate — hence the name.

points.zh: 同理，二碳单位 two-carbon unit 就是两个碳的基团（B1 / TPP 转移的那种）。
points.en: By the same logic a two-carbon unit is a two-carbon group — the kind transferred by B1 / TPP.

points.zh: 一碳单位是嘌呤环和嘧啶环上的组分：没有叶酸，人体的核苷酸就合成不出来，细胞生长因此受阻。
points.en: One-carbon units are building blocks of the purine and pyrimidine rings: without folate, nucleotides cannot be made and cell growth stalls.

points.zh: 肿瘤细胞快速增殖，对核苷酸的需求大，所以这条通路成了早期化疗的靶点（在靶向药出现之前）。
points.en: Tumour cells proliferate fast and need many nucleotides, which made this pathway a target for early chemotherapy, before targeted drugs existed.

points.zh: 抗叶酸药是四氢叶酸 THF 的类似物，破坏肿瘤细胞里的一碳单位传递；它无差别攻击所有增殖细胞，是「杀敌一千自损八百」的疗法，现在用得较少但历史上很重要。
points.en: Antifolates are analogues acting on tetrahydrofolate (THF) metabolism and cripple one-carbon transfer in tumour cells; they hit every dividing cell indiscriminately — effective but costly to the patient, less used now but historically important.

points.zh: 孕妇补叶酸是常识，但老师提醒：孕期需要补的不止叶酸，很多维生素都是辅酶，在细胞构筑中都关键。
points.en: Folate supplementation in pregnancy is common knowledge, but the teacher notes it is not only folate: many vitamins are coenzymes and all matter for building cells.

extra.zh: 课上把抗癌药说成「四氢蝶呤」。真正的药是氨蝶呤 aminopterin 和甲氨蝶呤 methotrexate（MTX）——叶酸的类似物，竞争性抑制二氢叶酸还原酶 DHFR，使 THF 无法再生，胸苷酸合成随之停摆。四氢蝶呤（BH4 一类）是芳香族氨基酸羟化酶的辅因子，不是化疗药。
extra.en: The lecture names the drug "tetrahydropterin". The actual drugs are aminopterin and methotrexate (MTX) — folate analogues that competitively inhibit dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR), so THF cannot be regenerated and thymidylate synthesis stops. Tetrahydropterin (the BH4 family) is a cofactor for aromatic amino acid hydroxylases, not a chemotherapeutic.

extra.zh: 「肿瘤细胞合成核苷酸比正常细胞快一千倍一万倍」不成立。真实差距只有几倍。正因为差距小，抗叶酸药才会同样重创肠黏膜和骨髓这些本来就在快速分裂的组织——治疗窗很窄，而不是很宽。这也是甲氨蝶呤要配合亚叶酸 leucovorin 解救的原因。
extra.en: "Tumour cells make nucleotides a thousand or ten thousand times faster" is not true; the real difference is only a few-fold. Because the margin is small, antifolates hit gut mucosa and bone marrow — tissues already dividing fast — just as hard. The therapeutic window is narrow, not wide, which is why methotrexate is given with leucovorin rescue.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 叶酸的标准编号是维生素 B9。B11 是旧的、非标准的叫法，考试上写 B11 有可能不被认可。另外要区分：叶酸 folate 是维生素形式，四氢叶酸 THF 才是有活性的辅酶形式，中间经二氢叶酸 DHF 由 DHFR 还原而来。
extra.en: Folate's standard designation is vitamin B9; B11 is an old non-standard label that may not be accepted on an exam. Also distinguish folate, the vitamin form, from tetrahydrofolate (THF), the active coenzyme form, produced via dihydrofolate (DHF) by DHFR.

extra.zh: 最值得记的一条回路：胸苷酸合成酶 thymidylate synthase 用 N5,N10-亚甲基-THF 把 dUMP 变成 dTMP，这个反应里 THF 既供碳又供氢，产物是二氢叶酸 DHF，必须由 DHFR 还原回 THF。所以 DHFR 一被 MTX 卡住，dTMP 立刻断供、DNA 合成停止；5-FU 则从另一端抑制胸苷酸合成酶本身。
extra.en: The circuit worth memorising: thymidylate synthase uses N5,N10-methylene-THF to convert dUMP into dTMP, with THF donating both the carbon and the hydrogens, leaving dihydrofolate (DHF) that DHFR must reduce back to THF. Block DHFR with MTX and dTMP supply stops at once, halting DNA synthesis; 5-FU attacks the same cycle from the other end by inhibiting thymidylate synthase itself.

quiz.q_zh: 在体内负责携带和传递一碳单位的辅酶是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which coenzyme carries and transfers one-carbon units in the cell?

options.zh: 生物素 biotin
硫胺素焦磷酸 TPP
四氢叶酸 THF
辅酶A CoA

quiz.explain_zh: 四氢叶酸以 N5 和 N10 位携带甲基、亚甲基、甲酰基等一碳单位，供给嘌呤环和 dTMP 的合成。生物素转移 CO2，TPP 转移二碳的活性醛基，CoA 转移酰基——都是别的基团。
quiz.explain_en: Tetrahydrofolate carries methyl, methylene and formyl one-carbon units on its N5 and N10 positions, feeding purine ring and dTMP synthesis. Biotin transfers CO2, TPP transfers a two-carbon activated aldehyde, CoA transfers acyl groups — all different groups.

quiz.q_zh: 甲氨蝶呤 methotrexate 抗肿瘤作用的直接分子靶点是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the direct molecular target of methotrexate's antitumour action?

options.zh: 胸苷酸合成酶 thymidylate synthase
核糖核苷酸还原酶 RNR
二氢蝶酸合成酶 dihydropteroate synthase
二氢叶酸还原酶 DHFR

quiz.explain_zh: 甲氨蝶呤是叶酸类似物，竞争性抑制 DHFR，使 DHF 无法还原成 THF，一碳单位断供。胸苷酸合成酶是 5-FU 的靶点，核糖核苷酸还原酶是羟基脲的靶点，二氢蝶酸合成酶只存在于细菌、是磺胺药的靶点。
quiz.explain_en: Methotrexate is a folate analogue that competitively inhibits DHFR, so DHF cannot be reduced back to THF and the one-carbon supply fails. Thymidylate synthase is the target of 5-FU, ribonucleotide reductase that of hydroxyurea, and dihydropteroate synthase exists only in bacteria as the sulfonamide target.

quiz.q_zh: 叶酸缺乏时细胞增殖首先受阻，直接原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: In folate deficiency, what directly stalls cell proliferation first?

options.zh: 细胞膜磷脂的合成原料不足
options.en: there is too little material for membrane phospholipids

options.zh: 核糖体上的肽键形成被直接抑制
options.en: peptide bond formation on the ribosome is blocked

options.zh: 线粒体的电子传递链无法运转
options.en: the mitochondrial electron transport chain cannot run

options.zh: 嘌呤和 dTMP 的合成缺少一碳单位
options.en: purine and dTMP synthesis lacks one-carbon units

quiz.explain_zh: 一碳单位是嘌呤环的碳来源，也是 dUMP 甲基化成 dTMP 的碳来源，缺叶酸时 DNA 合成先停，表现为巨幼细胞性贫血。电子传递、膜脂合成和翻译都不直接依赖叶酸的一碳单位。
quiz.explain_en: One-carbon units supply carbons of the purine ring and the methyl that converts dUMP into dTMP, so DNA synthesis is what fails first in folate deficiency, showing up as megaloblastic anaemia. Electron transport, phospholipid synthesis and translation do not depend directly on folate one-carbon units.

title_zh: 硫辛酸、维生素C、金属离子辅基与维生素章节小结
title_en: Lipoic acid, vitamin C, metal-ion prosthetic groups, and the vitamin chapter wrap-up

points.zh: 硫辛酸 lipoic acid：课上定位为不重要，见得也很少，它也是一种辅酶，具体反应不要求记。
points.en: Lipoic acid: placed as unimportant in class and rarely encountered; it is a coenzyme, but the specific reaction is not required.

points.zh: 维生素C 是水溶性维生素里老师认为最重要的一个，课件上列的功能很多。
points.en: Vitamin C is presented as the most important of the water-soluble vitamins, with a long list of functions on the slide.

points.zh: 老师明确说：维生素C 不是辅酶，它不转移碳单位（回答学生「它会传几个碳」的提问）。
points.en: The teacher states plainly that vitamin C is not a coenzyme and transfers no carbon units — answering the student's question about how many carbons it carries.

points.zh: 维生素C 最核心的性质是还原性 reducing power，由此发挥抗氧化 antioxidant 作用。
points.en: Vitamin C's core property is its reducing power, from which its antioxidant action follows.

points.zh: 本章最后提到金属离子：铁 Fe、铜 Cu、锌 Zn 等主要以辅基 prosthetic group 的形式存在，极少数作为辅酶。
points.en: The chapter closes with metal ions: Fe, Cu, Zn and the like serve mainly as prosthetic groups, only rarely as coenzymes.

points.zh: 金属离子的作用是在氧化还原酶 oxidoreductase 中传递电子，或参与结合 ATP 等底物。
points.en: Metal ions transfer electrons in oxidoreductases or help bind substrates such as ATP.

points.zh: 小结（脂溶性）：真正重要的是维生素D——记住它的功能和它长得像什么；维A、维E、维K 相对次要。
points.en: Summary for the fat-soluble vitamins: what really matters is vitamin D — its function and what its structure resembles; A, E and K are secondary.

points.zh: 小结（要点句）：脂溶性维生素里唯一作为辅酶的是维生素K；水溶性维生素大部分都以辅酶形式存在，从 B1 开始——B1 是辅酶，转移二碳单位。
points.en: Summary line to memorise: vitamin K is the only fat-soluble vitamin acting as a coenzyme, while most water-soluble vitamins exist as coenzymes, starting with B1 — a coenzyme that transfers two-carbon units.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 「维生素C 你能想到的任何反应它都能参与」过于笼统，考试要能点名具体岗位：脯氨酰羟化酶 prolyl hydroxylase 和赖氨酰羟化酶 lysyl hydroxylase 的辅因子（把 Fe2+ 保持在还原态），胶原三螺旋因此稳定——缺乏即坏血病 scurvy；多巴胺 β-羟化酶的辅因子；水相抗氧化剂，并能把氧化的维生素E 再生；还促进膳食非血红素铁的吸收。严格说它是这些酶的辅因子/还原剂，只是不像 NAD、CoA 那样传递基团。
extra.en: "Vitamin C takes part in any reaction you can think of" is too vague; an exam wants the specific posts: cofactor for prolyl and lysyl hydroxylase (keeping Fe2+ reduced), which stabilises the collagen triple helix — deficiency gives scurvy; cofactor for dopamine beta-hydroxylase; aqueous-phase antioxidant that also regenerates oxidised vitamin E; and it promotes absorption of dietary non-haem iron. Strictly it is a cofactor/reductant for those enzymes, it simply does not transfer a group the way NAD or CoA does.

extra.zh: 把「脂溶性维生素中唯一的辅酶是维K」讲完整：维K 是 γ-谷氨酰羧化酶的辅因子，把凝血酶原 prothrombin 及因子 VII、IX、X 上的谷氨酸 Glu 羧化成 γ-羧基谷氨酸 Gla，Gla 才能螯合 Ca2+ 并把凝血因子拉到膜表面。华法林 warfarin 抑制的是维K 环氧化物还原酶 VKOR，所以抗凝作用需要几天才显现。
extra.en: Complete the line "vitamin K is the only fat-soluble coenzyme": vitamin K is the cofactor of gamma-glutamyl carboxylase, converting glutamate residues in prothrombin and factors VII, IX and X into gamma-carboxyglutamate (Gla), which alone can chelate Ca2+ and pull the factors onto the membrane. Warfarin inhibits vitamin K epoxide reductase (VKOR), which is why its anticoagulant effect takes days to appear.

extra.zh: 辅酶 coenzyme 与辅基 prosthetic group 的区别是结合的松紧：辅酶结合松、可以透析除去（NAD+、CoA、THF），辅基结合紧甚至共价（血红素、琥珀酸脱氢酶上的 FAD、共价连在赖氨酸上的生物素）。金属离子多算辅基，两者都属于辅因子 cofactor。这一点老师在前一讲讲反过一次，务必按这个方向记。
extra.en: Coenzyme versus prosthetic group is a question of how tightly they bind: coenzymes bind loosely and can be removed by dialysis (NAD+, CoA, THF), prosthetic groups bind tightly or covalently (haem, the FAD of succinate dehydrogenase, biotin on its lysine). Metal ions count mostly as prosthetic groups, and both are cofactors. The teacher inverted this once in the previous lecture, so fix the direction.

extra.zh: 硫辛酸虽然被跳过，但它出现在一个必考的位置：丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体 PDH 的 E2 亚基上，硫辛酸以硫辛酰胺形式共价连在赖氨酸上，摆动着把酰基和还原当量在 E1、E2、E3 之间传递。PDH 的五个辅因子——TPP（B1）、硫辛酸、CoA（泛酸）、FAD（B2）、NAD+（PP）——常被整组考。
extra.en: Lipoic acid is skipped here but sits in an exam-standard place: on the E2 subunit of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, covalently attached to a lysine as lipoamide, swinging acyl groups and reducing equivalents between E1, E2 and E3. PDH's five cofactors — TPP (B1), lipoate, CoA (pantothenate), FAD (B2) and NAD+ (niacin) — are usually examined as a set.

quiz.q_zh: 脂溶性维生素中，以辅酶形式直接参与酶促反应的是哪一个？
quiz.q_en: Which fat-soluble vitamin acts directly as a coenzyme in an enzymatic reaction?

options.zh: 维生素E
维生素K
维生素A
维生素D

quiz.explain_zh: 维生素K 是 γ-谷氨酰羧化酶的辅因子，参与凝血因子的羧化反应。维生素A 是视黄醛形式的发色团，维生素D 经两次羟化后作为激素通过核受体起作用，维生素E 是脂相抗氧化剂——三者都不是辅酶。
quiz.explain_en: Vitamin K is the cofactor of gamma-glutamyl carboxylase in the carboxylation of clotting factors. Vitamin A works as the retinal chromophore, vitamin D acts as a hormone through a nuclear receptor after two hydroxylations, and vitamin E is a lipid-phase antioxidant — none of them a coenzyme.

quiz.q_zh: 维生素C 缺乏导致坏血病，最直接的生化原因是什么？
quiz.q_en: What is the most direct biochemical cause of scurvy in vitamin C deficiency?

options.zh: 铁不能装入原卟啉，血红素合成受阻
options.en: iron cannot enter protoporphyrin and haem synthesis stalls

options.zh: 脯氨酰、赖氨酰羟化酶失活，胶原不稳定
options.en: prolyl and lysyl hydroxylases fail, so collagen is unstable

options.zh: 一碳单位转移受阻，核苷酸合成不足
options.en: one-carbon transfer stalls and nucleotide synthesis fails

options.zh: 凝血因子无法羧化，钙离子结合丧失
options.en: clotting factors cannot be carboxylated and lose Ca2+ binding

quiz.explain_zh: 维生素C 把这两个羟化酶活性中心的铁维持在 Fe2+ 状态，羟脯氨酸和羟赖氨酸缺失则胶原三螺旋不稳定，血管壁与结缔组织脆弱、牙龈出血。一碳单位是叶酸的活，羧化凝血因子是维K 的活，血红素装铁靠亚铁螯合酶。
quiz.explain_en: Vitamin C keeps the active-site iron of those two hydroxylases as Fe2+; without hydroxyproline and hydroxylysine the collagen triple helix is unstable, leaving vessel walls and connective tissue fragile with bleeding gums. One-carbon transfer is folate's job, carboxylating clotting factors is vitamin K's, and inserting iron into haem is done by ferrochelatase.

quiz.q_zh: 关于辅酶与辅基的区别，下列哪一项正确？
quiz.q_en: Which statement about coenzymes versus prosthetic groups is correct?

options.zh: 辅酶是金属离子，辅基是有机小分子
options.en: coenzymes are metal ions; prosthetic groups are organic

options.zh: 辅酶参与催化，辅基只起结构支撑
options.en: coenzymes catalyse; prosthetic groups only give structure

options.zh: 辅酶结合紧密，辅基可被透析除去
options.en: coenzymes bind tightly; prosthetic groups dialyse away

options.zh: 辅酶结合疏松，辅基结合紧密或共价
options.en: coenzymes bind loosely; prosthetic groups bind tightly or covalently

quiz.explain_zh: 标准区分是结合的松紧：NAD+、CoA、四氢叶酸这类辅酶可以透析除去，像共底物一样来去；血红素、琥珀酸脱氢酶上的 FAD、共价连在赖氨酸上的生物素这类辅基则牢牢留在酶上。二者都是辅因子，都直接参与催化，金属离子多数属于辅基而非辅酶。
quiz.explain_en: The standard distinction is how tightly they bind: coenzymes such as NAD+, CoA and tetrahydrofolate can be dialysed away and come and go like co-substrates, whereas prosthetic groups such as haem, the FAD of succinate dehydrogenase and lysine-linked biotin stay fixed on the enzyme. Both are cofactors and both take part in catalysis, and metal ions mostly count as prosthetic groups rather than coenzymes.

title_zh: 水溶性维生素总复习：每个 B 族维生素变成哪个辅酶
title_en: Water-soluble vitamin recap: which coenzyme each B vitamin becomes

points.zh: 维生素 B2 riboflavin 核黄素是 FMN 和 FAD 的组成部分，负责传递氢和电子（一次转移 2H）。
points.en: Vitamin B2 (riboflavin) is the building block of FMN and FAD, which carry hydrogen and electrons (2H per cycle).

points.zh: 维生素 B6 的辅酶形式是 pyridoxal phosphate 磷酸吡哆醛 (PLP)，是转氨酶 transaminase 和氨基酸脱羧酶的辅酶。
points.en: The coenzyme form of vitamin B6 is pyridoxal phosphate (PLP), coenzyme for transaminases and amino-acid decarboxylases.

points.zh: 维生素 B12 cobalamin 钴胺素是唯一含金属 cobalt 钴 的维生素，也是唯一含金属的辅酶类维生素。
points.en: Vitamin B12 (cobalamin) is the only vitamin containing a metal, cobalt, at the centre of its ring system.

points.zh: 维生素 PP niacin 尼克酸（即 B3）是 NAD⁺ 和 NADP⁺ 的组成部分，是氧化还原反应的主力辅酶。
points.en: Vitamin PP (niacin, B3) is the building block of NAD⁺ and NADP⁺, the workhorse redox coenzymes.

points.zh: 泛酸 pantothenic acid (B5) 是 coenzyme A (CoA) 的组成部分，CoA 负责转移酰基 acyl group。
points.en: Pantothenic acid (B5) is part of coenzyme A (CoA), which transfers acyl groups.

points.zh: 生物素 biotin 作为维生素考点不重，但作为实验 tag 标签极重要；它本身是羧化酶 carboxylase 的辅酶，转移 CO₂。
points.en: Biotin matters less as a vitamin than as a laboratory tag, but it is also the coenzyme of carboxylases, transferring CO₂.

points.zh: 成对记忆：B1 thiamine (TPP) 转移二碳单位 two-carbon unit，叶酸 folate (THF) 转移一碳单位 one-carbon unit。
points.en: Remember as a pair: B1 (as TPP) transfers two-carbon units, folate (as THF) transfers one-carbon units.

points.zh: 硫辛酸 lipoic acid 不是重点，它在丙酮酸脱氢酶复合体 pyruvate dehydrogenase complex 中同时转移酰基和电子。
points.en: Lipoic acid is a minor exam item; it transfers both acyl groups and electrons inside the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex.

points.zh: 老师对维生素 C 的总结是「什么作用都有，怎么说都对」——考试上这样答太空，需要说出具体的酶和病症。
points.en: The lecturer sums vitamin C up as "it does everything, any answer works" — too vague for an exam, which wants named enzymes and diseases.

extra.zh: 「维生素C任何功能都能参与」并不准确。它的作用是具体的：作为 prolyl hydroxylase 和 lysyl hydroxylase 的辅因子参与胶原蛋白 collagen 羟基化（缺乏导致坏血病 scurvy）；作为 dopamine β-hydroxylase 的辅因子参与儿茶酚胺合成；作为水相抗氧化剂并再生维生素 E。
extra.en: "Vitamin C takes part in any reaction" is not accurate. Its roles are specific: cofactor for prolyl and lysyl hydroxylase in collagen hydroxylation (deficiency causes scurvy), cofactor for dopamine β-hydroxylase in catecholamine synthesis, and an aqueous-phase antioxidant that regenerates vitamin E.

extra.zh: 背成一张对应表最省力：B1→TPP（二碳单位、α-酮酸脱羧）；B2→FMN/FAD（氢传递）；B3/PP→NAD⁺、NADP⁺（氢传递）；B5 泛酸→CoA（酰基）；B6→PLP（转氨）；B7 生物素→羧化（CO₂）；B9 叶酸→THF（一碳单位）；B12→甲基转移与分子内重排。
extra.en: The cheapest way to hold this is one table: B1→TPP (two-carbon units, α-keto acid decarboxylation); B2→FMN/FAD (hydrogen); B3/PP→NAD⁺, NADP⁺ (hydrogen); B5 pantothenate→CoA (acyl); B6→PLP (transamination); B7 biotin→carboxylation (CO₂); B9 folate→THF (one-carbon units); B12→methyl transfer and intramolecular rearrangement.

extra.zh: 维生素 PP = niacin 尼克酸 = 维生素 B3 = 抗癞皮病因子 pellagra-preventing factor，是 NAD/NADP 的来源；不要和维生素 B2 riboflavin（FMN/FAD 的来源）混起来。两者都做氢传递，但辅酶不同、缺乏症不同（癞皮病 vs 口角炎）。
extra.en: Vitamin PP = niacin = vitamin B3 = the pellagra-preventing factor, and it is the source of NAD/NADP; do not merge it with riboflavin (B2), the source of FMN/FAD. Both work in hydrogen transfer, but the coenzymes and the deficiency diseases differ (pellagra vs angular cheilitis).

extra.zh: 叶酸的标准编号是 vitamin B9。旧文献里出现的 B11、Bc 等写法是非标准的，考试上不会被承认，答题一律写 B9 或 folate/folic acid。
extra.en: The standard designation for folate is vitamin B9. Older labels such as B11 or Bc are non-standard and will not be accepted on an exam; write B9, folate, or folic acid.

quiz.q_zh: 泛酸是下列哪种辅酶的组成部分？
quiz.q_en: Pantothenic acid is a building block of which coenzyme?

options.zh: 辅酶 Q（CoQ）
焦磷酸硫胺素（TPP）
磷酸吡哆醛（PLP）
辅酶 A（CoA）

quiz.explain_zh: 泛酸提供 CoA 分子中带巯基一侧的骨架，CoA 由此转移酰基。辅酶 Q 是脂溶性醌，不含维生素；TPP 来自维生素 B1，PLP 来自维生素 B6。
quiz.explain_en: Pantothenate supplies the backbone on the thiol side of CoA, which is how CoA carries acyl groups. Coenzyme Q is a lipid-soluble quinone and contains no vitamin; TPP comes from B1 and PLP from B6.

quiz.q_zh: 转移一碳单位 one-carbon unit 的辅酶来自哪种维生素？
quiz.q_en: The coenzyme that transfers one-carbon units derives from which vitamin?

options.zh: 维生素 B1 thiamine
维生素 B2 riboflavin
维生素 B6 pyridoxine
叶酸 folate

quiz.explain_zh: 叶酸还原成四氢叶酸 THF 后携带甲基、亚甲基、甲酰基等一碳单位。thiamine 以 TPP 形式转移二碳单位；riboflavin 传递氢；pyridoxine 以 PLP 形式做转氨。
quiz.explain_en: Folate reduced to tetrahydrofolate (THF) carries methyl, methylene and formyl one-carbon units. Thiamine as TPP moves two-carbon units, riboflavin carries hydrogen, and pyridoxine as PLP runs transamination.

quiz.q_zh: 唯一含有金属元素钴 cobalt 的维生素是？
quiz.q_en: Which vitamin contains the metal cobalt?

options.zh: 维生素 B2 核黄素
维生素 PP 尼克酸
维生素 B7 生物素
维生素 B12 钴胺素

quiz.explain_zh: 钴胺素的名字直接来自中心的钴离子。核黄素含异咯嗪环，尼克酸是吡啶羧酸，生物素含噻吩环加脲环，三者都不含金属。
quiz.explain_en: Cobalamin is named for the cobalt ion at its centre. Riboflavin has an isoalloxazine ring, niacin is a pyridine carboxylic acid, and biotin has a thiophene fused to a ureido ring — none contains a metal.

title_zh: 细菌转化实验：S 型与 R 型、加热杀死的细菌为什么还能致死
title_en: The bacterial transformation experiment: S and R strains, and why heat-killed bacteria still kill

points.zh: 在此之前人们普遍认为蛋白质才是遗传物质，因为蛋白质研究开始得早得多、分子种类也更多。
points.en: Before these experiments protein was the favoured candidate for the genetic material, since protein chemistry started far earlier and proteins are far more varied.

points.zh: 肺炎链球菌按菌落形态分 S 型 smooth（表面光滑）和 R 型 rough（表面粗糙）。
points.en: Pneumococcus comes in two colony morphologies: S (smooth) and R (rough).

points.zh: 活的 S 型接种小鼠致死；活的 R 型接种小鼠不死；高温杀死的 S 型接种小鼠也不死。
points.en: Live S kills the mouse; live R does not; heat-killed S does not either.

points.zh: 关键组：高温杀死的 S 型 + 活的 R 型混合后接种，小鼠死亡，而且能从死鼠体内分离出活的 S 型菌。
points.en: The decisive group: heat-killed S mixed with live R kills the mouse, and live S bacteria can be recovered from it.

points.zh: 结论是存在一种耐热的 transforming principle 转化因子，能把 R 型转化成 S 型，而且这个性状可以遗传下去。
points.en: The conclusion is that a heat-stable transforming principle converts R into S, and the converted trait is inherited.

points.zh: 老师用「蛋白质高温已变性，所以蛋白质不是遗传物质」来解释——这是后来的推论，Griffith 本人并没有鉴定出转化因子是什么。
points.en: The lecturer's reasoning — protein was denatured by heat, so protein is not the genetic material — is a later inference; Griffith himself never identified the transforming principle.

points.zh: 真正的鉴定来自 Avery, MacLeod & McCarty 1944：用 protease 和 RNase 处理转化活性仍在，用 DNase 处理活性消失，因此转化因子是 DNA。
points.en: The identification came from Avery, MacLeod and McCarty in 1944: protease and RNase left the transforming activity intact, DNase destroyed it, so the principle is DNA.

points.zh: Hershey 与 Chase 1952 用 ³²P 标记噬菌体 DNA、³⁵S 标记外壳蛋白，证明进入细菌的是 DNA，最终定案。
points.en: Hershey and Chase settled it in 1952, labelling phage DNA with ³²P and coat protein with ³⁵S and showing that only DNA entered the bacterium.

points.zh: 细菌之间能互相传递遗传物质，这是转化实验成立的天然基础——肺炎链球菌本身就有天然感受态 competence。
points.en: Bacteria naturally exchange genetic material, which is what makes the experiment possible — pneumococcus is naturally competent.

extra.zh: 课上说「1928 年人们才发现核酸是遗传物质」，又把它叫作「格里芬和 Avery 的细菌转化实验」，把相隔十六年的两个实验并成了一个。Griffith 格里菲斯（不是格里芬）在 1928 年只证明存在一种耐热的转化因子，他从未说过那是 DNA；把它鉴定为 DNA 的是 Avery、MacLeod 和 McCarty，1944 年；Hershey–Chase 1952 年用同位素标记做最终确认。答题时时间线要写清：1928 → 1944 → 1952 → 1953（双螺旋）。
extra.en: The lecture says "in 1928 people discovered that nucleic acid is the genetic material" and calls it "Griffith and Avery's transformation experiment", collapsing two experiments sixteen years apart. Griffith (1928) showed only that a heat-stable transforming principle exists — he never said it was DNA. Avery, MacLeod and McCarty identified it as DNA in 1944, and Hershey–Chase confirmed it with isotope labelling in 1952. Write the timeline out: 1928 → 1944 → 1952 → 1953 (double helix).

extra.zh: Avery 实验的方法学核心是酶学排除法：同一份提取物分别用蛋白酶、RNase、DNase 处理，只有 DNase 让转化活性消失。这种「用专一性酶逐一敲掉候选分子」的设计本身就是常考的实验设计题模板。
extra.en: The methodological core of the Avery experiment is enzymatic elimination: the same extract is treated with protease, RNase or DNase, and only DNase abolishes transformation. This "knock out each candidate with a specific enzyme" design is itself a classic exam template.

extra.zh: S 型的毒力来自多糖荚膜 capsular polysaccharide，它让细菌逃避吞噬；R 型丢失了荚膜合成基因，所以既粗糙又无毒。转化恢复的正是这段荚膜合成基因，所以「转化」在分子层面就是一次基因的水平转移。
extra.en: S virulence comes from a capsular polysaccharide that lets the bacterium evade phagocytosis; R strains have lost the capsule-synthesis genes, which makes them both rough and avirulent. Transformation restores exactly those genes, so at the molecular level it is a horizontal gene transfer event.

extra.zh: 老师对加热温度只是猜测，他自己也说没查证。真正重要的关系是：大多数蛋白质在 60–70 °C 就已不可逆变性，而双链 DNA 的 Tm 通常落在 85–95 °C 区间（随 GC 含量和离子强度升高而升高）。所以温和加热可以在保住 DNA 完整性的同时杀死细菌并使蛋白变性，这正是转化因子「耐热」的物理基础。
extra.en: The lecturer's heat-killing temperature is a guess and he says so. The relationship that matters: most proteins denature irreversibly by 60–70 °C, whereas the Tm of duplex DNA generally falls in the 85–95 °C range, rising with GC content and ionic strength. Moderate heat can therefore kill the cells and denature their proteins while leaving DNA intact — the physical basis for the transforming principle being heat-stable.

quiz.q_zh: Griffith 1928 年的实验直接证明了什么？
quiz.q_en: What did Griffith's 1928 experiment directly demonstrate?

options.zh: 这种转化因子就是荚膜多糖
options.en: the transforming principle is capsular polysaccharide

options.zh: 存在一种耐热的转化因子
这种转化因子就是 DNA
这种转化因子就是蛋白质

quiz.explain_zh: Griffith 只观察到加热杀死的 S 型能把 R 型转化为 S 型，说明存在一种耐热且可遗传的因子，他没有做任何化学鉴定。把它鉴定为 DNA 要等到 1944 年的 Avery 实验。
quiz.explain_en: Griffith saw only that heat-killed S converted R into S, implying a heat-stable, heritable factor; he ran no chemical identification. Naming it as DNA had to wait for Avery in 1944.

quiz.q_zh: Avery 等 1944 年的实验中，哪种处理会让转化活性消失？
quiz.q_en: In Avery's 1944 experiment, which treatment abolished the transforming activity?

options.zh: lipase 脂肪酶处理
DNase 脱氧核糖核酸酶处理
RNase 核糖核酸酶处理
protease 蛋白酶处理

quiz.explain_zh: 只有降解 DNA 的酶能破坏转化活性，说明转化因子是 DNA。蛋白酶、RNase 和脂肪酶处理后活性仍保留，正好排除了蛋白质、RNA 和脂类。
quiz.explain_en: Only the DNA-degrading enzyme destroyed the activity, identifying the principle as DNA. Activity survived protease, RNase and lipase, which excluded protein, RNA and lipid.

quiz.q_zh: Hershey 与 Chase 用哪一对同位素区分噬菌体的 DNA 和蛋白质？
quiz.q_en: Which pair of isotopes did Hershey and Chase use to separate phage DNA from phage protein?

options.zh: ¹²⁵I 与 ⁵⁹Fe
³²P 与 ³⁵S
¹⁴C 与 ³H
¹⁵N 与 ¹³C

quiz.explain_zh: DNA 含磷不含硫，蛋白质含硫（Cys、Met）而几乎不含磷，所以 ³²P 标记 DNA、³⁵S 标记外壳蛋白能把两者彻底分开。¹⁵N 与 ¹³C 是 Meselson–Stahl 半保留复制实验的标记思路。
quiz.explain_en: DNA contains phosphorus but no sulfur, while protein contains sulfur (Cys, Met) but essentially no phosphorus, so ³²P labels DNA and ³⁵S labels the coat cleanly. ¹⁵N and ¹³C belong to the Meselson–Stahl semi-conservative replication experiment.

title_zh: 实验室插话（可跳过）：PCR 预变性温度，以及 transformation / transfection 的区别
title_en: Lab digression (skippable): PCR pre-denaturation, and transformation vs transfection

points.zh: 学生问：高温不是会让 DNA 解链吗？——DNA 解链 denaturation 是可逆的，降温可以复性 renaturation；蛋白质变性通常不可逆，这是两者的关键差别。
points.en: The student asks whether heat would not melt the DNA. DNA denaturation is reversible — it renatures on cooling — whereas protein denaturation is usually irreversible; that is the key difference.

points.zh: 老师说 PCR 前要 98 °C 加热 5 分钟甚至 10 分钟，这个时间明显偏长。
points.en: The lecturer says PCR needs 98 °C for five or even ten minutes before cycling; that is far longer than routine.

points.zh: 常规预变性 pre-denaturation 是 95–98 °C、30 秒到 3 分钟，足以把模板全长解开。
points.en: Routine pre-denaturation is 95–98 °C for 30 s to 3 min, which is enough to melt the template over its full length.

points.zh: 例外是 hot-start polymerase：它的抗体或化学修饰需要一个激活步骤，时长由厂家说明书规定。
points.en: The exception is hot-start polymerase, whose antibody or chemical block needs an activation step with a manufacturer-specified duration.

points.zh: 长时间高温的代价是模板 depurination 脱嘌呤、链断裂，以及聚合酶活性损失，所以并不是「越久越保险」。
points.en: Prolonged heat costs you template depurination and strand breaks plus polymerase activity, so longer is not safer.

points.zh: transformation 转化：把裸露的 DNA 或质粒 plasmid 导入原核细胞（尤其 E. coli），常用 CaCl₂ 化学感受态或 electroporation 电穿孔。
points.en: Transformation: introducing naked DNA or a plasmid into a prokaryote (especially E. coli), usually via CaCl₂ chemical competence or electroporation.

points.zh: transfection 转染：借助脂质体等试剂或病毒载体，把 DNA/RNA 导入真核细胞。记法就是老师说的「进原核叫转化，进真核叫转染」。
points.en: Transfection: delivering DNA or RNA into a eukaryotic cell with lipid reagents or viral vectors. The lecturer's rule of thumb: into prokaryotes it is transformation, into eukaryotes it is transfection.

points.zh: 老师想不起来的第三个词是 conjugation 接合：两个细菌之间伸出 pilus 性菌毛，直接把质粒传给对方。
points.en: The third word the lecturer cannot recall is conjugation: two bacteria connect through a pilus and one transfers a plasmid directly to the other.

points.zh: 还有 transduction 转导：由噬菌体 phage 携带把细菌基因带到另一个细菌里。
points.en: And transduction: bacterial genes carried from one cell to another inside a phage particle.

extra.zh: 「PCR 前 98 °C 加热 5 分钟或 10 分钟」不是常规条件。常规预变性是 95–98 °C、30 秒至 3 分钟；十分钟的高温会让模板脱嘌呤断裂并消耗酶活。只有 hot-start 酶需要更长的激活时间，且必须按说明书。
extra.en: "98 °C for five or ten minutes before PCR" is not a routine condition. Routine pre-denaturation is 95–98 °C for 30 s to 3 min; ten minutes depurinates and fragments the template and costs polymerase activity. Only hot-start enzymes need a longer activation, and it is specified by the manufacturer.

extra.zh: 细菌的水平基因转移 horizontal gene transfer 有三条经典途径，考试常一起考：transformation 转化（摄取环境中的裸 DNA）、conjugation 接合（通过 pilus 直接接触转移）、transduction 转导（噬菌体介导）。Griffith 实验里发生的正是第一种。
extra.en: Bacterial horizontal gene transfer has three classic routes, usually examined together: transformation (uptake of naked environmental DNA), conjugation (direct transfer through a pilus), and transduction (phage-mediated). Griffith's experiment is the first of the three.

extra.zh: DNA 的解链温度 Tm 随 GC 含量升高而升高（G≡C 三个氢键、A=T 两个），也随离子强度升高而升高（阳离子屏蔽磷酸骨架的负电排斥）。PCR 用 94–98 °C，是为了在几秒到几十秒内把包括高 GC 区在内的整条模板打开。
extra.en: The melting temperature Tm of DNA rises with GC content (G≡C has three hydrogen bonds, A=T two) and with ionic strength (cations screen the repulsion between phosphate backbones). PCR uses 94–98 °C so that even GC-rich stretches melt within seconds.

extra.zh: transformation 在细胞生物学里还有第二个意思：正常细胞的「恶性转化」，即癌变。看到英文 transformation 要先判断语境是分子克隆还是肿瘤生物学，两者同名异义。
extra.en: Transformation has a second meaning in cell biology: the malignant transformation of a normal cell into a cancerous one. When you meet the word, decide first whether the context is molecular cloning or tumour biology — they are unrelated senses.

quiz.q_zh: 常规 PCR 的初始预变性条件是？
quiz.q_en: What are the routine initial pre-denaturation conditions for PCR?
quiz.explain_zh: 95–98 °C 足以解开双链，30 秒到 3 分钟已经够用；延长到十几分钟会造成脱嘌呤和酶活损失。72–75 °C 是延伸温度，55–60 °C 是退火温度，都达不到解链。
quiz.explain_en: 95–98 °C melts the duplex and 30 s to 3 min is sufficient; stretching it to ten-plus minutes causes depurination and loses polymerase activity. 72–75 °C is the extension temperature and 55–60 °C the annealing temperature, neither of which melts the template.

quiz.q_zh: 通过 pilus 性菌毛在两个细菌之间直接转移 DNA，这种方式叫什么？
quiz.q_en: Direct DNA transfer between two bacteria through a pilus is called what?

options.zh: 接合 conjugation
转化 transformation
转导 transduction
转染 transfection

quiz.explain_zh: 接合需要供体与受体细胞直接接触，通过性菌毛建立通道传递质粒。转化是摄取环境中的裸 DNA，转导由噬菌体携带，转染针对的是真核细胞。
quiz.explain_en: Conjugation requires physical contact between donor and recipient, with the pilus establishing the channel for plasmid transfer. Transformation takes up naked DNA from the environment, transduction is carried by phage, and transfection targets eukaryotic cells.

quiz.q_zh: 用脂质体试剂把 mRNA 导入 HEK293 细胞，这一操作称为？
quiz.q_en: Delivering mRNA into HEK293 cells with a lipid reagent is called what?

options.zh: 转染 transfection
转化 transformation
接合 conjugation
转导 transduction

quiz.explain_zh: HEK293 是真核细胞，用化学试剂导入核酸就叫转染。转化用于把核酸导入原核细胞，接合只发生在细菌之间，转导特指由病毒载体递送。
quiz.explain_en: HEK293 is a eukaryotic line, and introducing nucleic acid with a chemical reagent is transfection. Transformation applies to prokaryotes, conjugation happens only between bacteria, and transduction specifically means delivery by a viral vector.

title_zh: 核酸的命名、基本单位与细胞内分布
title_en: Naming nucleic acids, their building blocks, and where they sit in the cell

points.zh: DNA = deoxyribonucleic acid 脱氧核糖核酸：de- 去掉，oxy 氧，ribo 核糖，nucleic 细胞核。拆开词根就能记住。
points.en: DNA = deoxyribonucleic acid: de- (removal), oxy (oxygen), ribo (ribose), nucleic (nucleus). Splitting the roots is the whole mnemonic.

points.zh: RNA = ribonucleic acid 核糖核酸，与 DNA 的差别就在核糖 2′ 位保留了羟基 OH。
points.en: RNA = ribonucleic acid; the difference from DNA is the hydroxyl retained at the 2′ position of the ribose.

points.zh: 层级要背清楚：碱基 base + 戊糖 pentose = 核苷 nucleoside；核苷 + 磷酸 phosphate = 核苷酸 nucleotide；核苷酸聚合成核酸 nucleic acid。
points.en: Fix the hierarchy: base + pentose = nucleoside; nucleoside + phosphate = nucleotide; nucleotides polymerise into nucleic acid.

points.zh: 举例：adenine 腺嘌呤（碱基）→ adenosine 腺苷（核苷）→ AMP 腺苷一磷酸（核苷酸）。英文后缀 -ine / -osine / -ate 是线索。
points.en: Example: adenine (base) → adenosine (nucleoside) → AMP (nucleotide). The English suffixes -ine / -osine / -ate are the clue.

points.zh: 老师强调核酸是静态生化里化学结构最复杂的一类：糖类是环，脂质是链加羧基，蛋白质是二十种相近的残基，而核酸的名称层层相套。
points.en: The lecturer stresses that nucleic acids have the most complex chemistry in static biochemistry: sugars are rings, lipids are chains with a carboxyl, proteins are twenty similar residues, but nucleic acid names nest inside one another.

points.zh: 真核细胞核内约 98% 的核酸以染色体 chromosome 的形式存在（DNA 与组蛋白结合）。
points.en: In a eukaryotic nucleus about 98% of the nucleic acid exists as chromosomes, DNA bound to histones.

points.zh: 核外 DNA 有线粒体 DNA 和叶绿体 DNA，都是环状双链、母系遗传，规范写法是 mtDNA 和 cpDNA（也写 ctDNA）。
points.en: Extranuclear DNA comprises mitochondrial and chloroplast DNA, both circular, double-stranded and maternally inherited, written mtDNA and cpDNA (also ctDNA).

points.zh: 原核生物没有核膜，DNA 集中在 nucleoid 拟核区，压缩程度远低于染色体，所以没有明确的「核内核外」之分。
points.en: Prokaryotes have no nuclear membrane; their DNA sits in the nucleoid, far less compacted than a chromosome, so there is no clear inside/outside-the-nucleus distinction.

points.zh: 同一个碱基可以出现在完全不同的分子里（NAD 里的腺嘌呤核苷酸、CoA 里的腺苷酸），学生的混乱正来自这里——按「碱基–糖–磷酸」三件套拆解就不乱。
points.en: The same base turns up in quite different molecules (the adenine nucleotide in NAD, the adenosine in CoA), which is the source of the student's confusion; dissecting every structure as base–sugar–phosphate resolves it.

extra.zh: 核苷 nucleoside 与核苷酸 nucleotide 只差一个磷酸基，英文靠词尾区分：-side 没有磷酸，-tide 有磷酸。中文靠「酸」字：带「酸」的才有磷酸。
extra.en: A nucleoside and a nucleotide differ by one phosphate group; in English the ending tells you which — -side has no phosphate, -tide has one. In Chinese the character 酸 marks the phosphorylated form.

extra.zh: 「脱氧」精确地指 2′-deoxy，即核糖 2′ 位的羟基被氢取代。RNA 保留的这个 2′-OH 正是它在碱性条件下容易发生分子内亲核攻击而断链的化学根源，也是 DNA 更适合做长期遗传物质的原因。
extra.en: "Deoxy" refers precisely to 2′-deoxy: the hydroxyl at C2′ of ribose replaced by hydrogen. The 2′-OH that RNA keeps is exactly what makes it prone to intramolecular nucleophilic attack and chain cleavage under alkaline conditions, and why DNA is the better long-term genetic store.

extra.zh: 人类线粒体 DNA 是一个约 16.6 kb 的环状双链分子，编码 13 条呼吸链多肽、2 条 rRNA 和 22 条 tRNA；其余线粒体蛋白由核基因组编码后运入。每个细胞有成百上千份拷贝，这也是法医和系谱研究偏爱 mtDNA 的原因。
extra.en: Human mitochondrial DNA is a circular duplex of roughly 16.6 kb encoding 13 respiratory-chain polypeptides, 2 rRNAs and 22 tRNAs; the remaining mitochondrial proteins are encoded in the nucleus and imported. Each cell carries hundreds to thousands of copies, which is why forensics and genealogy favour mtDNA.

extra.zh: 缩写 ctDNA 在临床文献中通常指 circulating tumor DNA 循环肿瘤 DNA，与叶绿体 DNA 撞名。现在叶绿体 DNA 多写 cpDNA；线粒体 DNA 的规范写法是 mtDNA，不是课上板书的 MDNA。
extra.en: In clinical literature ctDNA almost always means circulating tumour DNA, colliding with chloroplast DNA. Chloroplast DNA is now usually written cpDNA, and mitochondrial DNA is mtDNA, not the MDNA written on the board.

quiz.q_zh: 核苷 nucleoside 与核苷酸 nucleotide 的区别是什么？
quiz.q_en: What distinguishes a nucleoside from a nucleotide?

options.zh: 核苷酸多一个磷酸基团
options.en: the nucleotide has one extra phosphate group

options.zh: 核苷酸多一个碱基基团
options.en: the nucleotide has one extra base group

options.zh: 核苷酸多一个戊糖基团
options.en: the nucleotide has one extra pentose group

options.zh: 核苷酸多一个羟基基团
options.en: the nucleotide has one extra hydroxyl group

quiz.explain_zh: 核苷是碱基加戊糖，核苷酸是核苷再酯化上一个磷酸。碱基和戊糖两者都各只有一个，羟基数目的差别属于核糖与脱氧核糖之分，不是核苷与核苷酸之分。
quiz.explain_en: A nucleoside is base plus pentose; a nucleotide is that nucleoside esterified with a phosphate. Both contain exactly one base and one pentose, and a difference in hydroxyls separates ribose from deoxyribose, not nucleoside from nucleotide.

quiz.q_zh: 下列哪一项属于真核细胞的核外 DNA？
quiz.q_en: Which of these is extranuclear DNA in a eukaryotic cell?

options.zh: 着丝粒 DNA（centromere）
线粒体 DNA（mtDNA）
端粒 DNA（telomere）
核仁 rDNA（rDNA）

quiz.explain_zh: 线粒体有自己的环状基因组，位于细胞核之外。端粒、着丝粒是染色体上的特定区段，核仁 rDNA 也位于核内的染色体上，三者都属于核内 DNA。
quiz.explain_en: Mitochondria carry their own circular genome outside the nucleus. Telomeres and centromeres are specific chromosomal regions, and nucleolar rDNA also sits on nuclear chromosomes, so all three are nuclear DNA.

quiz.q_zh: DNA 名称中的「脱氧 deoxy」具体指什么？
quiz.q_en: What exactly does the "deoxy" in DNA refer to?

options.zh: 戊糖 2′ 位缺少羟基
戊糖 3′ 位缺少羟基
碱基环上缺少氨基
options.en: the base ring lacks an amino group

options.zh: 磷酸基上缺少氧原子
options.en: the phosphate lacks an oxygen atom

quiz.explain_zh: 脱氧核糖是核糖 2′ 位的 OH 被 H 取代。3′-OH 必须保留，否则无法形成 3′,5′-磷酸二酯键、也无法延伸——这正是 ddNTP 用于 Sanger 测序终止链延伸的原理。磷酸基和碱基都没有被脱氧。
quiz.explain_en: Deoxyribose is ribose with the 2′ OH replaced by H. The 3′-OH must remain, or no 3′,5′-phosphodiester bond can form and the chain cannot extend — precisely why ddNTPs terminate chains in Sanger sequencing. Neither the phosphate nor the base loses an oxygen.

title_zh: RNA 的分布、非编码 RNA 与 siRNA（夹带剪接体的职业闲聊，可跳过）
title_en: RNA distribution, non-coding RNA and siRNA (with a skippable career aside on the spliceosome)

points.zh: RNA 主要分布在细胞质 cytoplasm 中，这一点是对的；但老师说「主要存在形式就是 tRNA 和 mRNA」，与他后面自己的说法冲突。
points.en: RNA is indeed mostly cytoplasmic, but the lecturer's claim that it exists "mainly as tRNA and mRNA" contradicts what he says a few minutes later.

points.zh: 按含量算：rRNA 约占细胞总 RNA 的 80%，tRNA 约 15%，mRNA 只有百分之几。
points.en: By abundance, rRNA is roughly 80% of cellular RNA, tRNA about 15%, and mRNA only a few per cent.

points.zh: 非编码 RNA non-coding RNA / small RNA 是近一二十年的热点方向。
points.en: Non-coding RNA, or small RNA, has been a hot field for the last one to two decades.

points.zh: 2000 年之前，人们把细胞里提取到的这些小 RNA 当成提取或加热过程中的降解碎片，认为没有意义。
points.en: Before about 2000 these short RNAs recovered from cells were dismissed as fragments broken during extraction or heating.

points.zh: 此后发现它们具有真实的生物学功能，RNA 干扰 RNAi 的发现获 2006 年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖（Fire 与 Mello）。
points.en: They were then shown to have genuine biological functions; the discovery of RNA interference won the 2006 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine (Fire and Mello).

points.zh: snRNA、asRNA 等名目繁多，老师说不必背，但 siRNA 要记住。
points.en: The lecturer says the zoo of names — snRNA, asRNA and the rest — need not be memorised, but siRNA should be.

points.zh: siRNA = small interfering RNA 小干扰 RNA（老师口头说成 small inhibit RNA，但他板书写的「小干扰 RNA」是对的）。
points.en: siRNA = small interfering RNA; the lecturer says "small inhibit RNA" aloud, though the 小干扰 RNA he writes down is correct.

points.zh: 机制：siRNA 与目标 mRNA 碱基配对，导致该 mRNA 被切割失活，从而 knockdown 敲低目标蛋白的表达——这在信号通路研究里用得很多。
points.en: Mechanism: siRNA base-pairs with the target mRNA, which is then cleaved and inactivated, knocking down expression of that protein — heavily used in signalling-pathway work.

points.zh: 中间穿插一段职业闲聊（施一公与剪接体 spliceosome 的正刊论文），与考点无关可跳过；但剪接体本身值得记：它是 snRNA 加蛋白构成的核糖核蛋白复合体，负责剪除内含子。
points.en: A career aside about Shi Yigong's spliceosome papers interrupts here and can be skipped; the spliceosome itself is worth knowing as a ribonucleoprotein of snRNA plus protein that excises introns.

extra.zh: 「RNA 可能五六十度就开始降解」不成立。纯 RNA 在 60 °C 并不会自发解体。RNA 的脆弱来自两点：2′-OH 使磷酸二酯键在碱性或金属离子催化下容易发生分子内断裂；以及环境中无处不在的 RNase。所以 RNA 实验的核心是 RNase-free 操作（DEPC 处理、专用耗材、戴手套），而不是控温。
extra.en: "RNA starts degrading at fifty or sixty degrees" does not hold. Pure RNA does not fall apart spontaneously at 60 °C. Its fragility has two sources: the 2′-OH, which makes the phosphodiester backbone prone to intramolecular cleavage under alkaline or metal-ion catalysis, and ubiquitous RNases. RNA work is therefore about RNase-free technique — DEPC treatment, dedicated consumables, gloves — not about temperature.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 这里说 RNA「主要存在形式就是 tRNA 和 mRNA」，几分钟后他又说「大部分的 RNA 都是 rRNA」。后一句才是对的：rRNA 约 80%，tRNA 约 15%，mRNA 只占百分之几。听到前一句不要就此停下。
extra.en: Here RNA is said to exist "mainly as tRNA and mRNA"; a few minutes later the lecturer says "most RNA is rRNA". The later statement is the correct one — rRNA about 80%, tRNA about 15%, mRNA only a few per cent. Do not stop at the first version.

extra.zh: siRNA 不是自己去切 mRNA：它被装载到 RISC 复合体中，由 Argonaute 蛋白执行切割。完全互补配对 → 切割降解（siRNA 的典型作用）；部分互补配对 → 翻译抑制和去腺苷化（miRNA 的典型作用）。这一对差别是常考点。
extra.en: siRNA does not cut the mRNA itself: it is loaded into the RISC complex and the Argonaute protein does the cleaving. Full complementarity leads to cleavage and degradation (the typical siRNA outcome); partial complementarity leads to translational repression and deadenylation (the typical miRNA outcome). That contrast is frequently examined.

extra.zh: knockdown 敲低与 knockout 敲除不是一回事：敲低作用在 RNA 层面（siRNA/shRNA），是部分、可逆的表达下降；敲除作用在基因组层面（如 CRISPR），是该基因被永久破坏。写实验方案时用错词会被认为设计不清。
extra.en: Knockdown and knockout are not the same: knockdown acts at the RNA level (siRNA/shRNA) and gives a partial, reversible drop in expression, while knockout acts on the genome (e.g. CRISPR) and permanently disrupts the gene. Mixing the terms in a protocol reads as an unclear design.

quiz.q_zh: 细胞内含量最高的 RNA 种类是？
quiz.q_en: Which class of RNA is the most abundant in the cell?

options.zh: snRNA 核内小 RNA
rRNA 核糖体 RNA
mRNA 信使 RNA
tRNA 转运 RNA

quiz.explain_zh: rRNA 约占细胞总 RNA 的 80%，因为核糖体数量极多；tRNA 约 15%，mRNA 只有百分之几，snRNA 更少。含量高低与「重要与否」无关，mRNA 少却是信息载体。
quiz.explain_en: rRNA is about 80% of cellular RNA because ribosomes are so numerous; tRNA is about 15%, mRNA only a few per cent, and snRNA less still. Abundance is not importance — mRNA is scarce yet carries the message.

quiz.q_zh: siRNA 使基因沉默的机制是什么？
quiz.q_en: By what mechanism does siRNA silence a gene?

options.zh: 与靶 DNA 配对并阻断其转录
options.en: it pairs with the target DNA and blocks transcription

options.zh: 与核糖体结合并阻断其组装
options.en: it binds the ribosome and blocks its assembly

options.zh: 与靶蛋白结合并促进其降解
options.en: it binds the target protein and promotes its degradation

options.zh: 与靶 mRNA 配对并使其被切割
options.en: it pairs with the target mRNA, which is then cleaved

quiz.explain_zh: siRNA 装载进 RISC 后以碱基互补找到目标 mRNA，由 Argonaute 切割该 mRNA，蛋白因此表达下降。它不直接作用于 DNA、核糖体或蛋白质。
quiz.explain_en: Loaded into RISC, the siRNA finds its target mRNA by base complementarity and Argonaute cleaves it, so the protein is no longer made. It does not act on DNA, on the ribosome, or on the protein itself.

quiz.q_zh: RNA 在化学上比 DNA 更容易断裂，根本原因是？
quiz.q_en: What is the chemical reason RNA is more prone to cleavage than DNA?

options.zh: 尿嘧啶取代了胸腺嘧啶
分子通常为单链形式
磷酸二酯键数目更少
核糖 2′ 位带有羟基

quiz.explain_zh: 2′-OH 可以对相邻的磷酸发起分子内亲核攻击，在碱性或金属离子条件下形成 2′,3′-环磷酸中间体而断链，DNA 没有这个基团所以稳定得多。单链结构只是让 RNase 更易接近，不是化学根源；碱基种类和键数与骨架稳定性无关。
quiz.explain_en: The 2′-OH can attack the adjacent phosphate intramolecularly, forming a 2′,3′-cyclic phosphate intermediate and breaking the chain under alkaline or metal-ion conditions; DNA lacks that group and is far more stable. Being single-stranded only makes RNA more accessible to RNases, and the identity or number of bonds does not affect backbone stability.

title_zh: 核糖体、S 沉降系数，以及用 16S rRNA 鉴定细菌
title_en: Ribosomes, the Svedberg unit, and identifying bacteria by 16S rRNA

points.zh: 大部分 RNA 是 rRNA，rRNA 参与核糖体 ribosome 的构成，所以 RNA 的很大一部分是在为蛋白质合成的机器服务。
points.en: Most RNA is rRNA and rRNA builds the ribosome, so a large share of cellular RNA is part of the protein-synthesis machine.
