quiz.explain_en: Denaturation only undoes the non-covalent forces between strands; the backbone survives, which is why slow cooling permits renaturation. Breaking phosphodiester or glycosidic bonds would be degradation or depurination and is irreversible; the mature backbone contains no anhydride bonds at all.

title_zh: B/A/Z 型 DNA、非经典配对、超螺旋与染色质，以及课程收尾
title_en: B-, A- and Z-DNA, non-canonical pairing, supercoiling and chromatin, and the closing chat

points.zh: 基因组中的双螺旋都是反平行 antiparallel 的：两条链方向相反，一条 5′→3′ 时另一条 3′→5′。
points.en: Genomic duplexes are antiparallel: the two strands run in opposite directions, one 5′→3′ while the other runs 3′→5′.

points.zh: 生理条件下绝大多数是 B-DNA（现在写作 B，不写 β）；A-DNA 较少见。两者都是右手螺旋 right-handed。
points.en: Almost all physiological DNA is B-DNA (written B, not β); A-DNA is much rarer. Both are right-handed helices.

points.zh: B 与 A 的主要差别在沟的形状：A-DNA 的大沟窄而深、小沟宽而浅，与 B 型相反。
points.en: B and A differ mainly in groove shape: in A-DNA the major groove is narrow and deep and the minor groove wide and shallow — the reverse of B.

points.zh: 此外还有左手螺旋的 Z-DNA，以及四股螺旋（G-quadruplex）这类立方堆积式的非双链结构。
points.en: There is also the left-handed Z-DNA, and four-stranded structures (G-quadruplexes) that stack in a boxy, non-duplex arrangement.

points.zh: 经典配对称为 Watson–Crick 配对：一个碱基严格只与一个碱基配对，A=T 两个氢键、G≡C 三个氢键。非经典配对存在，但只是补充知识。
points.en: Canonical pairing is Watson–Crick: strictly one base to one base, A=T with two hydrogen bonds and G≡C with three. Non-canonical pairings exist but are supplementary.

points.zh: 超螺旋 supercoil：把已经成螺旋的双链再拧一次，就像把头发绳扭起来。它的定量描述（连接数等）考试不会考，知道概念即可。
points.en: Supercoiling means twisting an already-helical duplex again, like twisting a hair tie. Its quantitative description (linking number and so on) is not examined — the concept suffices.

points.zh: 超螺旋的意义是让 DNA 更致密；负超螺旋 negative supercoil 储存张力，一松开就倾向于局部解链，因而有利于复制 replication 和转录 transcription。
points.en: Supercoiling compacts the DNA; negative supercoiling stores torsional tension that favours local strand separation, and so favours replication and transcription.

points.zh: 改变超螺旋状态的酶是拓扑异构酶 topoisomerase，分子生物学里已经学过。
points.en: The enzyme that changes the supercoiled state is topoisomerase, familiar from molecular biology.

points.zh: DNA 与蛋白的复合物：DNA 缠绕组蛋白 histone 形成小环（核小体 nucleosome），小环再层层缠绕压缩，最终形成染色体 chromosome。
points.en: DNA-protein complex: DNA wraps around histones to form the nucleosome bead, and these coil upon themselves repeatedly to build the chromosome.

extra.zh: 课上说「用拓扑异构酶把双超螺旋解成单链螺旋然后才可以发生复制」，把两种酶混为一谈。解开双链变成单链的是解旋酶 helicase；拓扑异构酶 topoisomerase 是切开一条链（I 型）或两条链（II 型），让 DNA 转动或穿过后再接回去，用来消除 helicase 在复制叉前方堆积的正超螺旋。二者分工明确，谁也替代不了谁 —— 这正是复制需要两种酶的原因。
extra.en: The lecture says topoisomerase "unwinds the supercoiled duplex into single strands so replication can happen", conflating two enzymes. Helicase separates the strands at the fork. Topoisomerase cuts one strand (type I) or both (type II), lets the DNA rotate or pass through, and reseals — relieving the positive supercoiling that helicase piles up ahead of the fork. Neither does the other's job, which is exactly why both are needed.

extra.zh: 课上把配对描述成「一个碱基和两个 T 同时配对」。Watson–Crick 配对严格是一对一。一个碱基同时接触两个配偶属于 Hoogsteen 配对：嘌呤用 N7 面而不是 Watson–Crick 面成键，这是三链 DNA triplex 和 G-quadruplex 的基础 —— 真实存在，但不是经典配对。
extra.en: The lecture describes "one base pairing with two T's at once". Watson-Crick pairing is strictly one-to-one. A base contacting two partners simultaneously is Hoogsteen pairing, in which the purine uses its N7 face rather than its Watson-Crick face — the basis of triplex DNA and G-quadruplexes. Real, but not canonical.

extra.tag: 课上说法不同 · lecture states it differently
extra.zh: 课上说人体内「还有很多不同的螺旋，比如 A-DNA」。A-DNA 出现在脱水条件、以及 RNA–DNA 杂合双链和双链 RNA 中，并不是基因组的常规状态；人体内的生理构象是 B-DNA。
extra.en: The lecture presents A-DNA as a form found throughout the human body. A-DNA appears under dehydration and in RNA-DNA hybrids and double-stranded RNA, not as a general genomic state; the physiological form is B-DNA.

extra.zh: 课上给的「真核生物其他类型 DNA 占 5% 以下、原核生物约 15%」两个数字没有给出处，当示意听即可，不宜作为可引用的数据写进答案。
extra.en: The figures given in the lecture — under 5% non-B DNA in eukaryotes, about 15% in prokaryotes — come without a source. Treat them as illustrative rather than as quotable data.

quiz.q_zh: 在复制叉处把 DNA 双链解开成两条单链的酶是？
quiz.q_en: Which enzyme separates the DNA duplex into two single strands at the replication fork?

options.zh: 解旋酶 helicase
拓扑异构酶 topoisomerase
连接酶 ligase
引物酶 primase

quiz.explain_zh: 解旋酶水解 ATP 打开碱基对之间的氢键，分开两条链。拓扑异构酶不分开链，它切开并重接以消除前方的正超螺旋；连接酶封合缺口；引物酶合成 RNA 引物。
quiz.explain_en: Helicase hydrolyses ATP to break the hydrogen bonds between paired bases and part the strands. Topoisomerase does not separate strands — it cuts and reseals to relieve positive supercoiling ahead of the fork; ligase seals nicks; primase makes the RNA primer.

quiz.q_zh: 拓扑异构酶发挥作用的方式是？
quiz.q_en: How does topoisomerase act?

options.zh: 直接拆开碱基对的氢键
options.en: it breaks the hydrogen bonds of base pairs

options.zh: 在缺口处连接冈崎片段
options.en: it joins Okazaki fragments at a nick

options.zh: 在模板上合成 RNA 引物
options.en: it makes an RNA primer on the template

options.zh: 切开 DNA 链再重新接回
options.en: it cuts a DNA strand and reseals it

quiz.explain_zh: I 型切一条链、II 型切两条链，让 DNA 转动或穿过后再封回，从而改变超螺旋数。拆氢键分开双链是解旋酶的工作；连接冈崎片段是连接酶；合成引物是引物酶。
quiz.explain_en: Type I cuts one strand and type II both, letting the DNA rotate or pass through before resealing, which changes the supercoiling. Breaking hydrogen bonds to part the strands is helicase's job; joining Okazaki fragments is ligase's; making primers is primase's.

quiz.q_zh: 一个碱基同时与两个碱基配对，属于哪种配对方式？
quiz.q_en: One base pairing with two partners at the same time is which kind of pairing?

options.zh: 摆动 wobble 配对
反平行互补配对
Hoogsteen 配对
Watson–Crick 配对

quiz.explain_zh: Hoogsteen 配对用嘌呤的 N7 面另外结合一个碱基，是三链 DNA 和 G-quadruplex 的基础。Watson–Crick 严格一对一；wobble（如 G–U）虽非经典，但仍是一对一；反平行描述的是两条链的走向，不是碱基的配对数目。
quiz.explain_en: Hoogsteen pairing uses the N7 face of a purine to bind an additional base, the basis of triplex DNA and G-quadruplexes. Watson-Crick is strictly one-to-one; wobble pairing such as G-U is non-canonical but still one-to-one; antiparallel describes strand direction, not how many partners a base has.
